Berakhot 32b:11-25: Tanu rabbanan: arbaa tzerichin chizzuk, veellu hen: tora, umaasim tovim, tefilla, vederech eretz.
Tora umaasim tovim minnayin? — shenneemar: "rak chazak veematz meod lishmor velaasot kechol hattora", "chazak" — battora, "veematz" — bemaasim tovim.
Tefilla minnayin? — shenneemar "kavve el Adonai chazak veyaametz libbecha vekavve el Adonai".
Derech eretz minnayin? — shenneemar "chazak venitchazzak bead ammenu vegomer".

"Vattomer tziyyon azavani Adonai vaAdonai shechechani". hayeynu azuva, hayeynu shechucha? amar resh lakish: amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, adam nose ishsha al ishto rishona, zocher maase harishona. atta azavtani ushechachtani.

Amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu: bitti, shenem asar mazzalot barati barakia, veal kol mazzal umazzal barati lo sheloshim chayil, veal kol chayil vechayil barati lo sheloshim ligyon, veal kol ligyon veligyon barati lo sheloshim rahaton, veal kol rahaton verahaton barati lo sheloshim keraton, veal kol keraton ukeraton barati lo sheloshim gastera, veal kol gastera vegastera taliti bo shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha alfe ribbo kochavim keneged yemot hachamma. vechullan lo barati ella bishvilech, veat amart "azavtani" ushechachtani"?!

"Hatishkach ishsha ulah", amar hakkadosh baruch hu: kelum eshkach olot elim ufitre rechamim shehikravt lefanay bammidbar?! amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, hoil veen shichcha lifne kisse chevodecha, shemma lo tishkach li maase haegel? amar lah: "gam elle tishkachna".
Amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, hoil veyesh shichcha lifne kisse chevodecha, shemma tishkach li maase sinay? amar lah: "veanochi lo eshkachech".
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi elazar amar rav oshaya: may dichtiv "gam elle tishkachna" — ze maase haegel, "veanochi lo eshkachech" — ze maase sinay.
Chasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa achat:
Mena hane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar kera: "ashre yoshve vetecha".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammitpallel tzarich lishhot shaa achat achar tefillato, shenneemar: "ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha".

Tanya name hachi: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyishhe shaa achat kodem tefillato, veshaa achat achar tefillato. kodem tefillato, minnayin? shenneemar: "ashre yoshve vetecha". leachar tefillato minnayin? — dichtiv: "ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha yeshvu yesharim et panecha".

Tanu rabbanan: chasidim harishonim hayu shohin shaa achat, umitpallelin shaa achat, vechozrin veshohin shaa achat. vechi meachar sheshshohin tesha shaot bayyom bitfilla, toratan heach mishtammeret, umelachtam heach naaset?
Ella mittoch shechasidim hem — toratam mishtammeret, umelachtan mitbarechet.
Chullin 89a:5-10: Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: kol makom sheatta motze devarav shel rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili bahaggada – ase oznecha kaafarkeset. "lo merubbechem mikkol haammim chashak Adonai bachem vegomer" – amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: choshkani bachem, sheafillu beshaa sheani mashpia lachem gedulla – attem memaatin atzmechem lefanay.
Natatti gedulla leavraham – amar lefanay: "veanochi afar vaefer", lemoshe veaharon – amar: "venachnu ma", ledavid – amar: "veanochi tolaat velo ish".

Aval ummot haolam enan ken, natatti gedulla lenimrod – amar: "hava nivne lanu ir", lefaro – amar: "mi Adonai", lesancheriv – amar: "mi bechol elohe haaratzot vegomer", linvuchadnetztzar – amar: "eele al bomote av", lechiram melech tzor – amar: "moshav elohim yashavti belev yammim".

Amar rava, veittema rabbi yochanan: gadol shenneemar bemoshe veaharon yoter mimma shenneemar beavraham, deillu beavraham ketiv: "veanochi afar vaefer", veillu bemoshe veaharon ketiv: "venachnu ma". veamar rava, veittema rabbi yochanan: en haolam mitkayyem ella bishvil moshe veaharon, ketiv hacha: "venachnu ma", uchetiv hatam: "tole aretz al belima".

Amar rabbi ila: en haolam mitkayyem ella bishvil mi shebbolem et atzmo bishat meriva, shenneemar: "tole eretz al belima". rabbi avahu amar: mi shemmesim atzmo kemi sheeno, shenneemar: "umittachat zeroot olam".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "haumnam elem tzedek tedabberun mesharim tishpetu bene adam"? ma ummanuto shel adam baolam hazze – yasim atzmo keillem. yachol af ledivre tora? talmud lomar "tzedek tedabberun". yachol yagis dato? talmud lomar "mesharim tishpetu bene adam".
Eruvin 100b:7-30: Amar rame bar abba amar rav assi: asur leadam sheyyehallech al gabbe asavim beshabbat, mishshum shenneemar: "veatz beraglayim chote".
Tane chada: muttar lelech al gabbe asavim beshabbat, vetanya iddach: asur. la kashya: ha — belachim, ha — biveshim.
Vei baet ema, ha veha belachim, vela kashya: kan — bimot hachamma, kan — bimot haggeshamim.
Veibbaet ema, ha veha bimot hachamma, vela kashya: ha — desayem mesaneh, ha — dela sayem mesaneh.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha desayem mesaneh, vela kashya: ha — deit leh uketze, ha — delet leh uketze.
Veibbaet ema, ha veha deit leh uketze: ha — deit leh sheracha, ha — delet leh sheracha.
Vehaiddana dekayyma lan kerabbi shimon, kullehu shere.
Veamar rame bar chama amar rav assi: asur leadam sheyyachof ishto lidvar mitzva, shenneemar: "veatz beraglayim chote".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hakkofe ishto lidvar mitzva havyayn lo banim sheenan mehugganin. amar rav ika bar chinnana, may keraa: "gam belo daat nefesh lo tov".
Tanya name hachi: "gam belo daat nefesh lo tov" — ze hakkofe ishto lidvar mitzva. "veatz beraglayim chote" — ze habboel veshone.
Ini?! vehaamar rava: harotze laasot kol banav zecharim yivol veyishne! la kashya: kan — ledaat, kan — shello ledaat.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: kol ishsha shettovaat balah lidvar mitzva hovin lah banim sheafillu bedoro shel moshe lo hayu kemotan. deillu bedoro shel moshe ketiv: "havu lachem anashim chachamim unevonim viduim leshivtechem", uchetiv: "vaekkach et rashe shivtechem anashim chachamim viduim", veillu nevonim la ashkach.

Veillu gabbe lea ketiv: "vattetze lea likrato vattomer elay tavo ki sachor secharticha", uchetiv: "umibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim ladaat ma yaase yisrael rashehem matayim vechol achehem al pihem".
Ini?! vehaamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: eser kelalot nitkallela chavva, dichtiv:
"El haishsha amar hareba arbe", ellu shene tippe damim — achat dam nidda, veachat dam betulim. "itztzevonech", ze tzaar giddul banim. "veheronech", ze tzaar haibbur. "beetzev teldi banim", kemashmao.

"Veel ishech teshukatech", melammed shehaishsha mishtokeket al balah beshaa sheyyotze ladderech. "vehu yimshol bach", melammed shehaishsha tovaat ballev vehaish tovea bappe. zo hi midda tova bannashim.
Ki kaamrinan, demartzeya artzoye kammeh.
Hane sheva havvyan! ki ata rav dimi amar: atufa keavel, umenudda mikkol adam, vachavusha bevet haasurin.
May menudda mikkol adam? illema mishshum daasir la yichud, ihu name asir leh yichud. ella daasira leve tere.
Bematnita tana: megaddelet sear kelilit, veyoshevet umashtenet mayim kivhema, venaaset kar levalah.
Veiddach? hane shevach hu lah.

Deamar rabbi chiyyay, may dichtiv: "mallefenu mibbahamot aretz umeof hashshamayim yechakkemenu". "mallefenu mibbahamot" — zo pereda, shekkoraat umashtenet mayim. "umeof hashshamayim yechakkemenu" — ze tarnegol, shemmefayyes veachar kach boel.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ilmale lo nittena tora, hayinu lemedin tzeniut mechatul, vegazel minnemala, vaarayot miyyona. derech eretz mittarnegol — shemmefayyes veachar kach boel.
Umay mefayyes la? amar rav yehuda amar rav, hachi kaamar la: zavenna lich ziga dematu lich ad karaych, levatar hachi amar la: lishmatteh lecharbalteh dehahu tarnegola i it leh vela zavenna lich.
Jeremiah 16:19-17:3: Adonai uzzi umauzzi umenusi beyom tzara elecha goyim yavou meafse-aretz veyomru ach-sheker nachalu avotenu hevel veen-bam moil
Hayaase-lo adam elohim vehemma lo elohim
Lachen hinni modiam bappaam hazzot odiem et-yadi veet-gevurati veyadu ki-shemi Adonai {s}
Chattat yehuda ketuva beet barzel betzipporen shamir charusha al-luach libbam ulekarnot mizbechotechem
Kizkor benehem mizbechotam vaasherehem al-etz raanan al gevaot haggevohot
Harari bassade chelcha chol-otzrotecha lavaz etten bamotecha bechattat bechol-gevulecha
Jeremiah 17:13-18: Mikve yisrael Adonai kol-ozvecha yevoshu (yissure) [vesuray] baaretz yikkatevu ki azvu mekor mayim-chayyim et-Adonai {p}
Refaeni Adonai veerafe hoshieni veivvashea ki tehillati atta
Hinne-hemma omrim elay ayye devar-Adonai yavo na
Vaani lo-atzti ׀ meroe acharecha veyom anush lo hitavveti atta yadata motza sefatay nochach panecha haya
Yevoshu rodfay veal-evosha ani yechattu hemma veal-echatta ani havi alehem yom raa umishne shibbaron shovrem {s}
Jeremiah 17:19-23: Ko-amar Adonai elay haloch veamadta beshaar bene[haam] (im) asher yavou vo malche yehuda vaasher yetzu vo uvechol shaare yerushala͏m
Veamarta alehem shimu devar-Adonai malche yehuda vechol-yehuda vechol yoshve yerushala͏m habbaim bashshearim haelle
Ko amar Adonai hishshamru benafshotechem veal-tisu massa beyom hashshabbat vahavetem beshaare yerushala͏m
Velo-totziu massa mibbattechem beyom hashshabbat vechol-melacha lo taasu vekiddashtem et-yom hashshabbat kaasher tzivviti et-avotechem
Velo shamu velo hittu et-oznam vayyakshu et-orpam levilti (shomea) [shemoa] ulevilti kachat musar
Jeremiah 17:4-7: Veshamatta uvecha minnachalatcha asher natatti lach vehaavadticha et-oyvecha baaretz asher lo-yadata ki-esh kedachtem beappi ad-olam tukad {s}
Ko ׀ amar Adonai arur haggever asher yivtach baadam vesam basar zeroo umin-Adonai yasur libbo
Vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki-yavo tov veshachan charerim bammidbar eretz melecha velo teshev {s}
Baruch haggever asher yivtach baAdonai vehaya Adonai mivtacho
Jeremiah 17:8-12: Vehaya keetz ׀ shatul al-mayim veal-yuval yeshallach shorashav velo (yare) [yire] ki-yavo chom vehaya alehu raanan uvishnat batztzoret lo yidag velo yamish measot peri
Akov hallev mikkol veanush hu mi yedaennu
Ani Adonai choker lev bochen kelayot velatet leish kidrachav kifri maalalav {s}
Kore dagar velo yalad ose osher velo vemishpat bachatzi yamav yaazvennu uveacharito yihye naval
Kisse chavod marom merishon mekom mikdashenu
Kiddushin 82b:3-5: Rabbi meir omer: leolam yelammed adam livno ummanut nekiyya vekalla, vivakkesh rachamim lemi shehaosher vehannechasim shello, sheen aniyyut min haummanut veen ashirut min haummanut, ella – lemi shehaosher shello, shenneemar: "li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai tzevaot".

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: im raita miyyamecha. tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: miyyamay lo raiti tzevi kayyaytz, vaari sabbal, veshual chenvani, vehem mitparnesim shello betzaar. vehem lo nivreu ella leshammesheni, vaani nivreti leshammesh et koni. ma ellu shello nivreu ella leshammesheni mitparnesim shello betzaar, vaani shennivreti leshammesh et koni – eno din sheetparnes shello betzaar? ella shehareoti et maasay vekippachti et parnasati, shenneemar: "avonotechem hittu".

Rabbi nehoray omer: manniach ani kol ummanut vechulei. tanya: rabbi nehoray omer: manniach ani kol ummanut shebbaolam veeni melammed et beni ella tora, shekkol ummanut shebbaolam en omedet lo ella bime yalduto, aval bime ziknuto hare hu muttal baraav. aval tora enah ken – omedet lo laadam beet yalduto, venotenet lo acharit vetikva beet ziknuto. beet yalduto mahu omer? "vekoye Adonai yachalifu choach yaalu ever kannesharim" beziknuto mahu omer? "od yenuvun beseva deshenim veraanannim yihyu".
Mishnah Eruvin 4:10-5:2:
Mi sheyyatza lelech beir shemmearvin bah vehecheziro chavero, hu muttar lelech vechol bene hair asurin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, kol shehu yachol learev velo erev, hare ze chammar gammal: 
Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum, afillu amma achat, lo yikkanes. rabbi eliezer omer, shetayim, yikkanes, shalosh, lo yikkanes. mi shehechshich chutz lattechum, afillu amma achat, lo yikkanes. rabbi shimon omer, afillu chamesh esre ammot, yikkanes, sheen hammashochot mematztzin et hammiddot, mippene hattoin: 
Ketzad meabberin et hearim, bayit nichnas bayit yotze, pagum nichnas pagum yotze. hayu sham gedudiyyot gevohot asara tefachim, ugesharim unefashot, sheyyesh bahen bet dira, motziin et hammidda chenegdan, veosin otah kemin tavla merubbaat, kede sheyyehe niskar et hazzaviyyot: 
Notnin karpef lair, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, lo amru karpef ella ven shete ayarot, im yesh lazo shivim amma veshirayim, velazo shivim amma veshirayim, ose karpef lishtehen lihyotan keechat:
Mishnah Eruvin 5:3-6:
Vechen shelosha chefarim hammeshullashin, im yesh ben shenayim hachitzonim mea vearbaim veechad ushelish, asa emtzai et shelashtan lihyotan keechad: 
En moddin ella vechevel shel chamishshim amma, lo fachot velo yoter. velo yimdod ella cheneged libbo. haya moded vehiggia legay o legader, mavlio vechozer lemiddato. higgia lehar, mavlio vechozer lemiddato, uvilvad shello yetze chutz lattechum. im eno yachol lehavelio, bazo amar rabbi dostay bar rabbi yannay mishshum rabbi meir, shamati shemmekadderin beharim: 
En moddin ella min hammumche. ribba lemakom echad umiet lemakom acher, shomin limkom sheribba. ribba leechad umiet leacher, shomin lamrubbe. afillu eved, afillu shifcha, neemanin lomar, ad kan techum shabbat, shello amru chachamim et haddavar lehachamir ella lehakel: 
Ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim, mearvin et kullah. veshel rabbim venaaset shel yachid, en mearvin et kullah, ella im ken asa chutza lah keir chadasha shebbihuda, sheyyesh bah chamishshim diurim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim:
Mishnah Eruvin 5:7-6:1:
Mi shehaya vammizrach veamar livno, arev li vammaarav, bammaarav veamar livno, arev li vammizrach, im yesh hemennu uleveto alpayim ammot, uleeruvo yoter mikkan, muttar leveto veasur leeruvo. leeruvo alpayim amma, uleveto yoter mikkan, asur leveto umuttar leeruvo. hannoten et eruvo veibburah shel ir, lo asa velo chelum. netano chutz lattechum, afillu amma achat, ma shenniskar hu mafsid: 
Anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna, veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola. ketzad. mi shehaya veir gedola venatan et eruvo veir ketanna, beir ketanna venatan et eruvo veir gedola, mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma. verabbi akiva omer, en lo ella mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma: 
Amar lahen rabbi akiva, i attem modim li venoten eruvo vimara, sheen lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma. amru lo, ematay, bizman sheen bah diurin, aval yesh bah diurin, mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma. nimtza, kal tochah meal gabbah. velammoded sheamru notnin lo alpayim, sheafillu sof middato kale vimara: 
Haddar im hannachri vechatzer, o im mi sheeno mode vaeruv, hare ze oser alav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, leolam eno oser ad sheyyehu shene yisreelim osrin ze al ze:
Mishnah Eruvin 6:2-6:
Amar rabban gamliel, maase vitzdoki echad, shehaya dar immanu bemavoy birushalayim, veamar lanu abba, maharu vehotziu et kol hakkelim lammavoy, ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem. rabbi yehuda omer belashon acher, maharu vaasu tzarchechem bammavoy ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem: 
Anshe chatzer sheshshachach achad mehen velo erev, beto asur millehachnis umillehotzi, lo velahem, veshellahem muttarin, lo velahem. natnu lo reshutan, hu muttar vehen asurin. hayu shenayim, osrin ze al ze, sheechad noten reshut venotel reshut, shenayim notnim reshut veen notlin reshut: 
Meematay notnin reshut. bet shammay omrim, mibbeod yom, uvet hillel omrim, mishshechashecha. mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, hare ze oser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, bemezid oser, beshogeg eno oser: 
Baal habbayit shehaya shuttaf lishchenim, laze veyayin velaze veyayin, enam tzerichim learev. laze veyayin velaze veshemen, tzerichim learev. rabbi shimon omer, echad ze veechad ze, enam tzerichim learev: 
Chamesh chavurot sheshshavtu vitraklin echad, bet shammay omrim, eruv lechol chavura vachavura. uvet hillel omrim, eruv echad lechullan. umodim, bizman shemmiktzatan sheruyin bachadarim o vaaliyyot, shehen tzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura:
Mishnah Eruvin 6:7-10:
Haachin hashshuttafin shehayu ochlin al shulchan avihem vishenim bevattehem, tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad. lefichach, im shachach echad mehem velo erev, mevattel et reshuto. ematay, bizman shemmolichin eruvan bemakom acher, aval im haya eruv ba etzlan, o sheen immahen diurin bechatzer, enan tzerichin learev: 
Chamesh chatzerot petuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lemavoy, ervu vachatzerot velo nishtattefu vammavoy, muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bammavoy. veim nishtattefu vammavoy, muttarin kan vachan. ervu vachatzerot venishtattefu vammavoy, veshachach echad mibbene chatzer velo erev, muttarin kan vachan. mibbene mavoy velo nishtattef, muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bammavoy, shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim: 
Shete chatzerot, zo lifnim mizzo, erva happenimit velo erva hachitzona, happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura. hachitzona, velo happenimit, shetehen asurot. erva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah, zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah. rabbi akiva oser hachitzona, shedderisat haregel osartah. vachachamim omrim, en derisat haregel osartah: 
Shachach achad min hachitzona velo erev, happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura. min happenimit velo erev, shetehen asurot. natnu eruvan bemakom echad, veshachach echad, ben min happenimit ben min hachitzona, velo erev, shetehen asurot. veim hayu shel yechidim, enan tzerichin learev:
Mishnah Eruvin 7:1-4:
Challon shebben shete chatzerot, arbaa al arbaa, betoch asara, mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu, mearvin echad. pachot mearbaa al arbaa, o lemala measara, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad: 
Kotel shebben shete chatzerot gavoah asara verachav arbaa, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad. hayu verosho ferot, ellu olin mikkan veochlin, veellu olin mikkan veochlin, uvilvad shello yoridu lematta. nifretza hakkotel ad eser ammot, mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu mearvin echad, mippene shehu chefetach. yoter mikkan, mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim: 
Charitz shebben shete chatzerot amok asara verachav arba, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad, afillu male kash o teven. male afar, o tzerorot, mearvin echad, veen mearvin shenayim: 
Natan alav neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim, vechen shete gezuzteraot zo cheneged zo, mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu, mearvin echad. pachot mikkan, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad:
Mishnah Negaim 10:2-6:
Sear tzahov dak metamme mechunnas, umefuzzar, umevutztzar, veshello mevutztzar, hafuch, veshello hafuch, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, eno metamme ella hafuch. amar rabbi shimon, vedin hu, ma im sear lavan, sheen sear acher matztzil miyyado, eno metamme ella hafuch. sear tzahov dak shessear acher matztzil miyyado, eno din shello yetamme ella hafuch. rabbi yehuda omer, kol makom shetztzarich lomar hafuch, amar hafuch. aval hannetek shenneemar bo (Vayikra 13) velo haya vo sear tzahov, metamme hafuch veshello hafuch: 
Hatztzomeach matztzil miyyad hassear tzahov umiyyad happisyon, mechunnas, umefuzzar, mevutztzar, veshello mevutztzar. vehameshoar matztzil miyyad sear tzahov umiyyad happisyon, mechunnas, umefuzzar, umevutztzar. veeno matztzil min hatztzad, ad sheyyehe rachok min hakkama mekom shete searot. achat tzehubba veachat shechora, achat tzehubba veachat levana, enan matztzilot: 
Sear tzahov shekkadam et hannetek, tahor. rabbi yehuda metamme. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, lo metamme velo matztzil. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheeno siman tuma vannetek, hare hu siman tohora vannatek: 
Ketzad megallechin et hannetek. megalleach chutza lo umanniach shete searot samuch lo, kede sheyyehe nikkar im pasa. hechlito vesear tzahov, halach sear tzahov vechazar sear tzahov, vechen befisyon, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hu chemot shehaya. hechlito befisyon, vehalach happisyon vechazar happisyon. vechen besear tzahov, besof shavua rishon, besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, hare hu chemo shehaya: 
Shene netakim, ze vetzad ze, veshita shel sear mafseket benehem, nifratz mimmakom echad, tame. mishshene mekomot, tahor. kamma tehe happirtza, mekom shete searot. nifratz mimmakom echad kaggeris, tame:
Mishnah Negaim 10:7-10:
Shene netakin, ze lifnim mizze, veshita shel sear mafseket benehen, nifratz mimmakom echad, tame. mishshene mekomot, tahor. kamma tehe happirtza, mekom shete searot. nifratz mimmakom echad kaggeris, tahor: 
Mi shehaya vo netek uvo sear tzahov, tame. nolad lo sear shachor, tahor. af al pi shehalach lo sear shachor, tahor. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon, kol netek shettahar shaa achat, en lo tuma leolam. rabbi shimon omer, kol sear tzahov shettahar shaa achat, en lo tuma leolam: 
Mi shehaya vo netek kaggeris, venittak kol rosho, tahor. harosh vehazzakan en meakkevin ze et ze, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, meakkevin ze et ze. amar rabbi shimon, vedin hu, ma im or happanim veor habbasar, sheyyesh davar acher mafsik benehem, meakkevin ze et ze, harosh vehazzakan sheen davar acher mafsik benehem, eno din sheyyeakkevu ze et ze. harosh vehazzakan en mitztarfin ze im ze, veen posin mizze laze. eze hu zakan, min happerek shel lechi ad pikka shel gargaret: 
Hakkarachat vehaggabbachat mittammeot bishne shavuot, bishne simanim, bemichya uvefisyon. ezo hi karachat, achal neshem, sach neshem, makka sheenah reuya legaddel sear. ezo hi karachat, min hakkadkod hashshofea laachorav ad pikka shel tzavvar. ezo hi gabbachat, min hakkadkod hashshofea lefanav ad keneged sear milmalan. hakkarachat vehaggabbachat enan mitztarfot zo im zo, veenan posot mizzo lazo. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh sear benehen, enan mitztarfot. veim lav, hare ellu mitztarfot:
Mishnah Negaim 7:3-8:2:
Baheret veen bah kelum, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, yasgir. besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, yiftor. odehu masgiro ufoter venoldu lo simane tuma, yachlit. baheret uvah simane tuma, yachlit. odehu machlito vehalchu lahen simane tuma, battechilla, besof shavua rishon, yasgir. besof shavua sheni, leachar happetur, yiftor: 
Hattolesh simane tuma, vehakkove et hammichya, over belo taase. uletohora, ad shello va etzel hakkohen, tahor. leachar hechleto, tame. amar rabbi akiva, shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua holchin legadvad, betoch hesgero, ma hu. amru li, lo shamanu. aval shamanu, ad shello va etzel hakkohen, tahor, leachar hechleto, tame. hitchalti mevi lahem reayot. echad omed bifne hakkohen veechad betoch hesgero, tahor, ad sheyyetammeennu hakkohen. meematay hi tohorato, rabbi eliezer omer, lichsheyyivvaled lo nega acher veyithar mimmennu. vachachamim omrim, ad shettifrach bechullo, o ad shettitmaet bahareto mikkaggeris: 
Mi shehayta vo vaheret veniktzetza, tehora. ketzatzah mitkavven, rabbi eliezer omer, lichsheyyivvaled lo nega acher veyithar mimmennu. vachachamim omrim, ad shettifrach bechullo. hayta verosh haarla, yimmol: 
Happoreach min hattame, tahor. chazru vo rashe evarim, tame, ad shettitmaet bahareto mikkaggeris. min hattahor, tame. chazru vo rashe evarim, tame, ad shettachazor bahareto lichmot shehayta: 
Baheret kaggeris uvah michya chaadasha, parcha vechullo veachar kach halcha lah hammichya, o shehalcha lah hammichya veachar kach parcha vechullo, tahor. nolda lo michya, tame. nolad lo sear lavan, rabbi yehoshua metamme, vachachamim metaharin:
Mishnah Negaim 8:3-6:
Baheret uvah sear lavan, parcha vechullo, af al pi shessear lavan bimkomo, tahor. baheret uvah pisyon, parcha vechullo, tahor. vechullan shechazru vahen rashe evarim, hare ellu temein. parcha vemiktzato, tame. parcha vechullo, tahor: 
Kol perichat rashe evarim shebbifrichatan tiharu tame, kesheyyachzeru temeim. kol chazirat rashe evarim shebbachaziratam timmeu tahor, nitkassu, tahor. nitgallu, tame, afillu mea feamim: 
Kol harauy littamme venega habbaheret, meakkev et happericha. kol sheeno rauy littamme venega habbaheret, eno meakkev et happericha. ketzad. parcha vechullo, aval lo varosh uvazzakan, bashshechin, bammichva uvakkedach hammordin, chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach venaasu tzarevet, tehorim. parcha vechullo, aval lo vechachatzi adasha hassamuch larosh velazzakan, lashshechin, lammichva, velakkedach, chazar harosh vehazzakan venikrechu, hashshechin vehammichva vehakkedach venaasu tzarevet, af al pi shennaasa mekom hammichya baheret, tame, ad shettifrach bechullo: 
Shete veharot, achat temea veachat tehora, parcha mizzo lazo veachar kach parcha vechullo, tahor. bisfato haelyona, bisfato hattachtona, bishte etzbeotav, bishne rise enav, af al pi shemmedubbakim ze laze vehem nirim keechad, tahor. parcha vechullo, aval lo vabbohak, tame. chazru vo rashe evarim kemin bohak, tahor. chazru vo rashe evarim pachot mikkaadasha, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim omrim, bohak pachot mikkaadasha, siman tuma vattechilla, veen siman tuma vassof:
Mishnah Negaim 8:7-10:
Habba chullo lavan, yasgir. nolad lo sear lavan, yachlit. hishchiru shetehem o achat mehen, hiktziru shetehen o achat mehen, nismach hashshechin lishtehen o leachat mehen, hikkif hashshechin et shetehen o et achat mehen, o chillekan hashshechin umichyat hashshechin hammichva umichyat hammichva vehabbohak. nolad lo michya o sear lavan, tame. lo nolad lo lo michya velo sear lavan, tahor. vechullan shechazru vahen rashe evarim, hare ellu chemot shehayu. parcha vemiktzato, tame. parcha vechullo, hare hu tahor: 
Im bechullo farcha cheachat, mittoch hattohora, tame. umittoch hattuma, tahor. hattahor mittoch hesger, patur min happeria umin happerima umin hattiglachat umin hatztzipporim. mittoch hechlet, chayyav bechullan. ze vaze metammeim bevia: 
Habba chullo lavan uvo michya chaadasha, parcha vechullo veachar kach chazru vo rashe evarim, rabbi yishmael omer, kachazirat rashe evarim bevaheret gedola. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, kachazirat rashe evarim bevaheret ketanna: 
Yesh mare nigo lakkohen veniskar, veyesh mare umafsid. ketzad. mi shehaya muchlat, vehalchu lahen simane tuma, lo hispik lehareotah lakkohen ad shepparcha vechullo, tahor. sheillu hera lakkohen, haya tame. baheret veen bah kelum, lo hispik lehareotah lakkohen ad shepparcha vechullo, tame. sheillu hera lakkohen, haya tahor:
Mishnah Negaim 9:1-10:1:
Hashshechin vehammichva mittammein beshavua echad, bishne simanim, besear lavan uvefisyon. eze hu hashshechin. laka veetz o veeven o vegefet o veme teverya, kol sheeno mechamat haesh, ze hu shechin. ezo hi michva. nichva vegachelet o veremetz, kol shehu mechamat haesh, zo hi michva: 
Hashshechin vehammichva en mitztarfin ze im ze, veen posin mizze laze, veen posin leor habbasar, velo or habbasar pose letochan. hayu mordin, tehorin. asu kerum kiklippat hashshum, zo hi tzarevet hashshechin haamura vattora. chazru vechayu, af al pi shemmekoman tzalleket, niddonin keor habbasar: 
Shaalu et rabbi eliezer, mi shealta letoch yado baheret kassela umekomah tzarevet shechin. amar lahem, yasgir. amru lo, lamma, legaddel sear lavan enah reuya, ulefisyon enah posa, ulemichya enah mittamma. amar lahen, shemma tichnos vetifse. amru lo, vahalo mekomah kaggeris. amar lahen, lo shamati. amar lo rabbi yehuda ven betera, alammed bo. amar lo, im lekayyem divre chachamim, hen. amar lo, shemma yivvaled lo shechin acher chutza lo veyifse letocho. amar lo, chacham gadol atta shekkiyyamta divre chachamim: 
Hannetakim mittammein bishne shavuot, uvishne simanim, besear tzahov dak uvefisyon. besear tzahov dak, lakuy katzar, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, afillu aroch. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ma hallashon omrim, dak makkel ze, dak kane ze, dak lakuy katzar, o dak lakuy aroch. amar lo rabbi akiva, ad sheanu lemedim min hakkane, nilmad min hassear. dak searo shel peloni, dak lakuy katzar, lo dak lakuy aroch:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 10:4-11:1:
Anshe ir hanniddachat en lahen chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (sham 13) yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal mikkirbecha vayyaddichu et yshve iram. veenan neheragim ad sheyyihyu maddicheha meotah hair umeoto hashshevet, vead sheyyuddach rubbah, vead sheyyaddichum anashim. hiddichuha nashim uketannim o shehuddach miutah o shehayu maddicheha chutza lah, hare ellu chichidim. utzerichin shene edim vehateraa lechol echad veechad. ze chomer bayyechidim mibbammerubbim, shehayyechidim biskila, lefichach mamonam palet. vehammerubbim besayif, lefichach mamonam aved: 
Hakke takke et vegomer (Devarim 13). hachammeret vehaggammelet haoveret mimmakom lemakom, hare ellu matztzilin otah. hacharem otah veet kol asher bah veet behemtah lefi charev (sham), mikkan amru nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah ovdin, shebbechutza lah peletin. veshel reshaim, ben shebbetochah ben shebbechutza lah, hare ellu ovdin: 
Veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vegomer (Devarim 13). im en lah rechov, osin lah rechov. haya rechovah chutza lah, konsin oto letochah. vesarafta vaesh et hair veet kol shelalah kalil laAdonai elohecha (sham). shelalah, velo shelal shamayim. mikkan amru, hahekdeshot shebbah yippadu, uterumot yerakvu, maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganezu. kalil laAdonai elohecha, amar rabbi shimon, amar hakkadosh baruch hu, im attem osim din beir hanniddachat, maale ani alechem keillu attem maalin ola chalil lefanay. vehayta tel olam lo tibbane od (Devarim 13), lo tease afillu gannot ufardesim, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer, lo tibbane od, lichmo shehayta enah nivnet, aval naaset hi gannot ufardesim. velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem (sham), shekkol zeman sheharshaim baolam, charon af baolam. avdu reshaim min haolam, nistallek charon af min haolam: 
Ellu hen hannechenakin, hammakke aviv veimmo, vegonev nefesh miyyisrael, vezaken mamre al pi vet din, unevi hashsheker, vehammitnabbe beshem avoda zara, vehabba al eshet ish, vezomme vat kohen uvoalah. hammakke aviv veimmo eno chayyav ad sheyyaase vahen chabbura. ze chomer bamkallel mibbammakke, shehamekallel leachar mita chayyav, vehammakke leachar mita patur. haggonev nefesh miyyisrael eno chayyav ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto veyishtammesh bo, shenneemar (Devarim kad) vehitammer bo umecharo. haggonev et beno, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. ganav mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ven chorin, rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:2-6:
Zaken mamre al pi vet din, shenneemar (sham 17) ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat vegomer. shelosha vatte dinin hayu sham, echad yoshev al petach har habbayit, veechad yoshev al petach haazara, veechad yoshev belishkat haggazit. baim laze sheal petach har habbayit, veomer, kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray, kach limmadti vechach limmedu chaveray. im shamu, omrim lahem. veim lav, bain lahem leotan sheal petach haazara, veomer, kach darashti vechach darshu chaveray, kach limmadti vechach limmedu chaveray. im shamu, omrim lahem. veim lav, ellu vaellu baim levet din haggadol shebbelishkat haggazit, shemmimmennu yotzet tora lechol yisrael, shenneemar (sham) min hammakom hahu asher yivchar Adonai. chazar leiro veshana velimmed kederech shehaya lamed, patur. veim hora laasot, chayyav, shenneemar (sham) vehaish asher yaase vezadon, eno chayyav ad sheyyore laasot. talmid shehora laasot, patur, nimtza chumro kullo: 
Chomer bedivre sofrim mibbedivre tora, haomer en tefillin, kede laavor al divre tora, patur. chamishsha totafot, lehosif al divre sofrim, chayyav: 
En memitin oto lo vevet din shebbeiro velo vevet din shebbeyavne, ella maalin oto levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim, umeshammerin oto ad haregel umemitin oto varegel, shenneemar (Devarim 17) vechol haam yishmeu veyirau velo yezidun od, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yehuda omer, en meannin et dino shel ze, ella memitin oto miyyad, vechotvin vesholchin sheluchim bechol hammekomot, ish peloni ben ish peloni nitchayyev mita bevet din: 
Nevi hashsheker hammitnabbe al ma shello shama uma shello neemar lo, mitato vide adam. aval hakkovesh et nevuato, vehamevatter al divre navi, venavi sheavar al divre atzmo, mitato vide shamayim, shenneemar (sham 18) anochi edrosh meimmo: 
Hammitnabbe veshem avoda zara veomer, kach amra avoda zara, afillu chivven et hahalacha, letamme et hattame uletaher et hattahor. habba al eshet ish, kevan shennichnesa lirshut habbaal lannissuin af al pi shello nivala, habba aleha hare ze vechenek. vezomme vat kohen uvoalah, shekkol hazzommin makdimin leotah mita, chutz mizzomme vat kohen uvoalah:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:11-8:3:
Hamechashshef haose maase chayyav, velo haochez et haenayim. rabbi akiva omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, shenayim loktin kishshuin, echad loket patur veechad loket chayyav, haose maase chayyav, haochez et haenayim patur:  
Ben sorer umore, meematay naase ven sorer umore, mishsheyyavi shete searot vead sheyyakkif zakan, hattachton velo haelyon, ella sheddibberu chachamim belashon nekiyya, shenneemar (Devarim 21), ki yihye leish ben, ben velo vat, ben velo ish. hakkatan patur, shello va lichlal mitzvot: 
Meematay chayyav, mishsheyyochal tartemar basar veyishte chatzi log yayin haitalki. rabbi yose omer, mane basar velog yayin. achal bachavurat mitzva, achal beibbur hachodesh, achal maaser sheni birushalayim, achal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim, achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, achal davar shehu mitzva vedavar shehu avera, achal kol maachol velo achal basar, shata chol mashke velo shata yayin, eno naase ven sorer umore, ad sheyyochal basar veyishte yayin, shenneemar (Devarim 21) zolel vesove. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar (Mishlei 23) al tehi vesove yayin bezolle vasar lamo: 
Ganav mishshel aviv veachal birshut aviv, mishshel acherim veachal birshut acherim, mishshel acherim veachal birshut aviv, eno naase ven sorer umore, ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv veyochal birshut acherim. rabbi yose var rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv umishshel immo:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:4-9:1:
Haya aviv rotze veimmo enah rotza, aviv eno rotze veimmo rotza, eno naase ven sorer umore, ad sheyyehu shenehem rotzim. rabbi yehuda omer, im lo hayta immo reuya leaviv, eno naase ven sorer umore. haya echad mehem giddem o chigger o illem o suma o cheresh, eno naase ven sorer umore, shenneemar (Devarim 21) vetafsu vo aviv veimmo, velo giddemin. vehotziu oto, velo chiggerin. veamru, velo illemin. benenu ze, velo sumin. enennu shomea bekolenu, velo chershin. matrin bo bifne shelosha umalkin oto. chazar vekilkel, niddon beesrim ushelosha. veeno niskal ad sheyyehu sham shelosha harishonim, shenneemar (sham) benenu ze, zehu shellaka bifnechem. barach ad shello nigmar dino veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton, patur. veim mishshennigmar dino barach veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton, chayyav: 
Ben sorer umore niddon al shem sofo, yamut zakkay veal yamut chayyav, shemmitatan shel reshaim hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam, velatztzaddikim, ra lahen vera laolam. yayin veshena larshaim, hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam, velatztzaddikim, ra lahen vera laolam. pizzur larshaim, hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam, velatztzaddikim, ra lahen vera laolam. kinnus larshaim, ra lahen vera laolam, velatztzaddikim, hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam. sheket larshaim, ra lahen vera laolam, velatztzaddikim, hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam: 
Habba vammachteret niddon al shem sofo. haya va vammachteret veshavar et hechavit, im yesh lo damim, chayyav. im en lo damim, patur: 
Veellu hen shemmatztzilin otan benafshan, harodef achar chavero lehargo, achar hazzechur veachar hannaara hameorasa. aval harodef achar behema, vehamechallel et hashshabbat, vehaoved avoda zara, en matztzilin otan benafshan: 
Veellu hen hannisrafin, habba al ishsha uvittah, uvat kohen shezzinneta. yesh bichlal ishsha uvittah, bitto, uvat bitto, uvat beno, uvat ishto, uvat bittah, uvat benah, chamoto, veem chamoto, veem chamiv. veellu hen hanneheragim, harotzeach veanshe ir hanniddachat. rotzeach shehikka et reehu veeven o vevarzel, vechavash alav letoch hammayim o letoch haur veeno yachol laalot mishsham, vamet, chayyav. dechafo letoch hammayim o letoch haur veyachol laalot mishsham, vamet, patur. shissa vo et hakkelev, shissa vo et hannachash, patur. hishshich bo et hannachash, rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrin. hammakke et chavero ben beeven ben beegrof vaamaduhu lemita, vehekel mimma shehaya uleachar mikkan hichbid vamet, chayyav. rabbi nechemya omer, patur, sheraglayim laddavar:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:2-5:
Nitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam, lannachri veharag et yisrael, linfalim, veharag ben keyama, patur. nitkavven lehakkoto al matnav velo haya vah kede lehamit al matnav vehalcha lah al libbo vehaya vah kede lehamit al libbo, vamet, patur. nitkavven lehakkoto al libbo vehaya vah kede lehamit al libbo vehalcha lah al matnav velo haya vah kede lehamit al matnav, vamet, patur. nitkavven lehakkot et haggadol velo haya vah kede lehamit haggadol vehalcha lah al hakkatan vehaya vah kede lehamit et hakkatan, vamet, patur. nitkavven lehakkot et hakkatan vehaya vah kede lehamit et hakkatan vehalcha lah al haggadol velo haya vah kede lehamit et haggadol, vamet, patur. aval nitkavven lehakkot al matnav vehaya vah kede lehamit al matnav vehalcha lah al libbo, vamet, chayyav. nitkavven lehakkot et haggadol vehaya vah kede lehamit et haggadol vehalcha lah al hakkatan, vamet, chayyav. rabbi shimon omer, afillu nitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze, patur: 
Rotzeach shennitarev baacherim, kullan peturin. rabbi yehuda omer, konsin otan lechippa. kol chayyave mitot shennitarvu ze vaze, niddonin bakkalla. hanniskalin bannisrafin, rabbi shimon omer, niddonin biskila, shehasserefa chamura. vachachamim omrim, niddonin bisrefa, shehassekila chamura. amar lahen rabbi shimon, illu lo hayta serefa chamura, lo nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. amru lo, illu lo hayta sekila chamura, lo nittena lamgaddef velaoved avoda zara. hanneheragin bannechenakin, rabbi shimon omer, besayif. vachachamim omrim, bechenek: 
Mi shennitchayyev bishte mitot bet din, niddon bachamura. avar avera shennitchayyev bah shete mitot, niddon bachamura. rabbi yose omer, niddon bazikka harishona shebbaa alav: 
Mi shellaka veshana, bet din machnisim oto lechippa umaachilin oto seorin ad shekkereso mitbakkaat. hahoreg nefesh shello veedim, machnisin oto lechippa umaachilin oto lechem tzar umayim lachatz:
Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:6-10:3:
Haggonev et hakkasva vehamekallel bakkosem vehabboel arammit, kannain pogin bo. kohen sheshshimmesh betuma, en echav hakkohanim meviin oto levet din, ella firche chehunna motziin oto chutz laazara umaftziin et mocho bigzirin. zar sheshshimmesh bammikdash, rabbi akiva omer, bechenek. vachachamim omrim, bide shamayim: 
Kol yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (yeshaya 60) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. veellu sheen lahem chelek laolam habba, haomer en techiyyat hammetim min hattora, veen tora min hashshamayim, veeppikores. rabbi akiva omer, af hakkore vassefarim hachitzonim, vehallochesh al hammakka veomer (Shemot 15) kol hammachala asher samti vemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha. abba shaul omer, af hahoge et hashshem beotiyyotav: 
Shelosha melachim vearbaa hedyotot en lahem chelek laolam habba. shelosha melachim, yaravam, achav, umenashshe. rabbi yehuda omer, menashshe yesh lo chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (divre hayamim b log) vayyitpallel elav vayyeater lo vayyishma techinnato vayshivehu yerushalayim lemalchuto. amru lo, lemalchuto heshivo velo lechayye haolam habba heshivo. arbaa hedyotot, bilam, vedoeg, vaachitofel, vegechazi: 
Dor hammabbul en lahem chelek laolam habba veen omdin baddin, shenneemar (Bereshit 6) lo yadon ruchi vaadam leolam, lo din velo ruach. dor happallaga en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (Bereshit 11) vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham al pene chol haaretz. vayyafetz Adonai otam, baolam hazze. umishsham hefitzam Adonai, laolam habba. anshe sedom en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar (sham 13) veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod. raim baolam hazze. vechattaim, laolam habba. aval omdin baddin. rabbi nechemya omer, ellu vaellu en omdin baddin, shenneemar (tehillim 1) al ken lo yakumu reshaim bammishpat vechattaim baadat tzaddikim. al ken lo yakumu reshaim bammishpat, ze dor hammabbul. vechattaim baadat tzaddikim, ellu anshe sedom. amru lo, enam omdim baadat tzaddikim aval omdin baadat reshaim. meraggelim en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa bammaggefa lifne Adonai (Bamidbar 14). vayyamutu, baolam hazze. bammaggefa, baolam habba. dor hammidbar en lahem chelek laolam habba veen omdin baddin, shenneemar (sham) bammidbar hazze yittammu vesham yamutu, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, alehem hu omer (tehillim 50) isfu li chasiday korte veriti ale zavach. adat korach enah atida laalot, shenneemar (Bamidbar 16) vattechas alehem haaretz, baolam hazze, vayyovdu mittoch hakkahal, laolam habba, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, alehem hu omer (Shmuel 1 b) Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal. aseret hashshevatim enan atidin lachazor, shenneemar (Devarim 29) vayyashlichem el eretz acheret kayyom hazze, ma hayyom hazze holech veeno chozer, af hem holchim veenam chozrim, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, kayyom hazze, ma hayyom maafil umeir, af aseret hashshevatim sheafal lahen, kach atid lehair lahen:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Shemona devarim tzarich hammitpallel lehizzaher bahen velaasotan. veim haya dachuk o neenas o sheavar velo asa otan en meakkevin. veellu hen. amida. venochach hammikdash. vetikkun hagguf. vetikkun hammalbushim. vetikkun hammakom. vehashevayat hakkol. vehakkeria. vehishtachavaya:

Amida ketzad. en mitpallel ella meummad. haya yoshev bisfina o baagala im yachol laamod yaamod. veim lav yeshev bimkomo veyitpallel. chole mitpallel afillu shochev al tziddo vehu sheyyachol lechavven et dato. vechen hatztzame veharaev hare hen bichlal cholim im yesh bo yecholet lechavven et dato yitpallel veim lav al yitpallel ad sheyyochal veyishte. haya rochev al habbehema af al pi sheyyesh lo mi sheyyochaz behemto lo yered ella yeshev bimkomo veyitpallel kede shettehe dato meyushshevet alav:

Nochach hammikdash ketzad. haya omed bechutza laaretz machazir panav nochach eretz yisrael umitpallel. haya omed baaretz mechavven et panav keneged yerushalayim. haya omed birushalayim mechavven panav keneged hammikdash. haya omed bammikdash mechavven panav keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim. suma umi shello yachol lechavven et haruchot vehamehallech bisfina yechavven et libbo keneged hashshechina veyitpallel:

Keria ketzad. hammitpallel korea chamesh keriot bechol tefilla utefilla. bivracha rishona battechilla uvassof. uvehodaya battechilla uvassof. uchesheggomer hattefilla korea ufosea shalosh pesiot laachorav. ucheshehu korea noten shalom missemol atzmo veachar kach mimin atzmo veachar kach magbiah rosho min hakkeria. ucheshehu korea bearba hakkeriot korea bevaruch ucheshehu zokef zokef bashshem. bamme devarim amurim behedyot. aval kohen gadol korea bitchillat kol beracha uvesof kol beracha. vehammelech kevan sheshshacha barishona eno magbiah rosho ad sheggomer kol tefillato:

Velamma noten shalom lismolo techilla. mippene shessemolo hu yamin shekkeneged panav. kelomar keshehu omed lifne hammelech noten shalom limin hammelech veachar kach lismol hammelech. vekavu sheyyippater min hattefilla kemo shenniftarin millifne hammelech:
Kol hakkeriot haellu tzarich sheyyichra bahen ad sheyyitpakkeku kol chulyot shebbashshidra veyaase atzmo kekeshet. veim shacha meat vetzier atzmo venire kechorea bechol kocho eno choshesh:

Hishtachavaya ketzad. achar shemmagbiah rosho mikkeria chamishit yeshev laaretz venofel al panav artza umitchannen bechol hattachanunim sheyyirtze. keria haamura bechol makom al birkayim. kida al appayim. hishtachavaya ze pishshut yadayim veraglayim ad shennimtza muttal al panav artza:

Keshehu ose nefilat panim achar tefilla yesh mi shehu ose kida veyesh mi shehu ose hishtachavaya. veasur laasot hishtachavaya al haavanim ella bammikdash kemo shebbearnu behilchot avodat kochavim. veen adam chashuv rashshay lippol al panav ella im ken hu yodea beatzmo shehu tzaddik kihoshua. aval matte panav meat veeno kovesh otan bakkarka. umuttar leadam lehitpallel bemakom ze velippol al panav bemakom acher:

Minhag pashut bechol yisrael sheen nefilat appayim beshabbatot uvemoadim velo berosh hashshana velo berashe chodashim uvachanukka uvefurim velo bemincha shel arve shabbatot veyamim tovim velo bearvit shebbechol yom. veyesh yechidim shennoflim al penehem bearvit. uveyom hakkippurim bilvad noflim al penehem bechol tefilla utefilla mippene shehu yom techinna uvakkasha vetaanit:

Tikkun hagguf ketzad. keshehu omed bitfilla tzarich lechavven et raglav zo betzad zo venoten enav lematta keillu hu mabbit laaretz. veyihye libbo panuy lemala keillu hu omed bashshamayim umanniach yadav al libbo kefutin hayemanit al hassemalit veomed keeved lifne rabbo beema beyira vafachad. velo yanniach yadav al chalatzav:

Tikkun hammalbushim ketzad. metakken malbushav techilla umetzayyen atzmo umehadder shenneemar hishtachavu laAdonai behaderat kodesh. velo yaamod bitfilla baafunedato, velo berosh megulle, velo beraglayim megullot im derech anshe hammakom shello yaamdu bifne haggedolim ella bevatte haraglayim. uvechol makom lo yeechoz tefillin beyado vesefer tora bizroo veyitpallel mippene shellibbo tarud bahen. velo yeechoz kelim umaot beyado. aval mitpallel hu velulav beyado bimot hechag mippene shehu mitzvat hayyom. haya massoy al rosho vehiggia zeman tefilla im haya pachot mearbaa kabbin mafshilo laachorav umitpallel bo. haya arbaa kabbin mannicho al gabbe karka veachar kach yitpallel. derech kol hachachamim vetalmidehem shello yitpallelu ella keshehen atufim:

Tikkun hammakom ketzad. yaamod bemakom namuch veyachazir panav lakkotel. vetzarich liftoach challonot o petachim keneged yerushalayim kede lehitpallel kenegdan shenneemar <small>(Daniel 6 11)</small> "vechavvin petichan le beillite" vegomer. vekovea makom litfillato tamid. veen mitpallel bechurba velo achore bet hakkeneset ella im ken hechezir panav levet hakkeneset. veasur leshev betzad haomed bitfilla o laavor lefanav ad sheyyarchik mimmennu arba ammot:

Lo yaamod bemakom gavoah shelosha tefachim o yoter veyitpallel. velo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe safsal velo al gabbe kisse. haya binyan gavoah im yesh bo arba ammot al arba ammot shehu shiur habbayit hare hu kaaliyya umuttar lehitpallel bo. vechen im haya mukkaf mechitztzot mikkol ruchotav af al pi sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot muttar lehitpallel bo mippene sheen gavho nikkar shehare chalak reshut leatzmo:

Haummanin shehayu osin melacha berosh hailan o berosh hannidbach o berosh hakkotel vehiggia zeman tefilla yordin lematta umitpallelin vechozrin limlachtan. veim hayu berosh hazzayit o berosh hatteena mitpallelin bimkoman mippene shettarchan merubbe. uma hen mitpallelin. im hayu osin bisuddatan bilvad mitpallelin shalosh tefillot shel tisha asar berachot. hayu osin bischaran mitpallelin havinenu. uven kach uven kach en yordin lifne hatteva veen nosin et kappehen:

Hashevayat hakkol ketzad. lo yagbiah kolo bitfillato velo yitpallel belibbo ella mechattech haddevarim bisfatav umashmia leaznav belachash. velo yashmia kolo ella im ken haya chole o sheeno yachol lechavven et libbo ad sheyyashmia kolo, hare ze muttar. uvilvad shello yehe betzibbur kede shello tittaref datan mikkolo:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8:13-14:
Vehabborer pesolet mittoch haochel vaafillu beyado achat chayyav. vehabborer turmosin mittoch pesolet shellahen chayyav mippene shehappesolet shellahen mematteket otan kesheyyishleku otan immahem venimtza kevorer pesolet mittoch ochel vechayyav. habborer ochel mittoch pesolet beyado lehannicho afillu levo bayyom naasa kevorer laotzar vechayyav. hayu lefanav shene mine ochalin meoravin borer echad meacher umanniach leechol miyyad. veim berer vehinniach leachar zeman afillu levo bayyom kegon shebberer beshacharit leechol ben haarbayim chayyav: 
Hmshammer yayin o shemen o mayim vechen shear hammashkin bammeshammeret shellahen chayyav. vehu sheyyeshammer kigrogeret. aval mesannenin yayin sheen bo shemarim o mayim tzelulin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit kede sheyyehe tzalul beyoter. venotnin mayim al gabbe shemarim bishvil sheyyitztzolu. venotnin betza terufa limsannenet shel chardal kede sheyyitztzalel. chardal shellasho meerev shabbat. lemachar memache veshote ben bayyad ben bichli. vechen yayin miggitto kol zeman shehu toses toref chavit bishmareha venoten letoch hassudarin. sheadayin lo nifreshu hashshemarim min hayyayin yafe yafe vechol hayyayin keguf echad hu. vechen hachardal vechol kayyotze bo:
Niddah 20b:20-22: Rabbi raa dam ballayla vetimme, raa bayyom vetiher, himtin shaa achat chazar vetimme, amar: oy li shemma taiti!
Shemma taiti? vadday taa! detanya: lo yomar chacham "illu haya lach — haya vadday tame".

Ella (amar): en lo laddayyayn ella ma sheenav root. meikkara achzekeh betame, kevan dachaza letzafra deishtanni amar (leh): vadday tahor hava, uvallayla hu dela itchazi shappir. kevan dachaza dahadar ishtanni amar: hay tame hu, umifkach hu deka (mapekach) [fachach] veazel.
Proverbs 29:15-18: Shevet vetochachat yitten chochma venaar meshullach mevish immo
Birvot reshaim yirbe-pasha vetzaddikim bemappaltam yiru
Yasser bincha vinichecha veyitten maadannim lenafshecha {p}

Proverbs 29:19-23: Bidvarim lo-yivvaser aved ki-yavin veen maane
Chazita ish atz bidvarav tikva lichsil mimmennu

Proverbs 29:24-30:2: Cholek im-gannav sone nafsho ala yishma velo yaggid

Proverbs 29:9-14: Ish-chacham nishpat et-ish evil veragaz vesachak veen nachat
Anshe damim yisneu-tam visharim yevakshu nafsho
Kol-rucho yotzi chesil vechacham beachor yeshabbechenna
Rash veish techachim nifgashu meirene shenehem Adonai

Proverbs 30:3-7: Mi ala-shamayim ׀ vayyerad mi asaf-ruach ׀ bechofnav mi tzarar-mayim ׀ bassimla mi hekim kol-afse-aretz ma-shemo uma-shem-beno ki teda
Kol-imrat eloah tzerufa magen hu lachosim bo
Al-tosp al-devarav pen-yochiach becha venichzavta {p}
Shetayim shaalti meittach al-timna mimmenni beterem amut
Sanhedrin 24a:12-18: Amar rabbi oshaya: may dichtiv "vaekkach li et shene maklot leachad karati noam uleachad karati chovlim"? "noam" – ellu talmide chachamim shebbeeretz yisrael, shemmanimin ze laze bahalacha. "chovlim" – ellu talmide chachamim shebbevavel, shemmechabbelim ze laze bahalacha.

"Vayyomer elay elle [shene] vene hayyitzhar haomdim vegomer ushenayim zetim aleha". "yitzhar" – amar rabbi yitzchak: ellu talmide chachamim shebbeeretz yisrael, shennochin ze laze bahalacha keshemen zayit. "ushenayim zetim aleha" – ellu talmide chachamim shebbevavel, shemmerorin ze laze bahalacha kezayit.

"Vaessa enay vaere vehinne shetayim nashim yotzot veruach bechanfehem velahenna chenafayim kechanfe hachasida vattissena haefa ben hashshamayim uven haaretz. vaomar el hammalach haddover bi ana hemma molichot et haefa. vayyomer elay livnot la vayit beeretz shinar". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: zo chanuppa vegassut haruach sheyyardu levavel.
Vegassut haruach levavel nechit? vehaamar mar: asara kabbin gassut yardu leolam, tisha natla elam veachat kol haolam kullo!
In, levavel nechit, veishtarbove [hu] deishtarbav leelam. dayka name, dichtiv: "livnot la vayit beeretz shinar". shema minna.

Vehaamar mar: siman legassut haruach – aniyyut, vaaniyyut levavel nechit! may aniyyut? aniyyut tora, dichtiv: "achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah". amar rabbi yochanan: zo elam, shezzachta lilmod velo zachta lelammed.
May bavel? amar rabbi yochanan: belula bammikra, belula bammishna, belula battalmud. "bemachashakkim hoshivani kemete olam" – amar rabbi yirmeya: ze talmudah shel bavel.
Zohar, Bechukotai 10: Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar (Shir hashshirim 2:9) dome dodi litzvi o leofer haayyalim hinne ze vegomer. zakkain innun yisrael, dezachu demashkona da lemehevi gabbayyhu, min malka illaa. deaf al gav deinnun begaluta, kudesha berich hu ate bechol resh yarche veshabbatte uzemane, leashgecha alayyhu, uleistakkela behahu mashkona deit leh gabbayyhu, deihu kissufa dileh.

Lemalka desarcha matronita, afkah mehechaleh. ma avdat. natlat berah dileh kissufa demalka, rechima dileh. uvegin dedata demalka alah, shavkeh bidaha. beshaata desalik reuta demalka, al matronita, veal bere, hava salik agrin, venachit dargin, vesalik kotalin, leistakkela uleashgacha ben nukeve kotala alayyhu, kevan dechame lon, share bache meachore kusete kotala, ulevatar azil leh.

Kach yisrael, af al gav deinnun nafku mehechaleh demalka, hahu mashkona la shavku, uvegin diruta demalka alayyhu, shavkeh immehon. beshaata desalik reuta demalka kaddisha, al matronita veal yisrael. salik agrin (mekappetz al haggevaot), nachit dargin, vesalik kotalin, leistakkela uleashgacha ben kusete kotala alayyhu. kevan dechame lon, share uvache, hada hu dichtiv dome dodi litzvi o leofer haayyalim ledallega mikkotala leigra, umeigra lechotala. hinne ze omed achar katlenu, bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot mashgiach min hachallonot, (devadday bi kenishta bayay challonot). metzitz min hacharakkim, leistakkela uleashgacha alayyhu. uvegin kach, yisrael bau lemechde behahu yoma, deinhu yade da, veamre. (Tehillim 118:24) ze hayyom asa Adonai nagila venismecha bo.

(Vayikra 26:15) veim bechukkotay timasu vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Mishlei 3:11) musar Adonai beni al timas veal takotz betochachto. kama chavivin yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, dekudesha berich hu bae leochacha lehu, uledabbera lehu beorach meshar, keabba derachim livreh, umiggo rechimu dileh legabbeh, sharvita bideh tadir, ledabbera leh beorach meshar, dela yiste limina velismala. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:12) ki et asher yeehav Adonai yochiach ucheav et ben yirtze. uman dela rachim leh kudesha berich hu, vesane leh, salik minneh tochacha, salik minneh sharvita.

Ketiv. (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai vegomer, miggo rechimuta dileh, sharvita bideh tadir, ledabbera leh. veet esav saneti, begin kach selikit minneh sharvita, selikat minneh tochachta, begin dela etten leh bi chulaka, rechika denafshay hu. aval attun, ahavti etchem vadday. uvegin kach, musar Adonai beni al timas veal takotz betochachto. may veal takotz. la tekutzun beh, keman dearak miggo guvin, deinnun millin kegovin legabbeh begarmeh.
Zohar, Bechukotai 14: Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havo azle bearcha, arau behahi mearta bechakla. amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi yose, hay dichtiv, (Devarim 28:69) elle divre habberit vegomer, millevad habberit. may divre habberit. divre gevura (sefer acher haelle) mibbae leh. amar leh ha ukemuha, hallalu mippi haggevura, vehallalu mippi atzmo shel moshe, veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, illen veillen divre habberit havo, deaf al gav demippi haggevura havo millin. mile berit havo, deha tav uvish beh talyayn. tav deate mitzaddik. bish deate min dina. dina, meatar dedina, vehayeynu tzedek. vetzaddik vetzedek berit innun, berit ikrun. veal da, millin illen, mile berit innun. vekashir berit kachada. uvegine kach zachor veshamor, kashir kachada. zachor beyom, shamor ballayla. ha berit kachada, uvegin kach berit vadday, divre habberit ninhu. uvechol atar berit baatar da ihu.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday hachi hu, uvegin kach shabbat deihu zachor veshamor, ikre berit. dichtiv, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat laasot et hashshabbat ledorotam berit olam. vecholla milla chad, vaatar da, ikre berit bechol atar.

Ta chaze, ketiv venatatti shalom baaretz, hu yesod, deihu shelama deara, shelama deveta, shelama dealma. veyissarti etchem af ani sheva. may 7. da tzedek. ha vadday berit, uvegin kach divre habberit ninhu.
Zohar, Bechukotai 16: Patach veamar, (Malachi 1:6) ben yechabbed av veeved adonav. ben yechabbed av, kema deat amer (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha, veokmuha, bemechla umishteyay uvecholla. hay bechayyyoy deitchayyayv beh. batar demit, i tema ha patur minneh hu, lav hache. deaf al gav demit, itchayyayv bikareh yattir, dichtiv kabbed et avicha. dei hahu bera azil beorach tekala, vadday mevazze laavuy hu, vadday avid leh kelana. vei hahu bera azil beorach meshar, vetakin ovadoy, vadday da okir laavuy, okir leh behay alma gabbe bene nasha, okir leh behahu alma, gabbe kudesha berich hu. vekudesha berich hu chayis aleh, veotiv leh bechuresyay dikareh. vadday ben yechabbed av.

Kegon ribbi elazar, deihu okir leh laavuy behay alma, uvehahu alma hasheta asge shevacha derabbi shimon bitren almin, behay alma, uvehahu alma yattir mechayyyoy. dezacha livnin kaddishin, ulegizin kaddishin. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dezakkan livnin kaddishin, legizin kaddishin. alayyhu itkere, (Yeshayahu 61:9) kol roehem yakkirum ki hem zera berach Adonai amen. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
Zohar, Bechukotai 6: Ta chaze, ha ukemuha hachi hu, demiskena achid beh bedina, vechol mechlayyhu bedina hu, atar deikre tzedek, kema deat amer (tehillim 22) tefilla leani chi yaatof. tefilla, da tefilla shel yad, veokimna. uman deyahiv leh tzedaka lemiskena, hu avid leella shema kaddisha shelim kedka yaut. begin ditzdaka da ilana dechayye, utzedaka yahiv letzedek. vechad yahiv letzedek, keden itchabbar da beda, ushema kaddisha ishtechach shelim. man avid da ittearuta (davar acher deavid itaruta da) diltatta, vadday keillu avid shema kaddisha bishlimu. kegavvna deihu avid letatta, hachi ittear leella. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 106:3) ashre shomre mishpat ose tzedaka bechol et. ose tzedaka, da kudesha berich hu, kivyachol hu avid leh.
Ta chaze, miskena ha ittemar man hu atreh. may tama. begin demiskena la it leh midileh kelum, ella ma deyahavin leh vesihara la it lah nehora midilah, ella ma deyahiv lah shimsha.

Ta chaze, amay ani chashuv kammet, may tama. begin dehahu atar garim leh, deha baatar demota hu shechiach, uvegin kach ikre met. hahu dechayis aleh, hu yahiv leh tzedaka, ilana dechayye sharya aloy. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 10:2) utzedaka tatztzil mimmavt. uchegavvna deavid bar nash letatta, hachi name avid leella mammash. zakkaa chulakeh dezache lemebad shema kaddisha leella, begin kach tzedaka salik al kolla.

Vehane mile, tzedaka lishmah. deha ittear tzedaka letzedek, lechabbera lon kachada, ulemehevi kolla shema kaddisha kedka yaut. deha tzedek, la ittakkan, vela ishtelim, ella bitzdaka. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:14) bitzdaka tikkonani, velichneset yisrael ittemar, uvegin kach vaasitem otam vegomer.
Zohar, Bechukotai 7: (Vayikra 26:6) venatatti shalom baaretz ushechavtem veen macharid vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 4:Adonai) rigzu veal techetau vegomer. rigzu veal techotau, hay kera ukemuha, devae bar nash leargaza yetzer tov al yetzer hara, veshappir. aval beshaata deramash lelya, uvar nash shachiv al arseh, kama gardine nimusin mitarin bealma, veazlin veshatin, uvene nasha baan leitraggeza mikkame kudesha berich hu, uledachala minneh, begin dela yishtekach nafsheh begavvayyhu, veyishteziv minnayyhu. veyive leh lebar nash, dela yappik minnayyhu milla befumeh. begin dela yittear lehu legabbeh, vela yishtakkechun bahaddeh. hada hu dichtiv imru vilvavchem al mishkavchem vedommu sela. dela yappik minnayyhu milla mippumeh.

Ta chaze, beshaata deishtechachu yisrael zakkain kamme kudesha berich hu, ma ketiv, venatatti shalom baaretz. hay leella. deate kudesha berich hu leitchabbera bichneset yisrael. keden ushechavtem veen macharid. may tama. begin vehishbatti chayya raa min haaretz. da chayya dezina bisha letatta. umay ihi. agrat bat machalat, hi, vechol siata dilah. hay belelya. bimama, bene nasha deatu missitraha da, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:6) vecherev lo taavor beartzechem.

Ribbi abba amar, ha ukemuha deafillu cherev shel shalom, kegon paro necho. aval vecherev lo taavor, da siata dilah. vehishbatti chayya raa, dela tishlot beara, vaafillu haavara bealma lo taavor alayychu, vaafillu cherev dishar ammin, vaafillu bar nash mizyayna, la yaavor alayychu.

Veda darish yoshiyyahu malka, veokmuha dehu atpas bechovayyhu deyisrael. kema dichtiv, (Eicha 4:20) ruach appenu meshiach Adonai nilkad bishchitotam vegomer. hacha it leistakkela, deha tanenan i resha deamma hu tav, kol amma mishtezvan begineh. vei resha deamma la itkeshar, kol amma ittafsan bechoveh. veha yoshiyyahu resha dechashra hava, veovadoy mitkashsheran. amay itpas bechovehon deyisrael.

Ella al dela hayyemin beh beyirmiyahu, vela kafit lehu leyisrael, dechashiv dechullehu zakkain kevavteh. vahava amar leh yirmiyya, vela hayyemin beh. uvegin kach itpas bechovehon. veod desihara hava maich nehora, uvaya leastema.
Zohar, Terumah 20: Veda ihu (Tehillim 98:1) mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash. tushebachta da ha (Bereshit 123 amud bet) okimna. aval af al gav deittearna beh, attearu dechavrayyay deka ittearu, shappir ihu, dehanhu parot alot kad havo natle arona, ittearu behay tushebachta, kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 6:12) vayyishsharna happarot badderech. uma shira havo amre. (Tehillim 98:1) mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash ki niflaot asa. raza da ihu kegavvna dilella. beshaata deinnun chayyot natle (arona) kurseyay, learama leh leella, innun amre tushebachta da.

Vei tema, amay ketiv hacha chadash, veha tadir kaamre tushebachta da. ella vadday chadash ihu, vechadash la ikre, ella beittechadtuta desihara, kad itnehirat min shimsha, keden ihu chadash, veda ihu shir chadash. hoshia lo yemino uzeroa kadsho, ha ittearuta dimina usemala lekabbela lah.

Vetushebachta da, kad natle arona, ka meshabbechan lah. kad sallekin levet shemesh. kegavvna daagalot sallekin levet shemesh. vecholla beraza chad salkin, begin divshabbat ihu seliku dechuresyyay, lesalleka leella. tikkuna detushebachta da beshabbat illen tushebchan kullehu atkinu beshabbat, leshabbecha leh amma yechida bealma.

rashi: Matte lechem. leshon mishan, kemo matte oz (Yirmeyahu 48):
Beshivri lachem matte lechem. eshbor lachem kol misad ochel, vehem chitztze raav (Yechezkel Adonai):
Veafu eser nashim lachmechem betannur echad. mechoser etzim (sifra):
Veheshivu lachmechem bammishkal. shettehe hattevua nirkevet venaaset pat nefolet, umishtabberet battannur, vehen yoshvot veshoklot et hashshevarim lechallekam benehem (sham):

Vaachaltem velo tisbau. zehu meera betoch hammeayim ballechem, hare sheva puranuyyot: cherev, matzor, dever, shever matte lechem, choser etzim, pat nefolet, meera vammeayim; venittattem enah min hamminyan, hi hacherev:
Ish chacham nishpat. mitvakkeach im haevil:

Veen nachat. ben mare lo panim zeufot ben shemmarehu panim sochakot, en nachat lo vazo velo vazo, eno motze korat ruach. matzinu vaamatzya, shehera lo hakkadosh baruch hu panim sochakot umasar beyado edom, uveshuvo mehakkot (divrei hayamim 2 25:14) vayyave et elohehem velahem hishtachava. leachaz hera hakkadosh baruch hu panim zoafot umesaro beyad malche aram, vayyizbach lelohe dammesek ki amar elohe aram meazzerim lahem (divrei hayamim 2 28:23):
targum: Gavra chakkima den im gavra shatya veragez vechaech vela mittevar:

rashi: Yitmoch kavod. yikrav el hakkavod vetomech bo tamid:
targum: Ramuta devar nasha tashpelineh uman demakkicha rucheh nifleg yekara:

rashi: Vaachaltem yashan noshan. happerot yihyu mishtamrin vetovim lehityashshen, sheyyehe yashan hannoshan shel shalosh shanim yafe leechol mishshel eshtakad (bava batra 91):
Veyashan mippene chadash totziu. sheyyihyu haggeranot meleot chadash vehaotzarot meleot yashan, utzerichim attem lefannot haotzarot lemakom acher, latet hechadash letochan (sham):
ohc: Vaachaltem yashan noshan. perush, shello titappesh hattevua velo tihye nirkevet o tippased meachilat happolitikin, ella adrabba tivcharu leechol hayyoter yashan, vehu ma shekkafal lomar "yashan noshan".

Veamro veyashan mippene chadash totziu, perush, lo totziu oto letzad shennityashshen venifsad, ella mippene chadash totziu oto. vetaam shekkatav davar ze kan velo bimkomo lemala keshehizkir birkat hattevua uvirkat haaretz, nitkavven hakkatuv baze lehagedalat hattova, shehagam sheyyafre veyarbe otam, af al pi chen tihye lahem hafelagat hattov sheyyochlu yashan vegomer, ma sheeno kol kach keshehaochlim muatim, sheaz afillu mehammiut yochlu yashan noshan.

rashi: Vahashimmoti ani et haaretz. zo midda tova leyisrael, shello yimtzeu haoyvim nachat ruach beartzam, shettehe shomema miyyoshveha (sifra):
ohc: Vahashimmoti ani. amar "ani", perush, midda zo Adonai bichvodo yaasenna, vehattaam ki hi midda tova, kemaamar razal (torat kohanim) shello yimtzeu oyvim nachat ruach.

rashi: Beittam. beshaa sheen derech bene adam latzet, kegon belele shabbatot (sifra; taanit 23):
Veetz hassade. hen ilane serak, vaatidin laasot perot (sifra):
ohc: Venatatti gishmechem – tzarich ladaat amro "venatatti" beVav hammosif velo kadam laze yiud acher. ulema shekkatavti beferush "im bechukkotay" sheyyesh gezera betevat "telechu" yutzdak lomar "venatatti" betosefet vav. gam yityashshev ma sheyyesh lehair od, ki mippeshat hakkatuv mashma shessechar esek hattora vehammitzvot ase velo taase hu venatatti gishmechem, im ken sechar mitzva baolam hazze hu veyetze adam naki missechar avodato, uvema sheddikdek lomar venatatti betosefet vav heir otanu shekkadmu yiudim acherim laolam habba, vehem ma sheramazti befasuk "im bechukkotay telechu".

O yomar, letzad shessechar olam haelyon ruchani veen yiudav nitpasim bannirsham velo bedibbur, laze ramzu bema shehosif vav bitchillat inyan lomar ki yesh sachar acher, umosif od litten gishmechem. vedikdek lomar gishmechem keillu hem shellachem, lo bead sechar mitzvot umaasim tovim, ella letzad shehem maamide olam beesek hattora vechulei zochim beshellahem. veulay ki letaam ze raa vayyatter goyim hittir mamonam leyisrael (bava kamma lach.), ki yisrael kanu haolam vechol asher bo, vehen haggoyim kenichse bene yisrael:
Od nitkavven lomar, shehagam shehu noten betorat "gishmechem" mattana, eno mechashshev haddavar shehu shello, ella keillu haddavar shellachem.

Vedikdek lomar venatatti, shehu haadon tzarich laasot haddavar, kede sheyyorid tippot gishmechem bizmannam uchefi hashshiur hatztzarich, ki hu yodea hazzeman vehashshiur asher tishte haaretz vesheyyoilu lah, ma sheen ken kol zulato yitbarach. vechen timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 28:3) veze leshonam: adam shochev al mittato vehakkadosh baruch hu maale ananim.

Od nitkavven beamro gishmechem al kelalut hammazon, ben hatztzarich laolam, ben hatztzarich laadama, ben hatztzarich lannefashot, ki kullam omdim lizzon, veyesh telalim ugeshamim gashmiyyim, veyesh telalim ugeshamim ruchaniyyim kayyadua leyode chen, veal kullam amar "venatatti gishmechem", veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat behar sinay.
Venatna haaretz vegomer – perashti befarashat behar sinay.

rashi: Lo yevakker vegomer. lefi shenneemar "vechol mivchar nidrechem" (Devarim 12), yachol yehe vorer umotzi et hayyafe, talo "lo yevakker ben tov lara" — ben tam ben baal mum chala alav kedushsha — velo sheyyikrav baal mum, ella yeachel betorat maaser veasur liggazez veleaved (80 bechorot 14):
Al tihye li limchitta. al yehi shelichutecha limchitta:
targum: La yehe memrach li kadvin ruchtzani at beidan aka:

rashi: Vehithallachti betochchem. atayyel immachem began eden keechad mikkem, velo tihyu mizdazeim mimmenni, yachol lo tiru mimmenni, talo "vehayiti lachem lelohim" (sifra):
Shetayim shaalti meittach. achshav medabber lifne hakkadosh baruch hu:
targum: Tarten sheelat minach la tichle mini ad la emut:

rashi: Veaf gam zot. veaf afillu ani ose immahem zot happuranut asher amarti bihyotam beeretz oyvehem, lo emasem lechallotam ulehafer beriti asher ittam:
ohc: Veaf gam zot bihyotam vegomer. tzarich ladaat ech yutzdak "veaf gam zot" shehu inyan hatava im ma shekkadam lo beinyan hayyissurin vehatztzarot. veulay shechozer litchillat hainyan shehizkir avonotam vahalichatam bemikre im Adonai, af al pi chen lo meastim vechulei.

Od yitbaer al derech ma shepperashti bema shekkadam, ki Adonai noten taam lehakepadat kol chacham lev lamma yigle yisrael meartzo velo sam lo sham baaretz atzmah mishpat tet ashuram minni orach. od hosif lomar af gam taam ze, vehu beemtzaut havaatam beeretz oyvehem veteazev haaretz mehem lo meastim vegomer lechallotam, al derech amram zichronam livracha (midrash tehillim et) ki Adonai hishlich chamato al etzim veal avanim lemallet am bene yisrael, kemizmor leasaf bau goyim vegomer samu et yerushalayim leiyyim" vegomer, shehaya mezammer al haddavar. gam yesovev rachamav vetikkavesh middat haddin birot am elyon bene melachim shefalim beyad oyvehem, veze yesovev shiflam shello techalle otam middat haddin, vehu amro veaf gam zot sibba lahavaatam beeretz oyvehem shebbihyotam beeretz oyvehem lo meastim vegomer lechallotam, uletzad ze bacharti beonesh kaze.

Lehafer beriti ittam. berit zo hi shello yachlifem beumma acheret shekkiyyem Adonai ken bemaamaro leyotze mitzrayim, vehu ma sheggamar omer ki ani Adonai elohehem – perush, zot ot habberit, elohehem velo elohim leumma acheret, gam maamaro bishat mattan tora sheyyihyu am segulla mikkol haammim umamlechet kohanim, umaamar Adonai hu bimkom berit.

Od nire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hi al ze hadderech: lo meastim vegomer lechallotam, vehattaam hu letzad beriti ittam, vechazar uferesh ma hu habberit – ki ani Adonai elohehem, ze hu habberit shehufar im achalle otam, ki en mekayyem berit Adonai sheyyihye lahem leeloah asher nitchayyevu hem lekayyemo. gam yirtze al hattora shennikret berit, sheim en yisrael, hattora shennatan Adonai lahem vehi ittam immam hufera.

rashi: Vaavadtem baggoyim. keshettihyu fezurim, tihyu avudim ze mizze (80 sifra):
Veachla etchem. ellu hammetim baggola:
Yaan uveyaan. gemul uvigmul asher bemishpatay maasu (80 sifra):
ohc: Vehaaretz teazev vegomer yaan uveyaan vegomer. amro "yaan uveyaan" al derech amro (yirmeya 9:12) "al ma avda haaretz al azvam et torati", veamru zichronam livracha (bava metzia pe:) davar ze nishala vechulei ad shebba hakkadosh baruch hu ufershah: "vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati". perush, hashsheela hi sheim yisrael chatu, eretz ma chata sheavda? shehaya lo levaal haddin lippara mehem velo techerav haaretz, vechurebatah hi bitziat baneha mittochah veyavou vah arel vetame shehu avdan haaretz. "vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati", hare sheyyetziat yisrael meeretz yisrael hi lesibbat meniat hattora, ki letzad sheen tora en cheshek laaretz bishivatam bah. umatzinu od sheamar hakkatuv lemala mizze "az tirtze vegomer vetiretz et shabbetoteha", hare ki lesibbat avon hashshemitta tovad haaretz mehem. meatta hem shene teamim litziat yisrael meeretz hakkedosha.

Laze amar "yaan uveyaan", vechazar uferesh ma hem hashshete sibbot veamar: bemishpatay maasu – hem hashshemittot, vechukkotay gaala nafsham – hi esek hattora, kemo sheamar bitchillat happarasha "im bechukkotay" ufershuha al esek hattora. umimmotza davar atta yodea ki tzerichin shete hassibbot, sheim hayu oskim battora hayu mityasserim beofen acher vetitratztze haaretz bevittul hashshemitta letzad toelet hattora hannishmaat bah. veim hayu mekayyemin mitzvat hashshemitta hagam shello hayu oskin battora haya Adonai meyasseram beofen acher velo hayu golin. uvehitztaref shenehem yatza haddin lehavi otam beeretz oyvehem sheamar bitchillat hainyan.

rashi: Az tirtze. tefayyes et kaas hammakom shekkaas al shemittoteha:
Vehirtzat. lammelech et shabbetoteha:
Veim lo yigal et hassade. hammakdish:
Veim machar. haggizbar:
Et hassade leish acher lo yigal od. lashuv beyad hammakdish:
Baavonot avotam ittam. kesheavonot avotam ittam — kesheochazim maase avotehem bidehem (sham):
Yimmakku. leshon hamassa, kemo yimmassu, vechamohu "timmakna vechorehen" (Zecharya 14), "namakku chabburotay" (Tehillim 38):
Veheveti morech. pachad veroch levav; mem shel morech yesod nofel hu, kemo mem shel moed veshel mokesh:
Venasu menusat cherev. keillu rodfim horgim otam:

Ale niddaf. sheharuach dochafo umakkehu al ale acher umekashkesh umotzi kol, vechen targumo kal tarpa deshakif, leshon chavata, "shedufot kadim" (Bereshit 41) — shekifan kiddum, leshon mashkof, mekom chavatat haddelet, vechen targumo shel "chabbura" (Shemot 21) — mashkofe:
ohc: Vehannisharim bachem vegomer. perush, otam sheyyishshaaru achar kol ze berisham velo chazru bitshuva, kederech sheamar lemala "veim telchu immi keri" vegomer, kemo chen amar "vehannisharim bachem", perush, battechuna harishona, osif behavi lahem morech vegomer venaflu vegomer, vehannisharim vegomer perush: shello chazru vechulei achar kol ze yimmakku vegomer. umimmotza davar atta yodea shehagam shettavo lahem killayon achar killayon lo tichle haumma, kemaamaro levassof "lo meastim lechallotam".

rashi: Kizkor benehem mizbechotam. kizchirat benehem ken hayta lahem zechirat mizbechotam; keadam sheyyesh lo giguin al beno (sanhedrin 63:):
Vaasherehem. asher al etz raanan. al etz – kemo etzel, vechen tirgem yonatan: "techot kol ilan avuf":
targum: Keidkara venehon egorehon vaasherehon techot kol ilan abbuf veal ramata menatlata:

rashi: Veim mach hu. sheen yado masseget litten haerech hazze.
Veheemido. lanneerach lifne hakkohen, veyaarichennu lefi hassagat yado shel maarich:
Al pi asher tassig. lefi ma sheyyesh lo yesadderennu, veyashir lo kede chayyav: mitta, kar vecheset, uchele ummanut; im haya chammar mashir lo chamoro (bava metzia 114; arachin 23):
Kisse chavod vegomer. lefi shebba lomar kol ozvecha yevoshu, matchil bekilluso shel makom umedabber lefanav: atta, shekisse chavod umarom mereshit beriat olam umechuvvan keneged mikdashenu:
targum: Pureanuta titaved mineh min kodam dishchinteh al kurese yekara bishme meroma el min avla mikvel atar bet makdeshana:

rashi: Keerkecha hakkohen ken yihye. lishar kol adam habba liknotah miyyad hekdesh:
Veradfu mikkem. min hachallashim shebbachem velo min haggibborim shebbachem (sham):

Chamishsha mea umea mikkem revava. vechi chach hu hacheshbon? vahalo lo haya tzarich lomar ella mea mikkem shene alafim yirdofu, ella eno dome muatin haosim et hattora limrubbin haosin et hattora (sham):
Venaflu oyvechem vegomer. sheyyihyu noflin lifnechem shello chederech haaretz (sham):
ohc: Veradfu mikkem chamishsha vegomer. kashe, achar sheamar hakkatuv sheyyippelu haoyvim lefanenu vechulei bederech kelal, shemmashma afillu ribbo lifne shenayim, im ken ma makom lomar "veradfu Adonai mea"? en ze ella memaet mibberacha rishona.

Achen yitbaaru hakketuvim al pi ma sheamru zichronam livracha bemassechet sota daf 11 veze leshonam: leolam midda tova merubba mimmiddat puranut, vehikshu hattosafot sham bedibbur hammatchil "leolam" veze leshonam: veim tomar, hare matzinu middat puranut gedola mimmidda tova, dichtiv (Devarim 32:30) "echa yirdof echad elef ushenayim yanisu revava" gabbe middat puranut, vegabbe midda tova ketiv "veradfu mikkem chamishsha mea"? veyesh lomar degabbe middat puranut mayyre redifa velo hariga, aval hacha ketiv "veradfu mikkem chamishsha mea" vesefa dikra "venaflu oyvechem lifnechem lecharev", ad kan leshonam. vekashe li al divrehem zichronam livracha mimma sheamru bemassechet moed katan perek ellu megallechin (moed katan 16:) veze leshonam: "veelle shemot haggibborim vegomer al shemone meot chalal befaam achat", shehaya zorek chetz umappil shemone meot chalal befaam achat, vehaya mitanneach al matayim, dichtiv "echa yirdof echad elef", yatzta bat kol veamra lo, "rak bidvar uriyya hachitti", ad kan. uledivre hattosafot dema sheamar hakkatuv "echa yirdof echad elef" medabber birdifa belo hariga, lamma haya mitanneach david al shello haya horeg elef dichtiv "echa yirdof echad elef", halo pasuk ze eno medabber bahariga?

Asher al ken nire deven pasuk "veradfu mikkem chamishsha mea" ben pasuk "echa yirdof echad elef" (Devarim 32:30) eno medabber ella bahariga. uma shehikshu zichrono livracha nire letaretz al pi ma sheamru betorat kohanim veze leshonam: "mikkem" – min hachallashim shebbachem velo min haggibborim shebbachem, ad kan. veyesh ledakdek lamma kafal lomar "velo min haggibborim"? ella hakkavvana hi shebba lishlol shello lefaresh bidvarav sherotze lomar afillu min hachallashim, laze peresh "lo min haggibborim". veal pi haddevarim hallalu lo kashya, ki befasuk ze lo hizkir ella birkat hachallashim shebbeyisrael sheyyirdefu chamishsha mea vegomer, vechallashim kayyotze bahem beummot haolam enam afillu orche milchama. uma sheamar happasuk "echa yirdof echad elef" medabber baggibborim, veamro "echad" nitkavven lomar hammeyuchad shehu haggibbor, velo hutzrach lomar haderaga zo beyisrael ki yillamed mimmiddat puranut, shehare midda tova merubba.

Umeatta shene devarim tzivva Adonai letov leammo yisrael: haechad lo higbil bah shiur, vehem gibbore yisrael, vaalehem hu omer befasuk echad "uredaftem et oyvechem venaflu vegomer lecharev". veim nafshecha agma alecha ladaat shiur, tze ulemad mimmiddat puranut, shenneemar "echa yirdof echad elef", uchelal gadol hu ki midda tova gedola mimmiddat puranut, ulefachot behashevaa, kemo shehochichu hattosafot (sota 11.) zichronam livracha mehahi sheamru, kol haosek battora yom echad bashshana maale alav hakkatuv keillu asak kol hashshana, vehochichu mehaamur befarashat meraggelim vegomer (Bamidbar 14:34) "asher tartem et haaretz yom lashshana" vegomer, hare sheen hechreach lihyot gedola ella shello timmatze pechuta mimmenna bainyan, behechreach titchayyev lomar sheechad miyyisrael yaharog elef lefachot. velaze haya david mitanneach al tashlum haelef kede shello tihye middat puranut merubba, ki david haya echad hammeyuchad.

Vetimtza bedivre hayyamim 1 siman 12, sheamar hakkatuv: "elle mibbene gad rashe hatztzava, echad lemea hakkatan vehaggadol lealef". hinne lefanecha ki ma sheamar hakkatuv chamishsha mea umea revava hem hachallashim, uvaze gilla ki ma sheamar hakkatuv "echa yirdof echad elef" (Devarim 32:30), yirtze lomar echad hammeyuchad, lo mehappechutim. umeatta hirvachnu kushyat yittur pasuk rishon sheamar "uredaftem et oyvechem", shemmedabber baggibborim velo amar shiur, ki en shiur lahem, sheefshar sheechad lachamesh meot elef, ulefachot echad leelef kaamur bakkelala "echa yirdof echad elef". vehinniach Adonai haddavar satum, sheen kol haggibborim shavim, veen kol hazzechuyyot shavot, veen kol hazzemannim shavot. yachol lihyot sheechad yirdof ribbo, ella lefachot echad elef.

Venaflu oyvechem vegomer. kafal lomar davar ze paamayim. razal darshu (torat kohanim) shehakkavvana hi sheyyippelu ish becherev reehu. venire od lomar, lefi sheasa hefresh ben redifat Adonai lirdifat mea, hosif od lomar shehu haddin im yihye elef miyyisrael tigdal hannefila beoyvehem keshiur hahefresh shebben chamishsha lemea, yihye kemo chen ben mea leelef. vehu amro "lecharev", perush leshiur minyan cherev nokemet.

rashi: Vezacharti et beriti yaakov. bachamishsha mekomot nichtav male, veeliyyahu chaser bachamishsha mekomot — yaakov natal ot mishshemo shel eliyyahu eravon sheyyavo vivasser geullat banav:

Vezacharti et beriti yaakov. lamma nimnu achorannit? kelomar, keday hu yaakov hakkatan lechach, veim eno cheday, hare yitzchak immo, veim eno cheday, hare avraham immo shehu cheday, velamma lo neemra zechira veyitzchak? ella afaro shel yitzchak nire lefanay tzavur umunnach al hammizbeach (sifra):
ohc: Veamro vezacharti vegomer. perush, ki havvidduy yoil lehakel mealehem haggezerot haraot, aval lahashivam lechannam tzarich zechut avot, vehu amro "vezacharti".

Od yirtze lomar shezze tosefet taam laggalut beeretz oyvehem, ki al yede chen yaale zichron berit avot veyizkor otam lerachamim, ma shello haya chen zulat ze. gam tihye lahem zechirat harachamim kesheyyishtattef immahem zichron haaretz, vezulat galutam beeretz haammim en tzorech lezichron haaretz lezachrah immah, vehu amro vezacharti vegomer vehaaretz ezkor. vehosif od lomar vehaaretz teazev mehem, taam acher laggalut, ki baze gam ken tiretz haaretz shabbetoteha ma shello haya chen belo galut.
Beriti yaakov veaf et vegomer. perush, im taspik zechut yaakov ma tov, veim lav osif ma shelmala mimmenna shehi berit yitzchak, veim lo taspik atzaref ma shelfanav berit avraham:

rashi: Vechashlu ish beachiv. kesheyyarutzu lanus yikkashlu ze vaze, ki yibbahalu larutz:

Kemippene cherev. keillu borchim millifne horgim, sheyyehe vilvavam pachad, vechol shaa sevurim sheadam rodfam; umidrasho vechashlu ish beachiv, ze nichshal baavono shel ze, shekkol yisrael arevin ze laze (sifra; sanhedrin 27):
