Velo shamu. avotechem lema shetztzivvitim:
targum: Vela kabbilu vela archinu yat udenehon veakshiu yat kedalhon bedil dela lemishma uvedil dela lekabbala ulefan:

rashi: Vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel. miyyad hallokcho min haggizbar, kederech shear sadot hayyotzot miyyad lokchehem bayyovel:

Kodesh laAdonai. lo sheyyashuv lehekdesh bedek habbayit, leyad haggizbar, ella kisde hacherem hannatun lakkohanim — shenneemar "kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye" (Bamidbar 18) — af zo titchallek lakkohanim shel oto mishmar sheyyom hakkippurim shel yovel pogea bo (arachin 28):

Im bechukkotay telechu. yachol ze kiyyum hammitzvot, keshehu omer veet mitzvotay tishmeru vaashitem otam hare kiyyum hammitzvot amur, ha ma ani mekayyem im bechukkotay telechu? shettihyu amelim battora (sifra):
Veet mitzvotay tishmeru. hevu amelim battora al menat lishmor ulekayyem, kemo shenneemar "ulemadtem otam ushemartem laasotam" (Devarim Adonai):
ohc: Im bechukkotay telechu vegomer. betorat kohanim amru zichronam livracha: yachol ellu hammitzvot? keshehu omer "veet mitzvotay" vegomer hare hammitzvot amurot, ma ani mekayyem "im bechukkotay"? lihyot amelim battora, ad kan. vetaam shekkara hakkatuv amal hattora chukka, letzad sheyyesh bah mitzva afillu lilmod devarim shellemadam paamayim veshalosh vehem netuim etzlo, ki chafetz Adonai beesek hattora chukka chakak. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Kohelet Rabba 3) ki letaam sheyyilmod haadam tora becheshek tamid, gazra chachmato yitbarach sheyyihye haadam lomed veshocheach.

Vetaam amro chukkotay leshon rabbim, yirmoz lishte torot – tora shebbichtav vetora shebbeal pe, umasoret hatteva leshon yachid, sheen vav ben kof letav, lomar ki tora shebbeal pe hi kelula battora shebbichtav vesham binyanah. od ramaz beamro chukkotay leshon rabbim al derech amro (Yehoshua 1:8) "vehagita bo yomam valayla", shetztzarich likboa ittim battora bayyom uvallayla, vehammasoret leshon yachid ki shene haittim hem beyom echad. od yirtze ki tzarich haadam bekiyyum mitzvot hattora shene devarim, haechad lilmod leatzmo, vehashsheni lelammed laacherim, dichtiv (Devarim 11:19) "velimmadtem otam et benechem veshinnantam" vegomer, laze amar chukkotay leshon rabbim – lilmod ulelammed, lishmor velaasot, keamro "veet mitzvotay tishmeru vaasitem otam".
Vetaam amro leshon halicha, lomar shetztzarich laasok battora afillu bahalichato, al derech amro (Devarim 6:7) "uvelechtecha vadderech", beahavatah yishge tamid vegomer:

Od yirtze al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba la.) befasuk "chishshavti derachay" vegomer shehaya david choshev laasot inyanim, veraglav molichim oto meatzmam el bet hammidrash, lerov hachefetz veharatzon vehargilut baddavar, vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu, perush, halichatchem meatzmah tihye achareha kemaamar david lerov hacheshek vehargilut.

Od yirtze al pi maamaram zichronam livracha (Zohar 11 202.) ki hattora yesh bah arba derachim, vehem: peshat, remez, derush, sod, umeellu nifredu shivim panim, vechol ofen lechamma orchin ushevilin unetivot, vehu ma sheamar chukkotay leshon rabbim, telechu perush, bechol orchin ushevilin yelech bahem beferush hakketuvim, velo yomar sheen battora ella peshat hammuvan lakkol.

Od yirtze beamro telechu al derech amro (Mishlei 3:6) "bechol derachecha daehu" vegomer, vechatav rambam beferek 3 mehilchot yesode hattora (hilchot deot) veze leshono: yasim el libbo kede sheyyihye gufo shalem vechazak kede shettihye vechulei ladaat et Adonai, shei efshar sheyyavin veyistakkel bachachmot vechulei, nimtza hammehallech bederech ze kol yamav oved Adonai, ad kan. vehu maamar hakkatuv kan im bechukkotay telechu, bishvil esek hattora telchu bechol darkechem, baachila vechulei bemishte bedibbur vechulei bechol maase hammesubbav mehattiviyyot.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin lod.) sheharshut netuna lelomde tora lefaresh bah velidrosh bechamma orchin ushevilin, vetalmid vatik yechaddesh bidrashat hakketuvim kaasher yuchal hakkatuv seet kechol asher tassig yado betorato. vitzav Adonai kan beamro im bechukkotay shehi hattora, telechu befardesah, tenay hu haddavar "veet mitzvotay" vegomer, perush, shello yihye megalle fanim battora shello kahalacha, shello letaher et hattame "vaasitem otam" shello letamme et hattahor. vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (avot 3:11) hammegalle fanim battora shello kahalacha en lo chelek laolam habba.

Od yitbaer al derech amram (avot 2:6) "velo am haaretz chasid", perush, sheasur leam haaretz lehitnaheg bachasidut, sheyyaase chumerot ugedarim keminhag hachasidim, ki lifamim yaase chumera bedavar shehu adrabba avaryan, ki yimmatze chasid sheyyirtze ligdor atzmo lekayyem mitzvat ona bayyamim hammekuddashim vetihye beenav mitzva gedola leshammesh mittato belel kippur, kemo sheshshamanu shehaya maase ken, vechaddome, laze tziuu chazal sheen leam haaretz lehitnaheg bemiddat chasidut, vehu maamar Adonai kan im bechukkotay telechu shehu esek hattora, az veet mitzvotay tishmeru perush, taasu lachem mishmeret kede lekayyemam gedarim ushemirot velo zulat ze.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (avot 4:1) "heve gole limkom tora", shetztzarich lechattet raglav mimmakom lemakom lilmod tora. vetze ulemad divrehem zichronam livracha baggemara (chagiga 5:) ki chullan hayu golin lilmod, veyesh shehaya holech shishsha chodashim vechozer kemo chen laasok beyom echad. vehu amro im bechukkotay shehi esek hattora, tzerichim shettelchu mimmekomchem achareha. gam kede shettihyu penuyim, en nachon lilmod vehu beveto ki yitreduhu betzarche habbayit, lachen yaazov ish et aviv veet immo veyissa mimmekomo lalechet achareha.

Veamro "veet mitzvotay tishmeru", yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bemassechet shabbat (shabbat lo:): machriz rabbi yannay "chaval al man delet leh darta, vetara ledarta avid", sheikkar esek hattora tzarich sheyyihye lishmor velaasot, vehu amro im bechukkotay vegomer shehu esek hattora, tenay hu haddavar "veet mitzvotay tishmeru vaasitem otam". veamar veet mitzvotay yitbaer al derech amram baggemara (berachot 17:) hallomed shello lishmah noach lo shello nivra, vehikshu battosafot im otah sheamru leolam yaasok adam battora afillu shello lishmah shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah, vetertzu ki hem shene ofanim shello lishmah: echad lekanter, veechad lehitkabbed. lekanter – noach lo shello nivra, lehitkabbed – yaasok shemmittoch vechulei. vehu maamar Adonai im bechukkotay telechu utenay hu haddavar "veet mitzvotay" shebbah shete mitzvot hatztzerichin belimmudah, shello yilmedu lo lekanter velo lehitkabbed, az tishmeru vaasitem otam. mavtiach hakkatuv shehagam shettavo avera leyado yihye nitztzol mimmenna, ucheamram (sota ka:) tora maggena umatztzela miyyetzer hara, uchemo sheamru bemassechet avoda zara (77 17:) beotah maase shel rabbi chanina verabbi yonatan shechalfu appitcha dezonot vechulei, dichtiv (Mishlei 2:11) "mezimma tishmor alecha" vegomer. vedikdek lomar vaasitem al derech amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin lat:) yashav adam velo avar avera notnin lo sachar keose mitzva, veheemiduha keshebbaa avera leyado venitztzol mimmenna, hagam sheenah ella shemira maale alav hakkatuv keillu asa maase mitzvot.

Vahagam sheddarash rava (fesachim 50:) bappasuk "ki gadol ad shamayim chasdecha" (tehillim 57:11) – ze hallomed shello lishmah ella lehitkabbed, hattaam lo sheyyesh retzon habbore belimmud ze ella lattachlit hayyotze mimmennu sheyyavo lilmod lishmah, vetora zo en bisgullatah lehatztzil miyyetzer hara bevo avera leyado. uvaze yesh letaretz ma shehikshu sham besota lerav yosef sheamar tora ben beiddana deasik bah ben beiddana dela asik bah maggena umatztzela, ella meatta doeg vaachitofel mi lo asku battora? ammay lo aggina alayyhu? ad kan. lidvarenu en kushya, shehem hayu lomdim mittechillatam shello lishmah, veen koach betora kazo lehagen alav miyyetzer hara.

O yomar al ze hadderech, leheyot sheyyesh shene sevarot (avoda zara 17.), achat shel rabbi chanina veachat shel rabbi yonatan. echad amar "nichlaf appitcha daavoda zara denachis yitzreh", veechad amar "nichlaf appitcha dezonot ki hechi denichpeyeh leyitzrin unekabbel agra". uva hakkatuv kan vehichria im haomer nichlaf appitcha dezonot, vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu, perush yecholin attem lelech vaani mavtichachem sheet mitzvotay tishmeru", sheyyihyu kofin yitzram. veim tomar velamma yachnis atzmo besafek ze, laze amar vaasitem otam kede shettitlu sachar keose mitzva kevan shebba leyedchem heavon, vehu maamaram sham "venichpeyeh leyitzrin ki hechi dinkabbel agra":

O yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha bemishnat chasidim (avot 86) hattora niknet bearbaim ushemona devarim, ki lo kol harotze liknot tora yassig kinyanah ella beemtzaut haarbaim ushemona devarim, vehu ma sheamar kan im bechukkotay telechu – im attem chafetzim lehassig hattora, tenay hu haddavar "veet mitzvotay tishmeru vaasitem otam" shehem otam haarbaim ushemona devarim, ki yesh bahem bechinat hammeniot uchenegdam amar "tishmeru", veyesh bahem bechinat hammaase uchenegdam amar "vaasitem" vegomer:

Od yirtze lehodia maalat esek hattora sheyyesh bo ma sheen beesek hammitzvot, ki esek hammitzvot yachol lihyot sheyyihye adam poel veose, veyigrom hachet veyamir kevodo levassof velo tizzacharna tzidkato beyom pisho, aval mitzvat esek hattora mavticho ki chol haosek battora tzidkato omedet laad veyelech immo tzidko, al derech amram (sota ka.) ki avera mechabba mitzva veen avera mechabba tora levattel zechutah shel tora, veyizke lalechet bah belechto laolam haelyon. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat achare mot (Vayikra 18:4) "et chukkotay tishmeru lalechet bahem".

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat 63.) befasuk "orech yamim biminah" vegomer (Mishlei 3:16), shehammayminim bah secharam laolam haelyon, vehammasmeilim bah secharam baolam hazze. hu ma sheamar kan im bechukkotay shehi esek hattora, tihye kavvanatchem beesek ze lo letachlit olam hazze, vehu kat hammasmeilin bah, ella "telechu" – tihye kavvanatchem lattashlumin keshettelchu laolam haelyon, vehu kat hammayminim.

Od yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha bemishnat chasidim (avot 3:9): "kol shechachmato merubba mimmaasav vechulei vechol shemmaasav merubbim" vechulei, vehu ma sheramaz hakkatuv beamro im bechukkotay telechu shehu esek hattora, ulefi erech ze tihye shemirat hammitzvot vekiyyuman kede shello tihye chachmato merubba mimmaasav, vehu amro samuch lemitzvat esek hattora "veet mitzvotay tishmeru vaasitem otam".

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (pea 1:1) "ellu devarim vechulei vetalmud tora keneged kullam", vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu shehu esek hattora, maale ani alechem gam ken sheshshemartem mitzvotay vaasitem otam.

O yirtze al derech amro (Vayikra 7:37) "zot hattora laola velammincha", vedarshu zichronam livracha (menachot 110.) adam osek befarashat ola maale alav keillu hikriv ola vechulei, al derech amro (Hoshea 14:3-4) "uneshallema farim sefatenu", velo ze bilvad ella kol mitzva umitzva sheenah beferek hesseg yad kesheadam lomed mitzvatah battora keillu asaah, vehu maamar hakkatuv im bechukkotay telechu veet mitzvotay vegomer otam sheen metziut laasotam tishmeru, perush, tihyu mechakkim otam matay yavou leyedchem laasotam, maale ani alechem keillu asitem otam gam ken. vehu amro vaasitem otam, lomar, lo sechar machshava levad ani noten. vahagam shekkatavnu besamuch vetalmud tora keneged kullam, yesh mitzvot shemmevattelin talmud tora bishvilan, kegon maase hakkarbanot vechaddome, velivchina zo tzarich sheyyilmod mitzvatah vikav laasotam.

O yomar al ze hadderech, shello yomar adam, kevan shettalmud tora yemalle mekom hammitzvot, im ken hare hu patur mimmaase hammitzvot asher tizdammen lefanav, talmud lomar im bechukkotay telechu shehu esek hattora, veet mitzvotay shehem lo taase tishmeru, lo mippene ze tihyu peturin mikkiyyum mitzvot, ella "vaasitem otam". uma shepperashti shehu shakul hu perat lammizdammen sheeno yachol lehitkayyem al yede hazzulat.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot yad.) sheasur leadam lasum ladderech peamav ad sheyyakdim divre tora, dichtiv (tehillim 85:14) "tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech" vegomer, vetze ulemad ma sheamru bazzohar (9 69.) al haholchim badderech veen benehem divre tora shemmitchayyevim benafsham, vehu maamar Adonai im bechukkotay telechu perush, kesheyyesh limmud tora, telchu az lavetach, ki kesheyyesh esek hattora kochoteha melavvin et haadam.

Od nitkavven lomar ma sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat 63.) chashav adam laasot mitzva veneenas velo asaah, maale alav keillu asaah, vehu maamaro im bechukkotay telechu leshon atid, perush, tachshevu lalechet vegomer, tishmeru gam ken tachshevu laasot shemira, vaasitem otam perush, maale ani alechem keillu kevar asitem otam:

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (socha ma:) ki shalosh haderagot bivne aliyya: ha hammistakkelim beaspaklarya dela nahara, 2 hammistakkelim beaspaklarya denahara, hag deayyele bela var. uferashti al derech ze pasuk (Iyov 3, 19) "katon vegadol sham hu veeved chafshi meadonav", katon hu hammistakkel beaspaklarya dela nahara, besod (Bereshit 1, 16) hammaor hakkaton, gadol hu hammistakkel beaspaklarya denahara, besod (sham) hammaor haggadol, veeved chafshi meadonav ze sheole belo reshut, she adonav natan lo chafshiyyut lalechet bechol asher yachpotz. veen ani yodea bamme yussag hakkavod haggadol hazze. laze ba maamaro yitbarach veamar im bechukkotay, perush, beemtzaut hishtaddelut hattora kammitztarech baze en attem tzerichin lerishshayon leholich etchem ella attem meatzmechem telchu belo var.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kav.) sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu leyaravam: "chazor becha vaani veatta uven yishay netayyel began eden" vechulei ad kan, veamru hammekubbalim ki tiyyul ze hi haderagat shaashua sheen lemala mimmennu, ashre enosh yizke lo. veyomar adam: bamme yizke yelud ishsha lehaderaga zo? laze ba hammaamar kan veamar "im bechukkotay" – beemtzaut esek hattora "telechu", hi halicha neelama meene kol chay shehu hattiyyul, beemtzaut hattora tetayyelu bammekomot hanneelamim.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut tehillim 831) ki keshebbara Adonai adam harishon baolam hazze, lo berao lashevet baolam hazze leolme ad keshello yecheta, sheim ken adrabba yerida hi lo veshiflut, ki tachlit hamekuvve hi baolam haelyon sheshshamma yiktzor asher zara, ella hayta hakkavvana ki alo yaale lashshamayim uleotzrot hachayyim beet asher yachpotz, veyihye kemi sheddar bevayit vaaliyya al gabbah, uchesheyyirtze laalot ulehishtaashea yaale, kemo shemmatzinu (Melachim 2 2:11) sheala eliyyahu basseara hashshamayma, veal yede hachet hutzrach lehafeshit oro mealav veyanniach hagguf baolam hazze. vehodia hakkatuv kan ki behitatztzemut haadam beesek hattora yachol lehassig beemtzautah shello yargish bammavet ella keadam haholech mimmakom lemakom, vetimtza (Zohar 10 174:) shehatztzaddikim enam margishim betzaar happereda al derech amro (Kohelet 5:11) metuka shenat haoved, ki mi shehu oved Adonai, shenato, shehi hammita, metuka vaareva alav, veim yitatztzem yoter hare lecha eliyyahu sheal yede hitatztzemut torato lo met.

Od yirtze al derech ma sheamru bemishnat chasidim (avot 4:22) veal karchacha atta met veal karchacha atta chay, sheen adam met birtzono im yachpotz lamut. veamru bemassechet nidda (daf lo:) veze leshonam: ki ka nach nafsheh derav amar leh lerav ase zil tzaneh, vei la tzayet garyeh, hu savar gadyeh amar leh, batar denach nafsheh derav amar leh hadar beh dahadar beh rav vechulei gadyeh vechulei, nach nafsheh derav ase. azal shela amar leh lidvithu tzevit li zevavdta vechulei, tzevita leh zevavdta venach nafsheh deshela, ad kan. hare shebbeerech baale hattora yecholin lalechet laolam haelyon keshehem chafetzim verotzim lalechet, hagam sheadayin lo higgia zemannam velo shalach hammelech acharehem. vehu maamar im bechukkotay – besibbat chukkotay sheattem amelim bahem, attem birshut atzmechem im tirtzu lalechet telechu.

Od nitkavven Adonai lehodia hafelagat toelet hattora, ki haosek battora yitav tamid lalechet laolam haelyon, ki yire rov erech toelet hammesubbav mimmenna vechi hu lemala veyishaf haloch lifne Adonai beartzot hachayyim. ulederech ze perashti amro (tehillim 49:16) "ach elohim yifde nafshi miyyad sheol ki yikkacheni sela", perush kesheyyihye haadam batuach shello yire sheol veyitadden beeden Adonai, baze yishaf lekachto sela, ucheillu amar "sela ki yikkacheni". veayyen midrash rabbot (yalkut shemauni parashat mase tashepaz) bemaamar aharon lemoshe kesheala lehor hahar lamut sham, sheamar lo sheillu chen haya yodea haya mekavve sheyyelech kodem. vehu maamar hakkatuv im bechukkotay, perush shettaamlu battora, beemtzaut ze attem meatzmechem tachpetzu lalechet litom taam sheen aroch elav.

Od yirtze al derech amram besefer hazzohar (Zohar 11 91:) beferush pasuk "shor o chesev" vegomer (Vayikra 22:27), ki min habbahami eno mishtanne miggeder shebbo nolad, ma sheen ken bene adam yishtannu letzad maasehem veholchim miggeder legeder elyon, keamram (Zohar 10 94:) "zacha yattir yahavin leh vechulei, zacha yattir" vechulei holech vegadel, veen ani yodea mi hu hassovev mahalachim ellu, uva hakkatuv kan vegilla veamar im bechukkotay, beemtzaut esek hattora tihye hahassaga hallaz holech vaor mimmadrega shefela lemadrega elyona umin haelyona leshellemala mimmenna.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar 9 175:) befasuk (Mishlei 6:22) "behithallechcha tanche otach", ki hadderachim asher taale bahem hanneshama betzetah min haolam hem choshech vetzalmavet hammeleim gaarat Adonai, umi sheyyesh beyado tora hi meira lefanav, keamro (tehillim 119:105) "ner leragli devarecha veor lintivati", vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu, perush battora telechu ki hi or lintivatchem, aval zulatah alehem neemar (Mishlei 4:19) "derech reshaim kaafela" vegomer, gam nikrea tora ki hi torehu derech asher yelech bah.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv chutz middarkam zichronam livracha al ze hadderech: im bechukkotay – hakkatuv medabber bemitzva shennikra chukka, shehi mitzvat tefillin, shenneemar (Shemot 13:10) "veshamarta et hachukka" vegomer. veamar "telechu" al derech amram zichronam livracha: minhag harishonim menichin tefillin bizroam uverosham kol hayyom, holech mibbeto levet hammidrash tefillin berosho vechulei, mibbet hammidrash leveto tefillin vechulei. veamru (socha koach.) al rabban yochanan ben zakkay veal rabbi shello halchu arba ammot belo tefillin, vehu maamar Adonai "bechukkotay telechu". veamro veet mitzvotay tishmeru – hen mitzvot hashshayyachim lilvishatam shetztzerichin guf naki, uleman deamar (shabbat mat.) shello yafiach bahem, uleman deamar shello yishan bahem, veshello yassiach dato mehem, shezzulat ze asur lahanicham. veamro vaasitem otam – keillu amar "vaasitem attem", shebbaze attem metakkenim atzmechem lehasherot shechinato yitbarach alechem, keamro (Devarim 28:10) "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (berachot 6.) vechulei.

Od yitbaer al derech amram (Bereshit Rabba 44:12) befasuk "habbet na hashshamayma", sheheela Adonai leavraham vedarach al hammazzalot, vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu perush chukkotay al derech amro (Yirmeyahu 33:25) "chukkot shamayim" vegomer, im bahem telechu kemo (Bereshit 13:17) "kum hithallech baaretz", tenay hu haddavar "veet mitzvotay tishmeru", ki beemtzaut kiyyum hammitzvot hu sholet vedorech al hammazzalot, vehen henna shebbahem zacha avraham livchina zo. veamro vaasitem otam, "tzedek yikraehu leraglo" (Yeshayahu 41:2), veamru zichronam livracha (shabbat 156.) sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu "may datach dekae tzedek" vechulei, ad kan, hare shemmaarich hammazzalot basseder hannaot lo veyolich mazzal mimmakom lemakom, vehu amro vaasitem otam perush, lechukkotay tetakkenu otam basseder hannaot lachem, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (shabbat 156.) "en mazzal leyisrael", perush, hem sholtim bo. o yomar "vaasitem otam" al derech amro (Yeshayahu 66:22) "ki chaasher hashshamayim hachadashim vegomer asher ani ose", "asiti" lo neemar ella "ose", melammed sheal yede esek hattora vehammitzvot nivraim shamayim chadashim (Zohar 9 5.), vehu amro vaasitem otam:

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bemassechet shabbat daf 156: man deityelid benoga yehi zannay. od sham: amru kaldae leimmeh shel rav nachman bar yitzchak shebbenah yihye gannav vechulei, yeuyyan sham. hare shehammazzal yafil baadam poal asot hara, vechash Adonai ki yomar adam ki kesheyyesh hammazzal maggid al rasha hannolad bo en beyado letakken veanus hu ufatur mehaonesh. laze amar im bechukkotay shehem hammazzalot, telechu, perush, yesovvu etchem haloch bederech lo tov – enchem peturim betaana zo, ella veet mitzvotay tishmeru al kol panim attem chayyavim, veyesh tikkun lammazzal, uchemaase sheasta lo immo shel rav nachman, vehu amro "vaasitem otam".

O yomar al derech amram bemassechet shabbat (156.) hay man deityelid bemazzal maadim oshid dema, amar rav ashe: o ummana, o gannava, o tabbacha, o mohala ad kan. vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu shehem chukkot hashshamayim shehem hammazzalot, veet mitzvotay tishmeru, shehem shechita mila, baze attem osim ma shemmare bammazzalot bidvar mitzva, vehu amro vaasitem otam:

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (sifre parashat haazinu) shetztzarich haadam lilmod musar mechukkot hashshamayim sheen meshannim et tafkidam, vesasim usemechim laasot retzon habbore. vehu amro im bederech chukkotay, shehem chukkot shamayim vaaretz hammatmidim laasot retzon konam besimcha belo shinnuy, telechu, baze gam attem mitzvotay tishmeru shello taavru alehem vetaasu et sheyyeshnam baase, ki tomru uma ellu sheen lahem sachar veonesh ken, anu al achat kamma vechamma.

Od yirtze im bechukkotay al derech amram (avot 3:17) "im en kemach en tora" vechulei, uferashtihu bimkomo sheyyirtze lomar "im en kemach" – im atta roe sheatzar Adonai hashshamayim veen kemach, hattaam hu mishshum en tora, keamro (Devarim 32:2) "yaarof kammatar likchi", perush kashshiur hammuchan habba min haggeshamim yihye likchi, uchesheen lekach yaatzor Adonai hashshamayim. veamram "im en tora en kemach" – perush, kesheen tora bevadday shello yihye kemach ki yaatzor Adonai shamav. vehu amro im bechukkotay, perush, beshiur chukkotay shehem chok hammezonot, telechu, perush, im attem rotzim latet lachem chukkechem shehem hammezonot tzerichin attem kemo chen lekayyem hammitzvot, vehu amro veet mitzvotay tishmeru al derech amro "yaarof kammatar likchi" – keshiur hammatar shehu hammazon tzarich shettihye haavoda. veamro vaasitem otam perush yaasu kede sheyyatmid Adonai hammaase latet chukkam.

Od yirtze al derech amro (tehillim 72:5) "yiraucha im shamesh", veamru zichronam livracha (berachot 29:) ki chol hannivraim zeman avodatam hu bizman shehashshemesh ola babboker, zeman tefillat shacharit, uvizman shehashshemesh yoredet vechulei, vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu al derech amro (tehillim 55:15) "bevet elohim nehallech beragesh", veamro veet mitzvotay tishmeru yirmoz leamram zichronam livracha (berachot lev:) chasidim harishonim hayu shohim shaa achat vechulei veachar tefilla shaa vechulei, uchenegdan amar veet mitzvotay vegomer, veamro vaasitem otam perush baze yetakkenu hammeorot, ki al yede maase hattachtonim kesheholchin bederech lo tov hammeorot lokin (socha 29:).

Od yesh lefaresh hakkatuv bakkarbanot, shemmatzinu shennikreu chukka, dichtiv bahem (Vayikra 6:11) "chak olam" vegomer, uchetiv (Vayikra 7:36) "chukkat olam" vegomer. veamar im bechukkotay telechu lehavi karbenotechem, tenay hu haddavar, veet mitzvotay tishmeru al derech amram bemassechet sukka (29.): amar rabbi yochanan amar rabbi shimon ben yochay, gazul dumeya defisseach vechulei, af gazul let leh takkanta ben lifne yeush ben leachar yeush vechulei leachar yeush mishshum mitzva habbaa baavera. vehu maamar Adonai kan veet mitzvotay tishmeru, shello yaviu lo gazul lifne yeush velo gazul shelleachar yeush. umasoret hatteva achat yore letzad sheshshete hammitzvot hem inyan echad shel gezel. veamro vaasitem otam yitbaer al derech amram sham beferek lulav haggazul veze leshonam: amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv (Yeshayahu 61:8) "ani Adonai ohev mishpat sone gazel beola"? mashal lemelech sheavar al bet hammeches, amar laavadav tenu meches vechulei, amar lahem: mimmenni yilmedu ovre derachim shello lehaveriach min hammeches. af hakkadosh baruch hu sone gazel beola kede sheyyilmedu vechulei. veamru zichronam livracha (kiddushin lat:) ki mi shebbaa avera leyado venitztzal hemenna notnin lo sachar keose mitzva. vehu amro taam lammitzva haamura shello yaviu min haggazel, "vaasitem otam", perush, kede sheyyelammedu atzman gam ken livroach min haggazel. veze yikkare maase, hagam sheeno ella harechakat haresha, kevan shehu bishat maase kimdayyek mimmaamar "livroach" vechulei.

Od yitbaer happasuk al kelalut hammitzvot al ze hadderech: letzad sheyyachshov adam ki ikkar hammitzvot vetoaliyyotam eno ella lemi sheyyodea ikkaran vetaaman, aval asiyyat mitzva belo yediat taam hare hu ose maase sheen bo mammash keguf belo neshama. vetimtza shekken katvu beshem harav haari zichrono livracha (Likkutei tora parashat ekev) ki maase belo kavvanat haddavar hu kichli rek, shehaikkar hu hammachshava. velaze ba maamar Adonai kan im bechukkotay telechu, perush, im haadam yaase hammitzva bechavvana zo letzad asher chakak Adonai baruch hu, toil lahem kavvana zo keillu kiyyemu hammitzvot kemo shennitkavven Adonai asot. vehu amro veet mitzvotay tishmeru bechinnuy el hammetzavve shehu bechol kavvanotehem vesodotehem. uletzad sheyyomar adam, im ken, kevan shehakkadosh baruch hu yekabbel davar ze letzad haratzon shebbaadam hagam shello nitkavven, im ken gam ken lo yaase davar veyitratztze bedato asot veyoil haratzon gam beheder hammaase, talmud lomar "vaasitem otam" – tenay hu haddavar sheyyaase ma sheyyesh beyado vaAdonai yigmor baado.

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheppasak maran behilchot tefillin siman 32 seif 18 veze leshono: im nidbeka ot leot vechulei pasul, uvehilchot sefer tora katav harosh devekut posel besefer tora veim garar haddevekut vechulei kasher. nimtzenu omrim sheyyesh hetter lachkok devek shebben ot leot besefer tora velo bitfillin, vehu ma sheramaz hakkatuv kan im bechukkotay perush chakikot haotiyyot telechu kemishpatehen lachok otam, lo lakkol timchaku ella veet mitzvotay shehem tefillin, tishmeru leval tachokku afillu devek shebben ot leot. veamro vaasitem otam yitbaer al derech ma sheppasak harosh bitshuva 16 kelal 3 veze leshono: mem petucha shennidbak petichatah, yimchok kullah veyichtov acheret bimkomah, aval gerirat hassetima eno ose otah ot, dahave leh chak tochot, veamrinan (gittin 20.) "vechatav" velo chakak vechulei, ad kan. vehu amro "vaasitem otam" perush, sheen lachok tochah ella legarrah velaasot acheret bimkomah.

Od yirmoz al pi ma sheheelu haacharonim (magen avraham siman 143) ki sefer tora shennimtza bo devek muttar likrot bo veen tzarich lehotzi acher, mittaam sheyyachol legarrah vechol sherauy levila vechulei (menachot 103:). vechiddeshu od haacharonim (ture zahav 15 siman 32) sheafillu hu yom shabbat sheen yachol legarrah, mittaam shehammenia enah mitztzad hassefer tora ella letzad shemirat shabbat. vehu amro im bechukkotay – davar shehu omed lachok shehu devek haot, telechu – perush yesh lachem reshut lehorot ki hu derech sheyyelchu bo velo yitztarchu lehotzi acher, vaafillu yihye bizman sheenam yecholin letakken shehu yom shabbat kodesh shemmitzvotay alechem leesor, vehu amro "veet mitzvotay tishmeru". venatan hattaam vaasitem otam – kevan sheyyesh beyedchem laasot veyachol letakken hare ze kasher, sheen hattikkun meakkev kattaam shennatnu haacharonim.

Od yitbaer al pi ma sheppasak 355 beyore dea siman 276 saif 11, veze leshono: davka ot lachavertah beotiyyot shem 7, yesh legarrah. vechatav hammardechay bimnachot veze leshono: sheaf al pi sheazhara lemochek Adonai milo taasun ken" vegomer, ha tikkun hu, ad kan. hu ma sheamar im bechukkotay telechu, perush, hagam sheasarti limchok, im hu davar shetztzarich lachok haddavek attem rashshain laasot ken, vehu ma sheamar telechu al derech (Shemot 18:20) "vehodata lahem et hadderech asher yelchu vah". veamro veet mitzvotay vegomer, perush, tenay hu haddavar leammen yadav shello yigga ella bachelek haddavek velo beguf haotiyyot shennitztavva alehem leval yimchok. veamar leshon rabbim sheyyetzav Adonai al shete otiyyot haddevukot shello yigga bishnehem. veulay sheyyesh lismoch gam ken divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (shavuot la.) sheasur limchok gam ot hannitpal laAdonai meachorav, vehu ma sheramaz beamro mitzvotay leshon rabbim – hashshem vehannitpal lo, sheyyishmor leval yimchok bigrirato haddavek. veamro vaasitem otam natan taam lehattir limchok haddavek kedivre hammardechay sheen ze ella tikkun. vegam yirmoz bemaamar "vaasitem otam" al pi ma sheamru babberayta (massechet sofrim 85) veze leshonam: hammochek ot achat vechulei veim nishpach deyo al hashshem muttar lemachko shello hayta kavvanato ella letakken. vechatav habbet yosef beshem 215 395 sheafillu nifseda haot mehaotiyyot sheyyuchal lemachko lechol haot, ad kan. vehu amro "vaasitem otam", perush, afillu otam atzman shehem haotiyyot im huchrach letakken yachol limchok haot atzmah. uma shehitna "veet mitzvotay tishmeru" leval yigga baotiyyot hu kesheen ella devek vehaotiyyot shelemim, aval im nifseda haot immah yachol lemachkah uletakkenah.

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru beferek 1 shel rosh hashshana (205 21.), veze leshono: shalach leh rav huna bar avin lerava, ki chazet demashcha tekufat tevet ad shitsar benisan, abbereh lehahi shatta vela techush, dichtiv (Devarim 16:1) "shamor et chodesh haaviv", shemor aviv shel tekufa sheyyihye bechodesh nisan, ad kan. vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu, perush lefi cheshbon haibbur, lefi chukkot hashshamayim shehem chamma ulevana behodaat hazzeman telechu, tenay hu haddavar, veet mitzvotay tishmeru kede sheyyavo zeman haaviv befesach, veim kefi hachukkot sheattem holchim bahem lo yihye chen, vaasitem otam perush teabberu hashshana kede shettaasu otam hammitzvot, kemo sheshshalach rav huna bar avin lerava.

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru bemassechet shabbat (shabbat kanu:) veze leshono: shemuel veavlat havo yatve vahavo kaazli hanhu inneshe leagma vechulei, hare shehagam shehera hammazzal alav bahalichato sheyyamut, al yede sheshshamar haish mikkelima veasa immo chesed, tikken hammazzal letova. vehu amro im bechukkotay telechu, perush, hagam shehu bizman shebbo hera alav hammazzal leraa sheyyelech velo yashuv, im et mitzvotay tishmeru yesh koach bachem lahafoch hammazzalot uletakken otam, vehu amro "vaasitem otam".

Od yitbaer al derech amram (fesachim 56.) "kittet nechash hannechoshet" vechulei, veamru baggemara sham letzad shehayu toim acharav. vehinne inyan nechash hannechoshet hu chukka asher chakak Adonai "vehibbit el nechash vegomer vachay" (Bamidbar 21:9), vehirsha otam asot ken. vehu maamar im bechukkotay shehu lehabbit el nechash hannechoshet telechu, tenay hu haddavar – veet mitzvotay tishmeru, aval im lo, en kan chukka veyachol chizkiyya lechatteto, uvaze "vaasitem otam" leval yitu acharav.

Od yitbaer al ze hadderech, shehacha mayre bemitzvat tevel, shemmatzinu sheyyetzav Adonai laochel tevel vaafillu kohen shechayyav mita. veyesh lecha litmoah baddavar, kelum ma hu davar sheyyesh bitvua zo sheosrah hu haferashat teruma, veim hatteruma atzmah hi neechelet lechohen mikkol shekken taarovet? ella en ze ella chukka, vehu maamar im bechukkotay telechu shello leechol tevel ad asot mitzvat Adonai lehaferish terumot vechulei, vehu amro veet mitzvotay tishmeru, veaz "vaasitem otam", shebbaze yetakkenu hammuferash leachel livalav, vehashshear lechol adam.

Od yirmoz al derech amram zichronam livracha (avot 2:10) shuv yom echad lifne mitatcha, shebbaze yihye kol yamav bitshuva, vehu maamar im bechukkotay shehi gezerat hammita shechakak Adonai sheen miyyado matztzil, im telchu bahem, shekkol yom yomar lemachar yamut, baze vadday "veet mitzvotay tishmeru vaasitem otam".

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru beferek hassocher et happoalim (bava metzia pe.) bemaase hahu merabbanan sheamar lo eliyyahu siman lehakkir kiso shel rabbi chiyyay bahalichato miggan eden shel matta lishiva shel mala, shehaya ole meatzmo velo haya tzarich lemalachim lehaaloto kishar hatztzaddikim, veze hassagato hayta beemtzaut hishtaddeluto nimratz beesek hattora leatzmo velaacherim kaamur sham, vehu maamar im bechukkotay telechu perush beemtzaut hishtaddelut battora lilmod ulelammed, karamuz betevat "bechukkotay", "telechu", perush, meatzmechem kerabbi chiyyay velo titztarchu lemalachim leholich etchem.

Vehitvaddu et avonam vegomer. rishonim lo heiru enenu bakketuvim hallalu, ki chullan rechokim mishshemoa. echad – lamma chiyyevam hakkatuv lehitvaddot avon avotam, halo behitvaddot avonam en ani kore alehem ochazim maase avotehem bidehem (berachot 7.). 2 – amro "af ani elech immam" vegomer ma inyan onesh ze achar havvidduy. 3 – amro "veheveti otam" vegomer onesh ze kevar amur lemala. 4 – amro o az yikkana safek ze lamma. veramban zichrono livracha peresh shehassafek hu al haggeulla, o tavo al yede kenia o ad sheyyekabbelu ansham, vehu perush dachuk. uchemo chen ma shepperesh adonenu Rashi zichrono livracha hu dachuk leayin roa velev maskil.

Venire lefaresh hakketuvim al ze hadderech, ki letzad shettaut matmide haaverot tavo lahem meayin toa, birotam ma shellifnehem hitivu avel shana achar shana vedarkam tzalcha veshalvatam rav leen cheker, af ki chattatam kavda mizze lo yifchad asot resha vimaen lakachat musar, ki yigdal bitchon harut mehodaat hammochiach miyyiude hattora. vedavar ze killa emunat am bene yisrael beonesh haresha usechar hatztzedek. uchemo chen hinne am bene yisrael lo hevi Adonai alehem musar ad asher avonot rishonim gavru vealu lemala rosh veshalvatam vetovatam rabba veatzma kammuvan middivre neviim, velaze kesheppaal Adonai veasa bahem nikmat avonotam lo heeminu ki al poal hara shillem lahem, veyochichu meharishonim. laze amar Adonai beet shuvam veyavou lehitvaddot – tzerichin lehitvaddot gam ken ki avotehem chatu.

Vehu amro "vehitvaddu avonam vegomer veet avon avotam", kede lehasir taut shehayu bo, sheen ze maase raa mimma sheasauhu rishonim velo neenshu, veyomru befihem: "avotenu chatu vehirshiu vaanachnu avonotehem savalnu" letzad sheachazu maase avotehem bidehem. veamro veaf asher vegomer, perush ki machshevet taut ze shehoonashim hayu baim bekeri, yachshevehu Adonai avon shetztzarich vidduy alav kishar averot.

rashi: Veshavarti et geon uzzechem. ze bet hammikdash, vechen hu omer "hinni mechallel et mikdashi geon uzzechem" (Yechezkel 24):

Venatatti et shemechem kabbarzel veet artzechem kannechusha. zo kasha mishshel moshe, sheshsham hu omer "vehayu shamecha asher al roshcha nechoshet vegomer" (Devarim 28), sheyyihyu hashshamayim mazziin kederech shehannechoshet mazzia, vehaaretz enah mazzia kederech sheen habbarzel mazzia, vehi meshammeret peroteha, aval kan hashshamayim lo yihyu mazziin kederech sheen habbarzel mazzia, vihe chorev baolam, vehaaretz tehe mazzia kederech shehannechoshet mazzia, vehi meabbedet peroteha (sifra):
ohc: Veshavarti et geon uzzechem. amru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim): ze bet hammikdash shennikra chen. vehakkavvana baze, kevan shello chazru bitshuva, ze yore shechoshvim bedatam ki Adonai chafetz bahem adayin, mimma sheodo shochen betocham, uvaze mitchazzekim. laze amar "veshavarti" vegomer.

Vehalachti vegomer bekeri. perush, shello yavi alehem yissurim mechuvvanim al chattotam kemo sheasa mikkodem, shehaya mevi kechattotam, al derech amro (tehillim 62:13) "teshallem leish kemaasehu", ki ze yeorer lev nirdam veyaskilu lehetiv maasav shekkenegdam baa elav haraa. veamar Adonai ki im yelchu immo bekeri velo yaskilu lemaase Adonai asher yeorer libbam bechiuun yissurin keneged avonotehem, gam hu yelech immahem bekeri veyavi alehem yissurin sheen lahem dimyon lemaasehem haraim, vehem: cherev, umatzor, vedever, usegira beyad oyev, veraav shekkolel shalosh tzarot, hare sheva.

rashi: Ach kol cherem vegomer. nechleku rabbotenu baddavar, yeo setam charamim lehekdesh, uma ani mekayyem kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye? becherme chohanim, shepperesh veamar hare ze cherem lakkohen; veyesh sheamru, setam charamim lakkohen (80 sifra; arachin 28):

Lo yimmacher velo yiggael. ella yinnaten lakkohen: ledivre haomer setam charamim lakkohanim, meforash mikra ze bistam charamim, vehaomer setam charamim levedek habbayit, mefaresh mikra ze becherme chohanim — shehakkol modim shecherme chohanim en lahem pidyon ad sheyyavou leyad kohen vecherme gavoah nifdim:

Kol cherem kodesh kodashim hu. haomer setam charamim levedek habbayit, mevi reaya mikkan, vehaomer setam charamim lakkohanim, mefaresh "kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu" lelammed shecherme chohanim chalim al kadshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim, venoten lakkohen, kemo sheshshaninu vemassechet arachin (daf 28), im neder, noten demehen, veim nedava, noten et tovatah:
Meadam. kegon shehecherim avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim:
Akov hallev. male toana vaakubba mikkol raa:
Veanush. leshon choli, vechalyo hu ze:
Mi yedaennu. hu savur: mi yedaennu. ani Adonai chokro:
targum: Nechil libba mikkola vetakif hu man yadineh:

rashi: Veheveti otam. ani veatzmi aviem; zo midda tova leyisrael, shello yihyu omrim, hoil vegalinu ben haummot naase chemaasehem, ani eni mannicham, ella maamid ani et neviay umachaziran letachat kenafay, shenneemar (Yechezkel 21), "vehaola al ruchachem hayo lo tihye vegomer chay ani … im lo beyad chazaka vegomer" (sifra):
O az yikkana. kemo "o noda ki shor naggach hu" (Shemot 21) — im az yikkana; lashon acher ulay — shemma az yikkana levavam vegomer:
Veaz yirtzu et avonam. yechapperu al avonam beyissurehem:
ohc: Veamro af ani vegomer. perush, gam ze yomru bichlal havvidduy ki tzaddik Adonai al kol habba alehem, vechen rauy lemishpat tzedek lelech immam bekeri velo yeavvel hael mishpat.

Veamro veheveti otam vegomer. perush, gam ze yomru bichlal havvidduy. vehinne mimma shemmatzricham Adonai lehitvaddot alav atta yodea shehem hayu marshiim bifrat ze, veharesha hu ki yomru: lamma Adonai yotziem meartzam veyaglem ben haummot? im lefiron avonam – yeyasserem toch artzotam velo yaglem ben haummot, ki adrabba ze yesovev hefech tikkun hammevukkash, sheim hammevukkash hu lehetiv maasehem, vehinne kesheyyezare otam baaratzot yigmeru laasot ra veyitarvu vaggoyim veyilmedu maasehem, veze yechazzek machshevet keri. laze kesheamar Adonai "vehitvaddu" zachar sheyyomru gam ken bevidduyam ki tzaddik Adonai bema shehalach immahem keri, uleoto hattaam uleoto hammivchan heviam beeretz oyvehem kederech maase hammikre belo kivvun el hatztzarich.

Veamro o az. perush, sheyyitlu taam havaatam beeretz oyvehem letzad halicha, o letaam kede sheyyikkana levavam hearel, laze heviam beeretz oyvehem ma shello haya nichna beofen acher zulat ze, shebbaze yihye lahem harevacha nechona, sheal yede hachenaa levad yirtzu et avonam velo yitztarchu lemeruk acher, al derech amro (Melachim 1 21:29) "haraita ki nichna achav", veamru zichronam livracha (berachot 7.) tova mardut achat belibbo shel adam mimmea malkiyyot, vehu amro "az yikkana vegomer veaz yirtzu et avonam":

rashi: Ani Adonai elohechem. keday ani shettaaminu vi sheani yachol laasot kol elle, shehare hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim veasiti lachem nissim gedolim:
Motot. kemin yated bishne rashe haol hameakkevim hammosera shello tetze merosh hashshor veyattir hakkesher, kemo "ashe lecha moserot umotot" (Yirmeyahu 27), kabeyleyya belaaz:
Kommiyyut. bekoma zekufa (sifra):

Veim lo tishmeu li. lihyot amelim battora, ladaat midrash chachamim. yachol lekiyyum hammitzvot? keshehu omer velo taasu vegomer hare kiyyum mitzvot amur, ha ma ani mekayyem veim lo tishmeu li? lihyot amelim battora, uma talo li? en li ella ze hammakkir et ribbono umechavven limrod bo, vechen benimrod "gibbor tzayid lifne Adonai" (Bereshit 10), shemmakkiro umitkavven limrod bo, vechen beanshe sedom "raim vechattaim laAdonai meod" (sham 13), makkirim et ribbonam umitkavvenim limrod bo (sifra):
Velo taasu. mishshello tilmedu lo taasu, hare shete averot:
ohc: Veim lo tishmeu vegomer. tzarich ladaat hechan nitztauu bitnay al hashshemia bitchillat happarasha, sheyyutzdak lomar bechefel hattenay "veim lo tishmeu", velo haya tzarich lehatechil ella mivim bechukkotay timasu". venire ki kan nitkavven hakkatuv lehaircha ki ma sheamar bitchillat haddevarim "im bechukkotay", shekkavvanato hi al iske hattora, velaze rasham behafechiyyutah shelilat hashshemia. veezo mitzva shetteluya beshema ozen? heve omer esek hattora, al derech amro (Yeshayahu 55:3) "shimu utechi nafshechem", "yishma chacham veyosef lekach" (Mishlei 1:5). uletzad shennitkavven Adonai bemaamar "bechukkotay" lechol ma shepperashnu bah, bechefel hattenay tala kol hemshech hara missibbat heder hattora.

Od letzad sheratza Adonai lomar shelilat shemirat hammitzvot umeun asot retzono yitbarach, laze hikdim hassibba veamar shessibbat haddavar hi letzad shello lamdu tora, al derech amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin 30.) amar hakkadosh baruch hu: barati lachem yetzer hara, barati lo tora tavlin. hare ki en tikva lehinnatzel mehayyetzer al yede esek zulat hattora, uchesheyyushelal mehattora yatte azno leyitzro hara:

Od nitkavven lehair lev nirdam, ki chol sheholech bederech lo tov vadday shehushelal mimmennu yediat habbore baruch hu vetovotav vehannimshach meavodato, ki bevadday im yassig adam chelek echad mearevut yedidut neimut metikut anaf meanfe or elyon, yivez belibbo heyot baolam hazze melech hammelachim beerech kiyyum mitzva achat. vehu ma sheheir Adonai beamro veim lo tishmeu li, perush, leshon havana, az hu sheani choshesh lachem shello taasu vegomer, aval im tavinu vetedu oti en lachush. vehu maamar hannavi (yeshaya 5:13) "lachen gala ammi mibbeli daat".

Od yirtze behair od amro velo taasu et kol, lefi ma shepperashti befasuk "im bechukkotay telechu" vegomer beechad min hadderachim, sheyyechavven lomar sheal yede esek hattora yihye batuach miyyitzro, ki hattora maggena umatztzela (sota ka.). laze amar bechefel hattenay "veim lo tishmeu li", perush 'li – lishmi, shehagam sheyyilmedu hattora, im lo yihye hallimmud lishmo yitbarach – "velo taasu et kol hammitzvot haelle", perush, en matztzil miyyad yetzer hara veyavou leyadam averot, sheen matztzil mehayyetzer ella tora lishmah.

Od yirtze, sheim lo yishmeu lattora hagam sheyyaskimu laasot kol hammitzvot, hu min hai haefsharut, ki lo yuchal hassig daat dikduke hammitzvot uferatehem, velo yimmana mehikkashel. gam al derech amram zichronam livracha (menachot 110.) "zot hattora laola" vegomer (Vayikra 6:2), ki haosek battora afillu bizman churban habbayit yachol lekayyem kol hammitzvot, ma sheen ken im lo yaasku battora bevadday shello yaasu et kol hammitzvot.

Od nitkavven beamro tevat li lehair, ki atimat ozen middivre tora hu kemi shebba ledabber immo haadon melech haolam vimaen lishmoa elav, vehu amro veim lo tishmeu li, perush, li en attem rotzim lishmoa.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha (Alshich Eicha 1) befasuk "veoti azvu vetorati" vegomer (Yirmeyahu 16:11) mashal letofes kinnor vechulei, ad kan. hare shehagam sheyyihyu yisrael baavonotenu merabbim ovde avoda zara veosim kol haaverot, veyihyu oskim battora – lo haya nechrav habbayit. vehu ma shennitchakkem Adonai lehakedim velomar veim lo tishmeu li, az hu sheim lo taasu et kol hammitzvot yimmashech lachem puranut haamur bainyan, aval im tishmeu, hagam shello taasu et kol vegomer, yihye dinam ketofes kinnor vechulei haamur bedivrehem.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: letzad sheyyodea Adonai machshevot lev haadam vetachbulot yetzer hara veseder kenisato im haadam, laze dibbera tora keneged yetzer hara vehitchil keneged techillat happittuy. vehinne kevar katavti lecha peamim rabbot ki letzad sheish yisrael kerovim laAdonai, lo tikkon atzato shel yetzer hara ledabber elav asot hara ad sheyyarchikehu meat meat, kegonev et hakkatan mibbet aviv shebbitchilla moshcho meat meat. kemo chen bitchilla yatchil hayyetzer ledabber elav ki nachon haddavar habba meet Adonai, kol hakkatuv battora "mi kamocha yachush ledivre Adonai", aval ma shehosifu chachamim kamma gedarim ushemirot veanfe haissur mi yomar ki chen tzivva habbore? uchesheyyatte azno lehareher acharehem, yosif lehakkoto ki yomar elav: "rabbim hammitzvot haelle mimmecha, 248 mitzvot ase veanfehem", uletzad heyot haadam meruchak meat meAdonai yuchal yakke bo.

Ucheneged shene pittuyim ellu amar veim lo tishmeu li, kan medabber al kabbalat divre chachamim, vehu al derech amro (Devarim 17:12) "vehaish asher yaase vezadon levilti shemoa vegomer umet haish hahu". vedikdek lomar "li" al derech kol hameharher achar rabbo keillu mehareher achar hashshechina, laze amar (sanhedrin 110.) "veim lo tishmeu", teda shehaddavar li hu nogea. veod ki hachachamim hechal Adonai hemma.

Ucheneged pittuy hashsheni shemmarbe beenav ol mitzvot ase ki rabbim hem, amar velo taasu et kol hammitzvot haelle. gam nitkavven lomar shekkol sheeno maamin bedivre rabbotenu bevadday shello yaase achat mikkol hammitzvot, ki seder hammitzvot vaamittutah hu asher gavlu rishonim, vehammesarev lishmoa lahem en beyado afillu achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai. velaze lo amar "veim lo taasu" kasseder sheamar bappasuk sheachar ze, letzad shezze nimshach meim lo tishmeu".

rashi: Vetam larik kochachem. hare adam shello amal, shello charash, shello zara, shello nikkesh, shello kisseach, shello adar, uvishat hakkatzir ba shiddafon umalke oto, en bechach kelum, aval adam sheamal vecharash vezara venikkesh vechisseach veadar uva shiddafon umalke oto, hare shinnav shel ze kehot:
Velo titten artzechem et yevulah. af ma sheatta movil lah bishat hazzera (sifra):
Veetz haaretz. afillu min haaretz yehe lakuy, shello yachanit perotav bishat hachanata (sham):
Lo yitten. meshammesh lemala ulematta, aetz veapperi:
Lo yitten piryo. keshehu mafre mashshir perotav, hare shete kelalot, veyesh kan sheva puranuyyot (sifra):
ohc: Vetam larik vegomer. keillu amar "vetam kochachem larik", perush, shekkocham bishlemut yihye larik, uletzad shellifamim lo yishlot hammashchit ella bechelek, kan hodia (Adonai) ki yishletu bakkol rachamana litztzelan:

rashi: Vehishlachti. leshon geruy:

Veshikkela etchem. en li ella chayya meshakkelet sheddarkah bechach, behema sheen darkah bechach minnayin? talo "veshen behemot ashallach bam" (Devarim 32), hare shetayim. uminnayin shettehe memita vinshichatah? talo "im chamat zochale afar" (sham), ma ellu noshchin umemitin af ellu noshchin umemitin, kevar hayu shanim beeretz yisrael chamor noshech umemit, arod noshech umemit:
Veshikkela etchem. ellu hakketannim:
Vehichrita et behemtechem. mibbachutz:
Vehimita etchem. mibbifnim:
Venashammu darchechem. shevilim gedolim ushevilim ketannim; hare sheva puranuyyot: shen behema, veshen chayya, chamat zochale afar, veshikkela, vehichrita, vehimita, venashammu:
ohc: Chayyat hassade. keshem shehem asu maase behemot shello hirgishu lehearat malkam, tavo chayyat hassade vetaase maaseha bahem:

rashi: Ki yafli. yafrish befiv:
Beerkecha nefashot. litten erech nefashot — lomar erech davar shennafsho teluya vo alay (80 sifra; arachin 4):
Venaar meshullach. sheshshelacho aviv lalechet bedarche libbo, sofo mevish immo. yishmael, al shehaya rasha, garam lesara sheamra leavraham "garesh et haama vegomer" (Bereshit 21:10):
targum: Shivta umachsenuta yahavin chachmeta vetalya dela mekabbel baa mavhit imeh:

rashi: Venatatti shalom. shemma tomru, hare maachol vahare mishte, im en shalom en kelum, talo achar kol zot "venatatti shalom baaretz"; mikkan shehashshalom shakul keneged hakkol, vechen hu omer (yeshaya 45) "ose shalom uvore et hakkol":
Vecherev lo taavor beartzechem. etzalo shello yavou lammilchama, ella afillu laavor derech artzechem mimmedina limdina (sifra):
ohc: Venatatti shalom baaretz. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar ze achar shekkevar amar "vishavtem lavetach", veulay sheyyechavven al am bene yisrael atzmam shello yihye lahem perud hallevavot, sheyyitta Adonai benehem shalom vereut. o efshar sheyyechavven al kelalut haolam, veteda shekkeshemmedabber al eretz yisrael mazkirah bechinnuy, keamro besamuch "beartzechem", vechan amar baaretz shemmavticham ki yihye shalom bechol haolam. vetimtza shechafetz Adonai baddavar, vetze ulemad mippare hechag shivim keneged shivim ummot, umaamre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (socha noah:) beinyan ze, gam kefi hatteva kesheyyesh milchamot baolam yecherdu gam hayyoshvim betach lekol anot milchama, velaze gamar omer ushechavtem veen macharid:

Vehishbatti chayya raa. perush, letzad shehivticham Adonai sheyyihyu yoshvim betach ish tachat gafno uteenato, mizze yesubbav shehadderachim harchokim ketzat min hayyishshuv titmaet bahem regel dorechet, vechevan shekken yimmatzun sham chayyot hammidbariyyot veyitkarvu lavo el hayyishshuv. laze amar vehishbatti chayya raa min haaretz, perush, eretz asher ba bah hammechush shettihye bo chayya raa shehu makom hakkarov layyishshuv, velaze lo amar beartzechem kemo shehitchil lomar besamuch millefaneha umilleachareha.

rashi: Tov bera. tam bevaal mum.
O ra betov. vechol shekken tov betov vera bera (80 temura 9):
Veim achar hayyovel yakdish. vechen im hikdishah mishshenat hayyovel venishtahat beyad gizbar, uva ze legoolah achar hayyovel.

Vechishshav lo hakkohen et hakkesef al pi hashshanim hannotarot. kefi cheshbon; ketzad? hare katzav dameha shel arbaim vetesha shana chamishshim shekel, hare shekel lechol shana veshekel yater al kullan, vehashshekel arbaim ushemona fundeyon, hare sela ufundeyon leshana, ella shechaser pundeyon echad lechullan, veamru rabbotenu sheoto pundeyon kalbon lifrotrot, vehabba ligol, yitten sela ufundeyon lechol shana lashshanim hannotarot ad shenat hayyovel (80 sifra; arachin 24):
Venigra meerkecha. minyan hashshanim shemmishshenat hayyovel ad shenat happidyon:
Veim gaol yigal. hammakdish oto, yosif chomesh al hakkitzba hazzot:
Ufaniti alechem. efne mikkol asakay leshallem secharchem. mashal lema haddavar dome? lemelech shessachar poalim vechulei, kidita betokko:
Vehifreti etchem. bifriyya ureviyya:
Vehirbeti etchem. bekoma zekufa (sifra):

Vahakimoti et beriti etchem. berit chadasha, lo chabberit harishona shehefartem otah ella berit chadasha shello tufar, shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 31) "vecharatti et bet yisrael veet bet yehuda berit chadasha lo chabberit vegomer" (sifra):
ohc: Ufaniti alechem vegomer. amro ufaniti al derech amram zichronam livracha (taanit 2.) shalosh maftechot beyad hakkadosh baruch hu, veechad mehem hu shel leda. laze kesheratza lomar "vehifreti etchem" amar "ufaniti", shehu yifne atzmo kivyachol laasot davar ze velo al yede shaliach. veulay sheyyechavven gam ken bemaamar vehirbeti al mafteach happarnasa, ki befarnasa komatam gedela, veamru betorat kohanim "vehirbeti etchem" bekoma zekufa. uvemaamar vahakimoti et beriti al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 90.) shebberit keruta leshochne afar lehachayotam, vehu mafteach hashshelishi shebbeyad hakkadosh baruch hu, ucheneged shelashtam amar "ufaniti" vegomer:

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat kanu.) en mazzal leyisrael, veal derech amro (yeshaya 41:2) "tzedek yikraehu leraglo", sheakar Adonai mazzal ze mimmakom echad unetano bemakom acher. vehu maamar Adonai "ufaniti alechem vehifreti" vegomer, keneged bene chayye umezone, hagam sheshshelashtam hem teluyim bemazzal velo bizchut (moed katan koach.), ani afanne hammazzal mimmakom lemakom hammore alechem lifrot, ze keneged habbanim. vehirbeti etchem keneged chayye, al derech amro (Devarim 11:21) "lemaan yirbu yemechem" vegomer. vahakimoti et beriti keneged mezone, veyiches lah shem berit al derech amro (Bereshit 8:21) "vayyomer Adonai el libbo lo osif vegomer od kol yeme haaretz zera vekatzir" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (shavuot lo.) ki ma sheamar "lo osif" hu shevua, uchetiv sham (Bereshit 9:12) "zot ot habberit", vechol hanneemar sham hu nichlal bichlal hashshevua. vedikdek bemaamaro kan sheyyekayyem otah habberit shel zera vekatzir immam, vehu amro vahakimoti et beriti ittechem, ki lo hayta hashshevua bederech kelal al kol haaretz, ki halo yesh kamma shanim sheen zera vekatzir bechelek min haaretz, ki Adonai lo amar sham bivrit noach "yeme kol haaretz". veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Devarim 6:5) "veahavta et Adonai elohecha".

Od yitbaer amro ufaniti alechem al derech ma sheamar hannavi (Shmuel 2 6:10) "velo ava david lehasir elav aron Adonai vegomer vayyattehu david bet oved vegomer vayvarech Adonai et oved" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (berachot 63.) ishto ushemone kalloteha yaldu shishsha bechares echad, dichtiv (divrei hayamim 1 26:8) "peulletay hashshemini shishshim ushenayim" ad kan. vehu maamar Adonai ufaniti alechem vehirbeti etchem, shebbeemtzaut peniyyat Adonai alehem yishtalshel haddavar meatzmo leharebot otam, kemo shennishtalshel levet oved keshehitta elav aron Adonai. veamro vehirbeti etchem leshon maala verabbanut, vehakkavvana baze shehagam sheyyihyu merubbim kol kach, umidderachim hargilim bannimtzaim baolam kol hammitrabbe yimat erko, kaasher hirchavnu beur perat bechina zo bimkomot acherim (Shemot 1:9, Bamidbar 13:18), af al pi chen "vehirbeti etchem". veamro vahakimoti et beriti ittechem hivticham ma shehivtiach hannavi, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 59:21) "vaani zot beriti otam amar Adonai vegomer lo yamushu mippicha" vegomer, shello tippasek tora mizzaram. od nitkavven lomar bederech kelal berit hahatava sheyyechaddesh habberit immahem millevad berit haavot, vehu amro "vahakimoti et beriti" shekkevar nishbati laavotechem akayyem otah ittechem mechadash.

rashi: Veim mibben chamesh shanim. lo sheyyehe hannoder katan — sheen bedivre katan kelum — ella gadol sheamar erech katan ze shehu ven chamesh shanim alay (80 arachin 2):
Lo yakdish ish oto. leshem karban acher, lefi sheeno shello (80 arachin 29):
Vaani lo atzti. lo mihareti lezarezcha lahaviam, mihyot roe tov mechazzer acharecha levakkesh alehem rachamim:

Veyom anush. choli shel puranut lo hitavveti. veyonatan tirgem: "vaana la anbit al memrach millehitnabbaa alehon laatavutehon ledachaltach". ulefi hattargum yihye atzti – leshon ikkuv, kelomar: lo ikkavti millomar lahem shelichutecha ulehashivam elecha, im hayu shomim elay:
Motza sefatay nochach panecha haya. lehashiv et chamatcha mehem:
targum: Vaana la akkevet al memrach militnabbaa alehon leotavutehon lidchaltach uleyom bish deat mayte alehon la chamedit at gele kodamach appakut sifvati gele kodamach hava:

rashi: Beet barzel. mashal hu, kelomar: chakuka beshikkua veen nocha limchok. umidrash aggada beet barzel betzipporen shamir al yede yirmeya shennikra ammud barzel, veal yede yechezkel shenneemar lo" kashshamir chazak mitztzur natatti mitzchecha" (Yechezkel 3:9):
Charusha. chakuka, keze shehu choresh baomek:
Al luach libbam. sheenam shochchin avoda zara shellahem:
targum: Chovay vet yehuda ketivin beat devarzel bitfar shamir charitin al luach libbehon ulekarnat egorechon:

rashi: Been chazon yippara am. kesheggormin yisrael shehannevua mistalleket mehem, al yede shehem malivim banneviim (divrei hayamim 2 36:16), yifretzu vam peratzot veyotzin letarbut raa:
targum: Besugea deavlae mittera ama udenater orayta tuvohi:

ohc: Vaachaltem besar benechem vegomer tochelu. taam shekkafal lomar "tochelu" paam sheniyya, lomar sheafillu achar shekkevar achlu, lo yikkamru rachamehem kadderech haragil lehinnachem achar maase veyikkamru rachamehem veyivku "hoy beni, hoy bitti", ella od yaskimu leechol im yimtzaum mechadash.

O yirtze ki yakdimu leechol habbanim, vehattaam letzad shennotnim enehem leechol gam habbanot, laze yakdimu habbanim sheyyesh bahem safek sheyyemaanu veyivrechu birot habbanot neechalot, ma sheen lachush kemo chen babbanot ki en koach bahem kazzecharim, vehu amro vaachaltem besar benechem, vetaam hakedamat habbanim velo habbanot lo letzad sheen datechem leechol habbanot, ella tosifu gam ken leechol besar benotechem, veattem makdimin habbanim sheyyesh lachush letaam muregash.

O yomar al ze hadderech, ki letzad sherachame haav al habbanim yoter mehabbanot (shabbat 66:), laze hem mitchakkemin leechol habbanim techilla kede shebbaze yihye nakel lahem leechol habbanot, veze shiur hakkatuv: vaachaltem besar benechem, vetaam hakedima kede shebbesar benotechem tochelu, perush lo yichav levavchem kefi ma shekkadam veyihye lachem kammaachol haragil:

rashi: Veim gaol yigalenna. babbealim hechemir hakkatuv lehosif chomesh, vechen bemakdish bayit, vechen bemakdish et hassade, vechen befidyon maasher sheni — habbealim mosifin chomesh velo shear kol adam (sham 25):
Yevoshu rodfay. anshe anatot levaddam:
targum: Yivhatun radfay vela ebbahet ana yitkalmun inun vela itkalem ana ayte alehon yom bish veal chad teren tevara tabberinun:

rashi: Veim telchu immi keri. rabbotenu amru aray, bemikre, sheeno ella lifrakim, ken telchu aray bemitzvot; umenachem peresh leshon menia, vechen "hokar raglecha" (Mishlei 25), vechen "yekar ruach" (sham 17), vekarov lashon ze letargumo shel unkelos, leshon koshi, shemmakshin libbam limmana mehitkarev elay:
Sheva kechattotechem. sheva puranuyyot acherim, bemispar sheva kechattotechem (sifra):
ohc: Veim telchu immi keri. letzad shemmakkot ellu hem makkot hammargishot umakkirot hashegacha ki Adonai meyasser otam, uchesheen chozrim bitshuva en maane ella lomar keri hu zo.
Sheva kechattotechem. hagam shello hirshiu baaverot chadashot, af al pi chen, kevan shello chazru achar hayyissurin, yechashev lahem keosim mechadash.

rashi: Vehifkadti alechem. vetzivviti alechem:
Hashshachefet. choli shemmeshachef et habbasar, anepavelaysh belaaz, dome lenafuach shehukalla nefichato umarit panav zeufa:
Hakkaddachat. choli shemmakdiach et hagguf umechammemo umaviro, kemo "ki esh kadcha veappi" (Devarim 32):

Mechallot enayim umedivot nafesh. haenayim tzofot vechalot lirot sheyyekal veyerafe, vesof shello yerafe, veyidavu hannefashot shel mishpachto bemoto; kol taava sheenah baa vetochelet memushshacha keruya chilyon enayim:
Uzeratem larik. tizreu velo titzmach, veim titzmach vaachaluhu oyvechem:
ohc: Af ani vegomer. perush, gam middat harachamim taskim al hakkelalot im middat haddin.

Vehifkadti vegomer hashshachefet vegomer. bachar Adonai bemin kelalot ellu keneged middatam shel harshaim, uletzad sheikkar avonam hi meniat esek hattora madad lahem bammidda atzmah, vehinne hattora nimshela laesh dichtiv (yirmeya 23:29) "halo cho devari kaesh".

Veda ki hattora tesaggel shalosh maalot tovot benefesh adam. haachat, mibbeemtzaut iskah leheyotah esh metzarefet hannefesh umetaheret otah leval titztarech laredet sheol letzarfah, velaze en ur shel gehinnom sholet bahem (chagiga 27.), ki ishshah gadol mikkoach esh gehinnom veen tachalue hannefesh shebbahem sholet ur shel gehinnom, velaze gehinnom tzoek behara "en li chefetz batztzaddikim" vechulei (Shemot Rabba 7:4) shehem mattishim kochah umechabbim ishshah. vehammaala hashsheniyya shemmeira haenayim, ki yesh lecha ladaat ki tzarich or gadol leene kol yisrael kede sheyyuchelu lehanot mizziv hashshechina lemala, vehaadon beahavato otanu natan lanu hattora shennikret or, dichtiv (Mishlei 6:23) "vetora or", kede shebbeemtzautah yigdal koach or enenu, ki kefi godel or shebbaenayim kefi hammussag behabbit el haelohim, ulechol shello heiru battora yikra lahem nevi Adonai (Yeshayahu 42:7) "vehaivrim habbitu lirot". vehammaala hashshelishit ki divre tora mesammeche lev, dichtiv (tehillim 19:9) "pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev", uchetiv (tehillim 97:11) "uleyishre lev simcha". ucheneged shalosh maalot ellu amar Adonai onesh mechuvvan leozve Adonai, keneged ma shemmeanu laasok battora shehi esh hakkedosha yafkid Adonai alehem shachefet vekaddachat, gam hizkir behala shehu hefech hammussag meesek hattora shehu yishshuv hassechel vehitkonnut haddaat, ucheneged meor enayim amar mechallot enayim, ucheneged simchat hallev amar vedaavon nafesh, veamar uzeratem larik keneged hatzelachat haolam hazze.

Gam yirmoz lehatzelachat olam haelyon, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Uktzin 3:12) atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehanechil lechol tzaddik vetzaddik shelosh meot veeser olamot. vedavar yadua hu shekkol hadderagot yiude sechar hattov latztzaddikim yesh kenegdam onshe harshaim, keamro (Kohelet 7:14) "gam ze leummat ze asa haelohim". ucheshem sheyyesh haderagot hashshelosh meot veeser yiude hakkesherim, kenegdam shelosh meot veeser tinnufe hayyissurin leose risha, veyikkaru keri rik sheole bahem shelosh meot veeser, vehu maamar uzeratem larik, bimkom "lehanechil ohavay yesh" yihye livchinat hara rik, shehem keneged mispar bakkelippa. veamar leshon zeria ki yityaches gam lemifalot lashon ze, al derech amro (Hoshea 10:12) "ziru lachem litzdaka" vegomer. veamro vaachaluhu oyvechem ki hakkelippot nehenim mimmaase harshaim, veyodia hakkatuv shehakkelippot hem oyve ish.

rashi: Nekam berit. yesh nakam sheeno babberit, kederech shear nekamot, vezehu simmuy enav shel tzidkiyyahu (sifra). davar acher: nekam berit nikmat beriti asher avartem. kol havaat cherev shebbammikra hi milchemet chayalot oyvim:
Veneesaftem. min hachutz el toch hearim mippene hammatzor (sham):
Veshillachti dever betochchem. ay haddever venittattem beyad haoyvim hatztzarim alechem, lefi sheen melinim et hammet birushalayim, ucheshehem motziim et hammet lekavro nittanin beyad oyev (sham):
Asher yivtach baadam. bacharisho uketziro, lomar: ezra bashsheviit veochal:
Zeroo. kemo ezro, vechen tirgem yonatan: "ruchetzaneh":
Umin Adonai yasur libbo. shehivticho: "vetzivviti et birchati lachem" (Vayikra 25:21). kach shamati:
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai lit gavra deitrechetz beenasha vishave visra rachtzaneh umin memra dayya yede libbeh:

rashi: Veshamatta. al karchacha tishmat artzecha et asher lo shavta beshabbetotechem (Vayikra 26:35), sheamarti lachem "veshavta haaretz" (Vayikra 25:2):
Uvecha. ennakem mechamat nachalatcha asher natatti lach shello asita retzoni lehashemitah, davar acher: uvecha minnachalatcha – uvecha ennakem minnachalatcha, sheagle otcha mimmenna:
Ki esh kedachtem beappi. yekadtem binchiray:
targum: Veayte sana al arachon utehe tzadya kishmitta uvechon abed fureanut dinin ad deagle yatchon meachsantechon dihavet lechon vetishtabedun levaale devavechon beara dela yedatun are kidum takif keeshta nefak min kodamay birgaz ad alma yechul:

rashi: Kol imrat eloah tzerufa. mezukkaka, velo chatav davar shello letzorech, vehaya li lizzaher:
targum: Kulehon memroy delaha tzerifan umesayea leilen demitrachatzin beh:

rashi: Yevakshu nafsho. leshon chibba, venire shekken hu, kema sheamar david leevyatar: "asher yevakkesh et nafshi yevakkesh et nafshecha" (Shmuel 1 22:23) – mi sheyyigmol li chesed yigmol lecha. veen happotrim modim li:
targum: Gavre deashdin dema sanyan temimuta uteritze bayan lah:

rashi: Veim mibben shishshim shana vegomer. keshemmaggia lime hazzikna, haishsha kerova lehechashev keish, lefichach haish pochet behizdakkeno yoter mishshelish beerko, vehaishsha enah fochetet ella shelish beerkah, deamre inshe "sava beveta, pacha beveta, savta beveta sima beveta vesimana tava beveta" (arachin 19):
Vechol erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh. kol erkecha shekkatuv bo shekalim, yihye veshekel hakkodesh:
Esrim gera. esrim maot, kach hayu mittechilla, uleachar mikkan hosifu shetut, veamru rabbotenu shesh maa kesef dinar, esrim vearba maot lesela (80 bechorot 50):
Mi ala shamayim. kemoshe (Shemot 19:3):
Mi asaf ruach. piach hakkivshan (Shemot 9:10):
Mi tzarar mayim. "kafu tehomot, nitztzevu chemo ned" (Shemot 15:8) bitfillato shel moshe:
Mi hekim. et hammishkan, shebbahakamato nitbassesu kol afse aretz. kach nidrash bappesikta (Pesikta rabbati 1,4):
Ma shemo uma shem beno. im tomar: kevar haya dugmato, emor: ma shem beno? ezo mishpacha yatza mimmennu, veneda mi hu?
Ki teda. im teda mi hu, veech lo yareta laavor al devarav?
targum: Man selek lishmaya unechet man achad rucha bechafnoy uman tzar maya beshushifa uman akem baryata deara man shemeh uman shum bereh in yedata:

rashi: Kearar. keetz yechidi; leshon "ariri" (Bereshit 15:2). veyesh omer: degashtih belaaz. umenachem peresh: shem etz meatze hayyaar varar shemo; vechen peresh "kearar bammidbar" (yirmeya 48:6): etz echad meatze hayyaar:
Baarava. leshon mishor:
Charerim. yovesh, kemo "chara minni chorev" (Iyov 30:30):
Eretz melecha. eretz shehi melecha velo tehe meyushshevet:
targum: Vihe keakkovita bemeshra vela yechze are yete tava veyishre bela velad bemadbera baara sedom dela ityatvat:

rashi: Ayye devar Adonai. happureaniyyot sheatta mitnabbe:
targum: Ha inun amrin li an deitnabbeta bishma dayya yitkayam kean:

rashi: Atz bidvarav. memaher venivhal lehashiv:
Tikva lichsil mimmennu. yesh lakkesil tikva yoter mimmennu:
targum: In chazayta gavra dimarkelin miloy sikkuya detav hu sachla mineh:

rashi: Veim ad elle. veim beod elle lo tishmeu:
Veyasafti. od yissurin acherim:
Sheva al chattotechem. sheva puranuyyot al sheva averot haamurot lemala:
ohc: Lo tishmeu li. tala haddavar bashshemia shehi hattora, ki hannimna sheyyachzeru bitshuva zulat al yede hattora.

Sheva al chattotechem. perush, leshiur chattotam shehem sheva midda keneged midda, veellu hem sheva averot: 1 – lo shamu, 2 – lo asu, 3 – bechukkotay maasu, 4 – mishpete hashshem gaalu, Adonai – monim acherim bilti asot, 6 – heferu berit, veachar sheyyisseram Adonai velo shamu lo vesagru shaare hatteshuva hare 7, uletaam ze anu meyashshevim maamaram zichronam livracha sheamru (rosh hashshana 16:) shelosha sefarim niftachim berosh hashshana vechulei benonim teluyim vechulei ad yom hakkippurim vechulei ad kan, perush, letzad shettala Adonai lahem laasot teshuva velo asu huchera mishkalam karshaim.

rashi: Ish af yegare madon. kemashmao. madon middat haddin:
targum: Gavra ragzana megareg tigre vegavra chemtana sagiin chovoy:

rashi: Bamotechem. migdalim uviraniyyot:
Chammanechem. min aza shemmaamidin al haggaggot, veal shem shemmaamidin bachamma, keruyin chammanim (sifra Vayikra 19):
Venatatti et pigrechem. tefuche raav hayu, umotziim yiratam mechekam umenashshekim otam, ucheresan nivkaat venofel aleha (sifra; sanhedrin 63):
Vegaala nafshi etchem. ze silluk shechina (sifra):
ohc: Vegaala nafshi vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar, ki peshita shettigal nafsho, shehare bizman shehem tzaddikim gemurim nitbarchu shello tigal nafsho (Vayikra 26:11), vehaddavar muvan shello tihye beracha zo noheget bime risham, veim ba lomar hafekiyyut habberachot, haya lo lomar hafekiyyut kol hashshear, ella vadday shello amar ella hoonashim shehem levad heder habberachot.

Venire shennitkavven lomar sheafillu beerech hatztzaddikim sheyyihyu bazzeman hahu tigal nafshi mehem, besod (Hoshea 4:5) "vechashal gam navi immecha". gam nitkavven shello yitnabbeu od beyisrael neviim, ki lo yofia Adonai shechinato hammityaches lah bechinat nefesh bahem. ukelala zo en kelala lemala mimmennu, velaze kevaah achar kamma kelalot. ha lamadta shehi gedola mimma shellefaneha, vehi shennitkayyema bazzeman hazze velah kalu enenu vedaava meod nafshenu, oy na lanu.

rashi: Vechol masar haaretz. bemaaser sheni hakkatuv medabber:
Mizzera haaretz. dagan:
Mipperi haetz. tirosh veyitzhar:

LaAdonai hu. kenao hashshem. umishshulchano tzivva lecha laalot veleechol birushalayim, kemo shenneemar (Devarim 14), veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha, masar degancha tiroshcha vegomer (80 kiddushin 54):

Veim et sede miknato vegomer. chilluk yesh ben sede mikna lisde achuzza, shessede mikna lo titchallek lakkohanim bayyovel, lefi sheeno yachol lehakedishah ella ad hayyovel, shehare vayyovel hayta atida latzet miyyado velashuv labbealim, lefichach im ba legoolah, yigal baddamim hallalu hakketzuvim lisde achuzza; veim lo yigal, veyimkerenna gizbar leacher, o im yigal hu bishnat hayyovel yashuv hassade laasher konehu meitto — oto shehikdish, ufen tomar "laasher kanahu" hallokeach hazze haacharon meitto, vezehu haggizbar, lechach hutzrach lomar laasher lo achuzzat haaretz — mirushshat avot, vezehu bealim harishonim shemmecharuha lammakdish (arachin 26):
Vehissig lachem dayish et batzir. sheyyehe haddayish merubbe, veattem asukim bo ad habbatzir, uvabbatzir taasku ad sheat hazzera (sifra):
Vaachaltem lachmechem lasova. ochel kima vehu mitbarech bemeav:
ohc: Vehissig lachem dayish vegomer. zo birkat hattevua achar shennitlesha, kederech amram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 42.) habba lamod garno yomar yehi ratzon vechulei, hare ki yesh birkat Adonai afillu achar sheasuy goren, vehu amro "vehissig lachem dayish", sheyyitrabbe hatztzomeach ad gevul ze. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat behar befasuk "veasat et hattevua" (Vayikra 25:21).
Vaachaltem vegomer lasova. zo birkat hammazon babbeten, keamram zichronam livracha (torat kohanim): ochel kima umitbarechet bemeav.

Od yirtze lomar, shello yimmashech lachem davar haragil lihyot bivne adam, ki yirbe tuvam umezonotehem shemmitmallet taavatam baze velo yaatzru koach lemechal lasova, ella "vaachaltem lachmechem lasova" – achila merubba kede sevia.
Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Megila 7.): "revacha livsume shechicha", vehu amro "vaachaltem vegomer lasova" – sheyyihye lachmechem arev kol kach sheafillu yihyu seveim yochluhu.
Od dikdek lomar lachmechem, sheenam tzerichin liftan lelappet bo et happat, ella hallechem levaddo arev lannefesh leechol mimmennu kede sevia:
Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (gittin 70.) achila gassa hu sam hammavet lagguf, vehivtiach Adonai sheyyochlu lachmam lasova afilu yihyu seveim yochlu velo yazzikum:

Od yirtze, letzad sheyyesh bapperot sheyyesh bahem shumman, keamram bammishna (sota moach.) taam happerot veshumman happerot. vehinne kol haochel sheyyesh bo shumman, adam ochel mimmennu umargish bichde sevia, ma sheen ken kol ochel sheen shumman, hagam sheyyochal adam umemalle bitno en hergesh hassova bemeav, veellu hem devarim hannirgashim lechol margish kayyadua. vehodia hakkatuv kan bemaamar vaachaltem lachmechem lasova, perush, afillu lechem levad hayyotze min haaretz yargishu baachilato hassova, ki yesh bo shumman hassoed levav enosh.

Vishavtem lavetach beartzechem. yirtze, ki letzad shekkol habberachot haamurot bainyan yecholin lehitkayyem veen tovatam tova, uchegon im hayu terudin bemilchamot veshana chorshim vezorim veshana en charish vekatzir umashlemet shana leshana, im ken en hekker labberacha, talmud lomar "vishavtem lavetach beartzechem" – en matrid etchem vechol shana veshana tihye lachem habberacha haamura. veamro beartzechem, perush, shekkol haolam yakkiru veyedu ki hi artzechem veen lezarim ittechem bah, uvaze lo yihye lachem afillu mechush veteshvu betach.
Od yirtze beamro vishavtem lavetach, perush shello titrechu attem bakkatzir uvabbatzir, ella zarim yaavdu veattem yoshvim bekatedra, veamro "lavetach" – sheen mechush al hakkinyan heyoto beyad ovdim.

rashi: Velo yire. haetz ki yavo chom:
Batztzoret. leshon raav 212 belaaz,.lashon acher: batztzoret leshon mivtzar, vechen chibbero menachem:
Lo yidag. lo yifchad:
targum: Vihe keilan dishtil al mabbua demayin veal nigrin yishlach shureshohi vela yecheze are yete choma vihon terafohi abbuf uvishnat betzureta la yittar vela yifsok milmebad perin:

rashi: Agur ben yake. divre shelomo sheagar et habbina vehekiah, kach pershuhu chachamim (tanchuma, vaere 5):
Hammassa. nevua zo amar al ken:

Neum haggever leitiel. amar haggever, ze shelomo, hammassa hazze al atzmo, bishvil itiel – al shessamach al chachmato leharebot zahav vesusim venashim shehuzehar milleharbot. vechen amar: itiel veuchol, arbe nashim velo yasuru et levavi, arbe zahav velo asur, arbe susim velo ashuv et haam mitzrayma (Devarim 17:16-17):
Leitiel veuchol. bishvil sheamar: itti el, veuchal laasot velo ekkashel. leitiel, al itiel, kemo "veamar paro livne yisrael" (Shemot 14:3) – al bene yisrael:
targum: Miloy deagur bar yake dekabbel neviuta veamar gavra leitiel leitiel veuchol:

rashi: Vehaya erkecha vegomer. en erech ze leshon damim, ella ben shehu yakar ben shehu zol, kefi shanav hu haerech hakkatzuv alav befarasha zo:
Erkecha. kemo erech, vechefel hakkafin lo yadati meeze lashon hu:
Ki tehillati atta. becha ani mithallel umitpaer lomar sheatta moshii:
Tehillati. 212 belaaz:
targum: Asyeni Adonai veettase ferokni veetperak are tushebachti at:

rashi: Im mishshenat hayyovel yakdish vegomer. im mishsheavra shenat hayyovel miyyad hikdishah, uva ze legoolah miyyad.
Keerkecha yakum. kaerech hazze haamur yihye — chamishshim kesef yitten:

Harari bassade. yerushalayim hayyoshevet bahar hammishor (yirmeya 21:13), kol seviv hair mishor, sade. velashon harari – kemo "aravi" (yeshaya 13:20), al shem sheyyoshev baarava; montinyersh belaaz, yoshve hahar (sefarim orchim yoshevet hahar):
Chelcha. kemo mamoncha (raa Devarim 8:17):
Bamotecha bechattat. bamotecha asuyot bechet leshem avoda zara bechol gevulecha:
targum: Al diflachtun al turaya bechakla nichsehon vechol bet ginzechon levaza emsar bechovin dahavitun palchin letaavata bechol techumechon:

rashi: Veish techachim. ish mezimmot, baal tora. verabbotenu (temura 16.; Vayikra Rabba 34,4) pershu: talmid sheamar larav hasheneni perek echad, umelammedo:
targum: Miskena vegavra matzaya pegiu chad bechad velaha manhir aynoy detarvehon:

rashi: Lo tivvasru li. lashuv elay:
Vehattorot. achat bichtav veachat beal pe, maggid shekkullam nittenu lemoshe besinay (sham):
Mikve yisrael. Adonai yoshev alav, lefichach kol ozvecha yevoshu:
Vesuray baaretz yikkatevu. otam shessarim middevaray, sheenam shomim shelichuti, bekivrot tachtiyyot eretz yikkatevu:
targum: Sibbur yisrael Adonai kol dishvaku pulechanach yivhatun ureshiaya daavaru al memrach begehinam inun atidin lemippal are shevaku pulechanach Adonai divdileh at mayte alehon yekara chemabbua demayin dela paskin mohi:

rashi: Pen yochiach becha venichzavta. yochiach al panecha, sheal yede tosaftecha atta ba lide avera, vechol shekken im tigra:
targum: La tosef al miloy dela yakkesinach vetitkadev:

rashi: Mefannek minnoar avdo. yetzer hara:
Manon. shallit, vechen "lifne shemesh yinnon shemo" (tehillim 72:17); vechen kol 'nin shebbammikra, shehannin kam tachat aviv lishlot binchasav:
targum: Mitpenek min talyuteh leavda neheve uveacharayteh yehe menasa:

rashi: Vehaya erkecha lefi zaro. lo kefi shavyah, achat sade tova veachat sade raa pidyon hekdeshan shave — bet kor seorim bachamishshim shekalim — kach gezerat hakkatuv, vehu shebba legoolah bitchillat hayyovel. veim ba legoolah veemtzao, noten lefi hacheshbon sela ufundeyon leshana, lefi sheenah hekdesh ella leminyan shenot hayyovel, sheim nigala hare tov, veim lav haggizbar mochrah baddamim hallalu leacher, veomedet beyad hallokeach ad hayyovel kishar kol hassadot hammechurot, ucheshehi yotza miyyado chozeret lakkohanim shel oto mishmar shehayyovel pogea bo, umitchalleket benehem, zehu hammishpat haamur bemakdish sade, veachshav afarshennu al seder hammikraot:
Berit rishonim. shel shevatim (sifra):
ohc: Veamro vezacharti lahem berit vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (torat kohanim) veze leshonam: minnayin shebberit keruta lashshevatim? dichtiv "vezacharti vegomer berit vegomer asher hotzeti" vegomer. veefshar lomar shennitkavven al derech amro (yirmeya 2:2) "zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat" vegomer, uchemo chen amar kan "vezacharti" vegomer – perush sheyyizkor Adonai laddor haacharon zechut dor rishon shennichnas bivrit im Adonai beahava rabba. uferesh mi hem harishonim baale berit veamar otam shehotzeti otam vegomer venitkaddesh beemtzautam elohim chayyim.
Chassalat parashat bachevaketay, salik sefer Vayikra

rashi: Kol cherem asher yochoram vegomer. hayyotze lehareg veamar echad erko alay, lo amar kelum (sifra; arachin 6):
Mot yumat. hare holech lamut, lefichach lo yippade — en lo lo damim velo erech:
Venatatti mishkani. ze bet hammikdash (sifra: eruvin 2):

Velo tigal nafshi. en ruchi katza vachem; kol geila leshon pelitat davar habbalua bedavar, kemo "ki sham nigal magen gibborim" (Shmuel 2 1) — lo kibbel hammeshicha, shemmoshchin magen shel or bechelev mevushshal kede lehachalik mealav makkat chetz o chanit, shello yikkov haor:
ohc: Venatatti mishkani betochchem. perush, al derech amro (Tehillim 78:60) "ohel shikken baadam", sheikkar mishkano yitbarach hu toch nishmot am kedosho.

Veamro velo tigal nafshi, velo hispik amro "venatatti mishkani", letzad shechash Adonai ki yomar na yisrael sheddavar ze shemmavtiach Adonai hu davar rachok mehassechel, sheyyadur dirat keva ruchani bilti baal tachlit haruchaniyyut toch bene adam baale tzura vechomer. vahagam ki yavtiach Adonai asot ken, ze yihye letzad otzem haahava yahafoch hatztzura, al derech ma shepperesh harashbi (Zohar 11 241.) befasuk "bati leganni vegomer achalti yari vegomer shatiti yeni" vegomer (Shir HaShirim 5:1), mashal lechatan vechulei, yeuyyan sham devarav. vehu davar hefech techunat hahishtauut, vedavar kaze lo yatmid kemaase nissim, veen muvtach lehatemadat haddavar, vetigal haruchaniyyut laggashmiyyut. laze amar velo tigal nafshi etchem, ki yechonen Adonai techunat nafsham beseder asher yishkon Adonai betocham kederech hammitkabbel bitchunat hannishtavve.

Vehosif lomar vehithallachti betochchem, lomar shemmillevad shello yigal, gam yihye lo nachat ruach behasheraat shechinato betoch tocham, vehi bechinat hanneshama shehi toch tocham. uferush "vehithallachti" hu tiyyul hearev. gam nitkavven al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha ki nishmot am bene yisrael chatzuvot meoro yitbarach, veharechakat shechinatam baolam hazze lo yesovev peredatah mimmekorah, vahare hi devuka bechevel hakkesef ad mekom machtzavah, vederech sham yored or hachayyim mimmakor elyon umechabber nefesh kedosha im mekorah. veze yesovev ki takkir hannefesh borah vetitav laavodato velalechet bidrachav. veal yede chet haadam nirtak chevel hakkesef velo yair or habba milmala toch hannefesh, vehu sod amro (Yeshayahu 59:2) "avonotechem hayu mavdilin benechem uven elohechem". veze yesovev sheyyekav haadam matamme hatteuv viabbed cheshko bammuskalot hanneimim vehaarevim. vehu maamar Adonai beamro vehithallachti betochchem, zo chevel hakkesef hammithallech meoro yitbarach toch nefesh adam, uvaze vehayiti lachem lelohim, ki ish kaze yivchar bekabbalat ol elohuto yitbarach. vetimtza shekkol nefesh hachotet baolam enah poelet hara bitchillatah ad shettakdim bechet kal mikkalle hakkallot, uvachato haadam afillu kechut hassaara yimmana mimmennu bechina zo shel hitkashsheruto bemadrega elyona. vetze ulemad mimmaase navot (Melachim 1 22), sheal yede sheamar devar sheker, hagam shehaya letachlit retzono yitbarach, af al pi chen Adonai amar elav "tze mimmechitzati" (shabbat kemet:). ucheshemmishtaddel hayyetzer im haadam bedikduk kal ad sheyyavdil beno uven Adonai, az hu sheyyachol lishlot bo lachato chataim gedolim rachamana litzlan, ma shello haya yachol asot kodem beet devekut haadam beor elyon.

Od nire lefaresh happarasha al ze hadderech, shehakkatuv medabber bahachanot olam hazze gam bischar olam habba, vehitchil bevirkat hallechem veamar venatatti gishmechem beittam, shehu hachanat hammazon vehapparnasa vehabbetach baaretz, keamro "vishavtem lavetach aleha". ad kan kalal kol hachanat olam hazze.

Veamro venatatti shalom vegomer, mikkan matchil gemul hannistar, vehu meet happereda meolam hazze shehu yom hammita, shehu hammadve haggadol asher belev kol chay, hakkos hammar hahu, hagam sheyyihye haadam shalem bechol shelemut haolam hazze, bezachro yom hammita vearva kol simcha, uma gam sheen lo gevul rachok sheen adam yodea yom kitztzo. asher al ken ba hammavtiach tovot leammo vesamach libbam gam bedavar ze, veamar ki beyom hannesia lo yecherad haish velo yirgaz kederech hammetim, ella yaase Adonai davar shettihye hannesia keadam sheshshochev vearva lo shenato.
