Vehu amro venatatti shalom, al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat 10.) ki shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu shalom, uveet petirat hatztzaddik yikrav oro yitbarach lifne haadam, vehu sod mitat neshika. uvaze yihye keshochev, vehu amro ushechavtem, kemo shenneemar baavot shechiva. vesod haddavar, ki hannefesh keshemmargeshet bikrivat or hanneerav etzlah, tichsof vetinnatek mimmekomah lehiddavek bashshechina, uleotzem hattaava yitrabbe haarevut al haregashat happereda velo targish bo, velo yishshaer hahergesh ella mehearev. veayyen ma shekkatavti bitchillat achare mot. vechol hassaga zo tesovev esek hattora vehammitzvot, vehu maamar hakkatuv (Kohelet 5:11) "metuka shenat haoved", hashshena hi yetziat hanneshama min hagguf, shehaoved et Adonai veosek battora uvammitzvot metuka lo yetziat hanneshama al ofen haamur. veamro veen macharid, hu malach hammavet hammacharid haadam biriyyato levad, uletzad sheyyesh tzaddikim sheyyizku lehiddavek nafsham bashshechina aval yakdim lahem malach hammavet lesibbat tachalue hannefesh lezakkechah beemtzaut tzaar hacharada, laze hivtiach ki kol ikkar lo yiru macharid.

Od yirtze amro venatatti shalom, sheyyitkayyem hagguf shehu bechinat haaretz velo yitpardu hayyesodot. vetze ulemad mimmaase rav achay bar yoshiyya (shabbat kinnev:) sheggashsheh rav nachman achar kamma shanim shemmet veraahu ki ish kayyam haya, ki Adonai yetzav layyesodot lehitkayyem yachad velo yitpardu, veze yusag meemtzaut hattora kemaamar (Mishlei 6:22) "beshachbecha tishmor alecha". veamro ushechavtem veen macharid al derech amram (Yeshayahu 57:2) "yanuchu al mishkevotam", shello tishlot rimma begufam lehacharidam bakkever. vetimtza shehatztzaddikim en rimma begufan, vetze ulemad mimmaase rabbi elazar ben rabbi shimon bar yochay (bava metzia 84.) vechaelle rabbot. vedavar ze hu yiud gadol sheyyanuach hagguf bakkever, sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat 13.) kasha rimma bivsar hammet kemachat bivsar hechay. veyesh lecha ladaat ki kol nivra yargish kefi shiur techunato asher konno yotzro.

Veamro vehishbatti chayya raa min haaretz, hu ruach hattuma hannikret chayya raa, shehi chiyyuniyyut ra, bechinat hattuma hashshora al hagguf achar mita, shellaze tzivva Adonai shehannogea bammet o hannichnas laohel yitma shivat yamim. hivtiach Adonai ki tasgil hattora vehammitzvot lehashebit ruach hattuma min hagguf. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (ketuvot 103.) yom shemmet rabbi batla tuma.

Veamro vecherev lo taavor beartzechem. natan hakkatuv taam lehashebatat hattuma, hu ki tuma zo ikkarah hu letzad shennishchat haadam becharbo shel malach hammavet happeguma, shebbaze naasa nevela, vehannevela metammea venishlechet lakkelev, dichtiv (Shemot 22:30) "lakkelev tashlichun", vehattuma hi bechinat hakkelev. aval haholchim betorat Adonai kammitztarech, "cherev lo taavor beartzechem", shehu gufo hannivne mehaaretz. mimmotza davar atta yodea shello yigga charbo shel malach hammavet begufo shel tzaddik. ad kan yiude happetira umenuchat hagguf.

Veamro uredaftem. mikkan matchil poal haruchaniyyut hannelam hammussag meesek hattora. da ki hitatztzemut esek hattora umaase hammitzvot hu levarer nitzotze hakkedushsha uleyached anafeha echad el echad, asher lesibbat achizat hakkelippot yimmana haddavar, besod amro (Yeshayahu 59:2) "avonotechem hayu mavdilim benechem" vegomer. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat yitro befasuk (Shemot 19:5) "vihyitem li segulla". veyityachasu hakkelippot beshem sonim veoyvim. veayyen ma shepperashti bemaamaram zichronam livracha befasuk (tehillim 92:10) "ki hinne oyvecha Adonai", veyeervu lecha divre elohim chayyim. vechan hodia hakkatuv ki beemtzaut esek hattora vehammitzvot yirdefu et oyvehem venaflu vegomer, vetovad hattuma, kemaamar (Zecharya 13:2) "veet ruach hattuma aavir" vegomer. veamro lecharev al derech amro (Shir HaShirim 3:8) "ish charbo al yerecho", veamru zichronam livracha (Tikkunei Zohar 7) shehashshomer berito leval nogea bema shello hursha, ze yesh koach bo lehamit uleabbed oyve Adonai beruach sefatav, velaze lo amar "becharev" ella "lecharev".

Veamro veradfu mikkem chamishsha mea, perush, mimma sheyyatza mikkem yirdefu chamishsha shehem chamishsha chumeshe tora, yirdefu mea haderagot hakkelippot, vehu al derech amro (Mishlei 16:26) "nefesh amel amla lo", veamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 99.) adam bemakom ze vetorato amela lo bemakom acher, sheosa killayon leoyve Adonai.

Veamro umea mikkem. perush al derech amram (menachot mag:) "ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach" vegomer (Devarim 10:12), al tikre "ma" ella "mea", shehem mea berachot. vehu amro umea mikkem, perush, shennaasim mikkem, shehem mea berachot bechol yom, revava yirdofu.

Vechazar lomar venaflu oyvechem vegomer lecharev, nitkavven lemaamar chazal sheamru (berachot 5.) kol hakkore keriat shema vechulei keillu ochez cherev pifiyyot vechulei, dichtiv "rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam" (tehillim 149:6). vehinne pasuk rishon ramaz bo yiud hamesubbav mehammaase, ufasuk sheni yiud hamesubbav mehaddibbur hammekuddash.

Veamro ufaniti alechem, peresh hakkatuv tachlit hahatzlacha habbaa mikkilyon haoyvim, veamar "ufaniti alechem", perush, keshezze nofel yippelu kol nitzotze hakkedushsha el sharsham, shehem kelalut yisrael hammekabbetzim otam. vechinna nitzotze hakkedushsha elav yitbarach letzad shehem chelek Adonai, uvaze yifru veyirbu. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 47:27) "vayyeachazu vah vayyifru vayyirbu meod", uma shepperesh hammaggid lemhryk befasuk "vayyamat yosef vegomer uvene yisrael paru" vegomer:
Od yirtze beamro ufaniti vegomer, ki behibbatel haoyev shehu masach hammavdil, kemaamar (Yeshayahu 59:2) "ki im avonotechem hayu mavdilim" vegomer, bahasarat hammasach az yifne veyidbak Adonai banu.

Od yirtze, ki kesheyyisrael yishtaddelu baddavar haamur, hagam sheyyeshno lammafsik bechelek echad, haadon yifne lanu mechelek hammufene, veyagdil veyarbe kochenu neged haoyev ad kelot hammasach, veaz "vahakimoti" vegomer.

Od yirtze ufaniti alechem al pi divrehem zichronam livracha bazzohar (zohar 11 303), ki shaashua hatztzaddikim sheen lemala mimmennu hu bachatzi layla hashsheni, shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev al kiso ben hatztzaddikim shebbegan eden, umesir pargod echad umegalle lahem or penimi hearev. ulerov hahishtokkut veotzem hafelagat hergesh haarevut lanneshamot ad shemmitallefim venoshrim mehem orot, vehem nefashot sheyyordot laolam hattachton lehair, yeuyyan sham devadav bezohar chadash (parashat balak). vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar "ufaniti alechem" shehu al shaashua haggadol umufla hannizkar. veamar leshon peniyya, letzad shehaadon baruch hu eno mishtanne, dichtiv (Malachi 3:6) "ani Adonai lo shaniti", ella shemmegalle meoro et asher yachpotz veyastir kefi ma sheenam reuyim lehassig. laze amar "ufaniti alechem" – lehair lemulechem or happenimi hannistar, yiru enechem veyismach libbechem.

Veamro vehifreti etchem, ramaz lenitzotzot hannoshrot mehem letzad hahitallefut kaamur. veamro vehirbeti etchem, perush shello tachshov ki letzad neshirat hanneshamot mehem yimat oram chas veshalom, laze amar "vehirbeti etchem", sheyyitrabbe adrabba orchem keor pene melech. vesod hanneshira ulay sheyyihye beechad mishshene hadderachim: o ki yirbe oram ad sheyyihye vehoter, o ki or hakkodem yiddache mippene or chadash, veyashan mippene chadash totziu, kasseder haamur bedivre hammekubbalim ki hammochin degadlut yidchu mochin dekatnut, venimtza hannosher mehem hu letzad hahitrabbut, vehu amro "vehirbeti etchem".

Od yirtze beamro vehirbeti etchem leshon rabbanut, vehu al derech amro "tihyu li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh" (Shemot 19:6), uferashnuhu sham shehigdilam al hammalachim kohane elyon, sheyyihyu hem kerove hammelech ugedole haelyonim. veamro "vahakimoti" – kan hivtiach al hattechiyya, shebberit keruta leshochne afar sheyyaale Adonai otam mikkivrotehem, veamar Adonai ki davka lelomde tora, al derech amram zichronam livracha (ketuvot ki:) "kol haosek betal tora tal tora mechayyehu". veulay ki hen hen haddevarim sheramaz beamro vahakimoti et beriti shehu hattora ittechem, ki battal asher yetzav Adonai et hattora hem chayyim.

Od nitkavven al derech amram (sanhedrin 90.) befasuk "asher nishbati latet laavotechem", shehaavot atzmam yaamdu lareshet et haaretz. vehu maamaro kan, sheotah berit shennishba Adonai lekayyem haaretz leolam vaed beyadam, kol hamekayyem tenay hakkatuv yechayyehu Adonai im haavot lekayyem beyado berit haaretz leolam vaed.

Od ramaz genizat hanneshamot bitzror hachayyim et Adonai, veyadua ki bechina hammityaches lah berit yityaches gam ken lah shalom, vehu amro vahakimoti et beriti shehu yesod olam hanneshamot ittechem. gam baze kalal ziuug chay haolamim bichneset yisrael shehi kelalut hanneshamot, vehammaskil yavin ki hu ze tachlit menuchat hanneshamot.

Veamro vaachaltem yashan noshan. kan ramaz lisudat olam habba sheyyatimem Adonai miyyayin hameshummar baanavav mishsheshet yeme vereshit, gam mibbesaro shel livyatan, veen lecha yashan noshan kaze shello kedamo davar baolam kodem livriat haadam:

Veamro veyashan mippene chadash totziu. millevad ma shepperashti bo lemala, yirmoz od al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (chagiga 12.) befasuk "veyimmana mershaim oram" (Iyov 38:15), ki or shebbo bara hakkadosh baruch hu maase vereshit genazo hakkadosh baruch hu latztzaddikim, lefi sheraa harshaim sheenam reuyim lehishtammesh bo vechulei, vehu amro "veyashan" shehu or shekkadam leor ze hechadash shennitchaddesh acharav, vehu amro "mippene chadash totziu", perush totziu mibbet genazav lehishtammesh bo.

Veamro venatatti mishkani vegomer. yirtze al derech maamaram zichronam livracha (bava batra 75.) sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehorid mishkan min hashshamayim, veyesh merabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru shehu mishshoham, veyesh merabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru miyyashfe, ucheamro (Shemot 15:17) "paalta Adonai mikkedash Adonai konnu yadecha", vehu amro venatatti mishkani betochchem, perush, mishkan shekkonnu yaday oridehu veettenehu betochchem, umeaz ad olam yaamod haddavar, keamro "velo tigal nafshi etchem", ki yaavir ruach hattuma min haaretz.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar 23:23) befasuk "kaet yeamer leyaakov" vegomer, shehammalachim mibbachutz vehatztzaddikim mibbifnim, vehammalachim shoalim et hatztzaddikim ma paal el, vehu amro venatatti mishkani betochchem, shello yihye machane hammalachim mafsik benechem uveni.

Veamro vehithallachti betochchem. al derech amro (Yoel 3:1) "venibbeu benechem uvenotechem", sheyyihye oro yitbarach mithallech betocham, vehu ruach hammenabbe, al derech amro (Bamidbar 11:29) "am Adonai neviim ki yitten Adonai et rucho alehem":

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (taanit lo.) atid hakkadosh baruch hu laasot machol latztzaddikim, veyeshev Adonai betocham, vechol echad yare beetzbao veyomar "ze eli veanvehu". vehu amro vehithallachti betochchem. veamar leshon halicha letzad sheyyithallech oro yitbarach lazun nishmot hayyoshvim sevivav yikkare halicha. veamro vehayiti lachem lelohim hu maamaram "ze eli veanvehu", veulay sheramaz leshon nave shehatztzaddikim atzman hem nave shel hakkadosh baruch hu shehu dar benehem. veamro veattem tihyu li leam sheyyihyu hem kerovim yoter mikkol tzeva hashshamayim.

Od yirtze beamro vehayiti lachem lelohim, letzad ki bazzeman hazze emunat elohuto hu mippi hanneviim. laze amar ki hinne yamim baim shekkol am Adonai yukkar lahem elohuto yitbarach, veyedu ki Adonai hu haelohim, vehu maamar "vehayiti lachem lelohim" – sheyyakkiru elohuto mitztzad atzmam. uletzad shehakkara zo yeshnah lechol hannivraim, dichtiv (Zecharya 14:9) "bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad", laze amar veattem tihyu li leam – hagam shehahakkara shava bakkol, lo yihyu lo leam ella am bene yisrael:

Veamro ani Adonai vegomer. yitbaer al derech maamar chazal (berachot 12.) befasuk "velo yeamer od chay Adonai asher heela et yisrael mimmitzrayim" vegomer (Yirmeyahu 23:7), shehakkavvana hi sheyyomru "chay Adonai asher heela yisrael meeretz mitzrayim umikkol haaratzot". vehu amro "ani Adonai vegomer asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim" – ze keneged yetziat mitzrayim, ucheneged "asher heela etchem mikkol haaratzot" amar "vaeshbor motot ullechem" vegomer. ulefi ma shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 20:2) "anochi Adonai elohecha asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim", yitbaer hakkatuv gam ken al haofen atzmo, yeuyyan sham.

rashi: Veim babbehema hattemea vegomer. en hammikra hazze musav al habbechor, sheen lomar bivchor behema temea ufada beerkecha, vachamor en ze, shehare en pidyon peter chamor ella tale, vehu mattana lakkohen, veeno lehekdesh, ella hakkatuv musav al hahekdesh, shehakkatuv shel mala dibber befidyon behema tehora shehummema, vechan dibber bemakdish behema temea levedek habbayit:
Ufada veerkecha. kefi ma sheyyaarichenna hakkohen:
Veim lo yiggael. al yede vealim:
Venimkar veerkecha. laacherim:
Velo lamadti chachma. velo daat kedoshim yadati, sheggarati o hosafti al divre moshe:
targum: Vela yelifet chachmeta vela yedaet yediata dekadishe:

rashi: Venatatti et arechem chorba. yachol meadam, keshehu omer vahashimmoti ani et haaretz hare adam amur, ha ma ani mekayyem charba? meover vashav:

Vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem. yachol min hakkarbanot, keshehu omer velo ariach hare karbanot amurim, ha ma ani mekayyem vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem? min haggedudiyyot — shayyarot shel yisrael shehayu mitkaddeshot venoadot lavo sham; hare sheva puranuyyot: achilat besar banim uvanot vehashemadat bamot hare shetayim — keritut chammanim en kan puranut, ella ay hashemadat habbiraniyyot yippelu hachammanim shebberashe haggaggot veyikkartu — venatatti et pigrechem vegomer hare shalosh, silluk shechina arba, churban arim, shimmon mikdash min haggedudiyyot, velo ariach karbanot, hare sheva:
ohc: Venatatti et arechem charba. perush, afillu yishshuv kishar ayarot laggoyim lo tihye, veze agmat nefesh gadol. gam ze yaggid bar minnan kilyon hattikva "tziyyon midbar hayata" vegomer (Yeshayahu 64:9), kol zeman sheyyisrael lo yetivu darchehem.

Vahashimmoti vegomer. perush – hasheraat hattuma vesimat shechunatah bevet hammikdash, ki hakkelippa tikkare shimmamon, uchevar hodiu hammekubbalim ki sham hirgia sheda veregel 100 dorechet al bet Adonai, asher al ze yikreu libbam vetaarog nefesh kol chay lemul baal habbira.
Velo ariach vegomer. perush, shello yitratztze bemaasehem hattovim sheggam lahem yityaches reach nichoach, uchemo chen amar yirmeya (Eicha 3:8) "satam tefillati".

rashi: Kol yeme hoshshamma. leshon heasot, umem dagesh bimkom kefel shemama:

Et asher lo shavta. shivim shana shel galut bavel hen hayu keneged shivim shenot hashshemitta veyovel shehayu bashshanim shehichisu yisrael beartzam lifne hammakom — arba meot usheloshim shana; shelosh meot vetishim hayu shene avonam mishshennichnesu laaretz ad sheggalu aseret hashshevatim, uvene yehuda hichisu lefanav arbaim shana mishsheggalu aseret hashshevatim ad charvot yerushalayim, hu shenneemar bichezkel "veatta shechav al tziddecha hassemali vegomer, vechillita et elle vegomer, veshachavta al tziddecha hayemani arbaim yom venasata et avon bet yehuda", unevua zo neemra lichezkel bashshana hachamishshit legalut hammelech yehoyachin, veod asu shesh shanim ad galut tzidkiyyahu, hare arbaim veshesh; veitto shenot menashshe chamishshim vechamesh hayu, menashshe asha teshuva sheloshim veshalosh shana, vechol shenot risho eshorim ushetayim, kemo sheamru beaggadat chelek, veshel amon shetayim, veachat eshore lihoyakim, uchenegdan letzidkiyyahu; tze vachashov learba meot usheloshim veshesh shana shemittin veyovlot shebbahem, vehem shesh esre lemea — arba esre shemittin ushenayim yovlot, hare learba meot shana shishshim vearba, lishloshim veshesh shana chamesh shemittot, hare shivim chaser achat, veod shana yetera, shennichnesa vashshemitta hammashlemet leshivim, vaalehem nigzar shivim shana shelemim, vechen hu omer bedivre hayamim (divrei hayamim 2 36), ad ratzta haaretz et shabbetoteha … lemallovt shivim shana (seder olam):
Ki vaar anochi. al shessamachti al chachmati bedavar shehakkadosh baruch hu daag, shemma yavo lide avera:
targum: Metul devura divne nasha ana dela it bi veyuna divne nasha:

rashi: Venatatti fanay. penay shelli — pone ani mikkol asakay lehara lachem:
Veradu bachem sonechem. kemashmao, yishletu vachem: aggadat tokko mipparasha zo:
Af ani eese zot. eni medabber ella beaf, vechen "af ani elech immachem bekeri" (pasuk 41):
Vehifkadti alechem. sheyyihyu hammakkot pokdot etchem mizo lezo, ad sheharishona fekuda etzlechem, avi acheret veesmechenna lah:
Behala. makka hamevahelet et habberiyyot, vee zo? zo makkat motan:

Et hashshachefet. yesh lecha adam shehu chole umuttal bammitta aval besaro shamur alav, talo "shachefet", shehu nishchaf, o ittim shehu nishchaf aval noach veeno makdiach, talo "veet hakkaddachat", melammed shehu makdiach, o ittim shehu makdiach aval savur hu veatzmo sheyyichye, talo "mechallot enayim", o hu eno savur beatzmo sheyyichye, aval acherim sevurim sheyyichye, talo "umedivot nafesh":

Uzeratem larik zarachem. zorah veenah matzmachat, umeatta ma oyvechem baim veochlim? talo "vaachaluhu oyvechem", ha chetzad? zorah shana rishona veenah matzmachat, shana sheniyya matzmachat, veoyvim baim umotzim tevua lime hammatzor, veshebbifnim metim baraav, shello likketu tevua eshtakad; davar acher: "uzeratem larik zarachem", keneged habbanim vehabbanot hakkatuv medabber, sheatta amel bahem umegaddelan, vehachet ba umechalle otam, shenneemar "asher tippachti veribbiti oyvi chillam" (Eicha 2):
Venatatti fanay bachem. kemo shenneemar battova "ufaniti alechem", kach neemar baraa "venatatti fanay"; mashlu mashal, lemelech sheamar laavadav, pone ani mikkol asakay veosek ani immachem leraa:
Veniggaftem lifne oyvechem. sheyyehe hammavet horeg etchem mibbifnim, uvaale devavechon makkifin etchem mibbachutz:

Veradu bachem sonechem. sheeni maamid sonim ella mikkem uvachem, shebbeshaa sheummot haolam omdim al yisrael, enam mevakkeshim ella ma shebbaggaluy, sheneemar "vehaya im zara yisrael veala midyan vaamalek uvene kedem vegomer vayyachanu alehem vayyashchitu et yevul haaretz" (Shoftim 6), aval beshaa sheaamid alechem mikkem uvachem, hem mechappesim achar hammatmoniyyot shellachem, vechen hu omer "vaasher achlu sheer ammi veoram mealehem hifshitu vegomer" (Micha 3):
Venastem. mippene ema:
Veen rodef etchem. mibbeli choach (sifra):
ohc: Venatatti fanay vegomer, hem pene zaam. vetaam keriat haddin panim, letzad shettamid omdim lifne Adonai kat hammasmeilim shehem kat hammashchitim, laze yikkaru pene Adonai, vaalehem amar "venatatti fanay". uvaze "veniggaftem lifne oyvechem" – hem haummot shehem anfe kochot hakkelippa. gam nitkavven bemaamar fanay lomar shello yastir panav mehem kesheyyimserem beyad oyvehem, sheim ken hem chas veshalom mechallim et hakkerem. vehu gilla retzono yitbarach besof hainyan "veaf gam zot vegomer lo meastim lechallotam" vegomer (Vayikra 26:44). veamar "bachem" lemaet bet hammikdash shello tishlot bo middat haddin techilla.

rashi: Kore dagar. kukuu gelunetznet belaaz:

Velo yalad. hakkore hazze moshech acharav efrochim shello yalad. dagar. tziftzuf shemmetzaftzef haof bekolo limshoch efrochin acharav, veellu shehakkore dagar lo yelchu acharav mishsheyyigdelu sheenam mino, kach ose osher velo vemishpat:
Yihye naval. "mitkere reshia" (targum yonatan):
targum: Ha kekoraa dimchanesh bein dela dileh umeshachen efrochin devatrohi la yehachun ken kol gevar reshia dikne nichsin dela vedina befalgut yomohi shevek lehon uvesofeh mitkere rashiaya:

rashi: Tachat hashshavet. keshebba leasseran, motzian bappetach ze achar ze, vehaashiri makke beshevet tzevua vesikra, lihyot nikkar shehu maaser, ken ose litlaim velaagalim shel kol shana veshana (28 58):
Yihye kodesh. likrav lammizbeach damo veemurav, vehabbasar neechol labbealim, shehare lo nimna im shear mattenot kehuna, velo matzinu sheyyehe natun besaro lakkohanim:

Veetchem ezare vaggoyim. zo midda kasha, shebbeshaa shebbene hammedina golim lemakom echad, roim ze et ze umitnachamin, veyisrael nizru chevammezare — keadam hazzore seorim benafa veen achat mehen devuka vachavertah (sham):
Vaharikoti. kesheshsholef hacherev mitroken hannadan; umidrasho cherev hannishmetet acharechem enah chozeret maher, keadam shemmerik et hammayim veen sofan lachazor (sifra):

Vehayta artzechem shemama. shello temaharu lashuv letochah, umittoch kach arechem yihyu charba — nirot lachem charevot, shebbeshaa sheadam gole mibbeto umikkarmo umeiro vesofo lachazor, keillu en karmo uveto charevim, kach shenuya betokko:
ohc: Veetchem azare vegomer. yitbaer hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet ketuvot (111.) shehishbia Adonai et yisrael shalosh shevuot, 1 shello yaalu bachoma, perush beyad chazaka, veechad shello yimredu beummot haolam vechulei ad kan, vehu maamar veetchem azare baggoyim kan ramaz lishne devarim, amro azare shello yaalu bachoma, baggoyim shello yimredu baggoyim, veamro vaharikoti acharechem charev yitbaer al derech sheggamar sham veze leshono: amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael, im attem mekayyemin hashshevua – mutav, veim lav ani mattir et besarchem kitzvaot ucheayyelot hassade, ad kan, vehu amro vaharikoti acharechem charev shettihye cherev meruta lifnechem, im lo tekayyemu gezerat zeruy baggoyim kannizkar yihye besarchem vegomer. veamro od vehayta artzechem vegomer chareva, hu netinat taam al haddavar lamma yachpotz Adonai bezeruy baggoyim, kede shettihye eretz shemama vearim charevot, kede sheaz tirtze haaretz vegomer, laze tzarich shettihyu attem beeretz oyvechem, vehu amro "veattem" vegomer:

rashi: Lifnechem lecharev. ish becherev reehu (sham):
ohc: Uredaftem et oyvechem. kashe, achar shehivtiach beshalom uvevitcha ma makom lomar ken? achen yirtze ki ma shehivtiach hu mimma shemmehaummot lahem shello yareu velo yashchitu, aval lo mimma shemmiyyisrael laummot. vezo hi ikkar nes hahavtacha, shello yomru ki hashshalom vehahavtacha hu sheggam hem lo yareu velo yashchitu laummot venimtzeu kegomlin, talmud lomar uredaftem vegomer, ki attem tirdefu otam uteabbedum, veaf al pi chen teshvu lavetach uveshalom velo taavor cherev beartzechem. uma shekkara otam hakkatuv oyvim, lo letzad shehem baim latzur al ir hakkodesh, sheim ken en betach veen shalom leyoshveha, ella kara otam oyvim letzad oyve Adonai, rishe haggoyim nikraim oyve Adonai veoyvenu, gam letzad sheyyodea Adonai ki chol haummot sone yisrael batteva hammitkanne, vehi sina yesodit veen lah temura.

Venaflu vegomer. amro lecharev, perush – tihye nefilat haoyvim lifne am Adonai keshiur hannefila asher tihye mehacherev. uvederech remez yirtze al derech amram bemaase nes bene chashmonay (yvesaypaven 22) sheraa malach sholef cherev neged haoyev, vehu ma sheramaz beamro venaflu vegomer lecharev, perush – hannishlaf mehammalach.

rashi: Veim kol behema temea. bevaalat mum hakkatuv medabber, shehi temea lehakerava, velimmedcha hakkatuv sheen kadashim temimim yotzin lechullin befidyon ella im ken hummemu (sham 33):

Mimmaasro. velo mimmasar chavero — happode maaser shel chavero en mosif chomesh, uma hi geullato? yifdennu kede lehattiro vaachila vechol makom, vehammaot yaale veyochal virushalayim, kemo shenneemar (Devarim 14), venatatta bakkasef vegomer (80 kiddushin 24):

Beachor yeshabbechenna. kesheyyotzi hakkesil kol rucho, ba hechacham veyashpilennu bemaane leshono. vedome lo "mashbiach sheon yammim" (tehillim 65:8); "beso gallav atta teshabbechem" (tehillim 89:10):
targum: Kola chumeteh mappik sichla vechakkima berayana maacha:

rashi: Ki yavin veen maane. kevan sheroehu shemmochicho, shotek, vehu chozer umekalkel; lechach tzarich leyassero bemakkot veonshin. velo dibber al eved mammash, ella al kol hammamrim divre hashshoftim:
targum: Bemile la mitrede avda deyada gir vela velia:

rashi: Veim bechukkotay timasu. moes baacherim haosim:
Mishpatay tigal nafshechem. sone hachachamim:
Levilti asot. monea et acherim measot:
Et kol mitzvotay. kofer shello tzivvitim, lechach neemar "et kol mitzvotay" velo neemar "et kol hammitzvot":

Lehaferchem et beriti. kofer baikkar; hare sheva averot, harishona goreret hashsheniyya, vechen ad hashsheviit, veellu hen: lo lamad, velo asa, moes baacherim haosim, sone et hachachamim, monea et haacherim, kofer bammitzvot, kofer baikkar:
ohc: Veim bechukkotay vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar "veim" velo samach al "veim" sheamar bitchillat hainyan? od amro bechukkotay shehaya tzarich lomar "veim chukkotay timasu", ki al shelilatam lo tikkon habbet, kemaamar "veim et mishpatay" hassemucha lah. od lamma chazar paam sheniyya lomar "veim"? od lamma lo kalal hakkatuv yachad chukkim umishpatim veyomar "veim chukkotay umishpatay timas o tigal" vegomer? od lamma yiched hakkatuv hammeisa lachukkot ugeilat nefesh lammishpatim? od achar shehizkir meisa ugeila ma tzorech lomar "levilti asot", uma gam shekkatav lemala "velo taasu et kol hammitzvot"? vahagam shepperashnu bo beechad mehadderachim shehu hemshech mimma shekkadam elav, im kol ze yitchayyev yishshuv mashmaut hakkatuv. od ma hu kavvanat amro "lehaferchem" vegomer?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu keneged pittuy yetzer hara hamefatte levattel mitzvot lo taase, veyitchakkem lehatechil leharechik middaat adam mitzvot shehem chukka belo taam beechad mishshene derachim: o yomar elav ki lo yeamnu haddevarim sheyyomar otam elohe olam, o yomar lo yihye shennaamin sheamaram – en haddevarim kifshatan, velo yechavven el hannishma mehem. uchesheyyatte adam azno ledivre hammesit, az yosif ledabber elav gam bemitzvot sheyyesh lahem taam bemitzvot Adonai, veyihye hannakel avro pi Adonai bechol shehu mitteamim pegumim sheyyare lo, kevan shennitrachek mehakkedushsha. uvaavera asher hayyetzer lo yimtza lah taam, yachzor lehochiach meotam haaverot shekkevar hushrash ze haadam laavor alehem, veyomar elav: "emor na li ma ra veonesh higgiacha al asher avarta al kamma averot sheasra tora?" velo yazkirehu sibbat techillat avro alehem shehayta betaana hannishmaat lo behoraot hayyetzer elav, veyitammetz immo beezer taava haggoveret alav veyaavor pi Adonai. veachar sheavar pi Adonai paam ushetayim, hinne yavo od betaana hahogenet lo ki yoter yekal mealav haonesh im yihye mumar veyichpor bakkol, sheaz lo yaanishehu lemala im yavo lichlal haonesh ella al avon echad shehemir vehefer berit shennishba behar sinay, ma sheen ken zulat ze yihye neenash al kol perat uferat.

Ucheneged haderagot hammesit ba hakkatuv veamar al rishon rishon, shehitchil lefattot bemitzvot shehem chukka, veim bechukkotay shehem mitzvot sheen bahem taam, kemaamar chazal (Bamidbar Rabba 19) shehassatan veummot haolam omrim: "ma mitzva zo uma taam yesh bah?" laze dikdek lomar bechukkotay bet hassibba, lomar ki letzad shehem chukkot timasu otan utekabbelu divre hayyetzer. veamar "veim" lomar shehi haderaga acheret shehu bittul gam mitzvot lo taase, gam lomar shekkol achat keday leatzmo lehavi onesh haamur bainyan.

Ucheneged pittuy sheni shel hayyetzer amar veim et mishpatay, shehem mitzvot sheyyesh bahem taam, tigal nafshechem . vetaam sheshshinna mehaamur bachukkim ledarkenu yesh taam nachon, ki hachukkim heder hattaam hu asher sibbev hammeisa bahem, ma sheen ken mishpatim yishre taam, sibbatam hi letzad shennafsham chamda asot ra, lo letzad sheen taam bammitzva. laze amar "tigal nafshechem", velaze lo amar gam ken "bemishpatay" kemaamar "bechukkotay".

Od yirtze beamro tigal, al pi maamar hachasidim behavechanat haadam et nafsho ladaat ma hi, im omedet begeder tov o nefesh temea, ki yukkar haddavar kefi taavat hannefesh asher titte asot, yeuyyan devarav besefer hayyashar lert (sear 9). hu maamar "tigal nafshechem", ki hannefesh harshaa tigal kiyyum hammitzvot vetivchar asot ra letzad cholaim shebbah shehu bechinat ra, kemaamar razal (berachot 61.) reshaim yetzer hara shoftan. vehu ma sheggamar omer levilti asot et kol mitzvotay, ki hannefesh hallezu tigal kol anfe hakkedushsha. veamro lehaferchem keneged pittuy haacharon shel yetzer hara sheomer elav hafer berit vehamer kevodcha lehakel haonesh, uva hakkatuv veyied onesh shalem beshave gam laze, uvittel taanat hammesit bifrat ze, uchemaamar hannavi (Yechezkel 25:8) "hinne kechol haggoyim bet yehuda" vegomer, vehayta hatteshuva laze (Yechezkel 20:33) "im lo bechema shefucha emloch alechem".

Od yitbaaru hakketuvim al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar 9 100.) sheshshelemut avodat Adonai hu beemtzaut shelosha devarim: machshava, dibbur, maase. laze keshekkafal Adonai hattenay amar zichron shelashtam: keneged haddibbur amar veim lo tishmeu keneged esek hattora shehu hahiggayon, ucheneged hammaase amar velo taasu vegomer, ucheneged hammachshava amar veim bechukkotay timasu, vedavar ze yeshno bammachshava. uletzad shehammachshava yeshnah bammoach uvallev, laze amar keneged hammoach "timasu", ucheneged hallev amar "tigal nafshechem", ki hannefesh hu ballev kayyadua.

Od efshar shehakkatuv yedabber keneged hadderagot sheyyihyu bichlalut am bene yisrael, vehem shalosh kittot: haechad hem gedole yisrael haomdim al hattora veal haavoda, ucheneged kat zo amar veim lo tishmeu li vegomer, ki hakkat hatztzaddikim tzerichin ledakdek bemitzvot Adonai ulekayyem kol hattora, veim yezalzelu afillu beanaf katan hare ze mitchayyev benafsho, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (yoma 86.) veze leshonam: hechi dame chillul Adonai? kegon ana demasgena arba ammot belo tzitzit utefillin uvelo tora. uchenegdam amar hakkatuv veim lo tishmeu li, perush, lehishtaddel beesek hattora lishmah, velo taasu et kol hammitzvot kelalotehem uferatotehem vedikdukehem, shechesron meat yechashev lezadon gadol. veyesh kat acheret sheenam bene tora aval hem muskalim veyodim hakkarat hattov vehayyashar, kenegdam amar veim bechukkotay timasu, ki leellu yaanish hakkatuv afillu al bittul mitzvot sheen bahem taam veyechashev lahem lizdonot, aval al bittul haddikdukim shenneenashim alehem gedole yisrael lo yassigem kemo chen haonesh. veyesh kat acheret shehem hassechalim shebbeam yisrael shello tassig yediatam lehacheriach kiyyum hachukkim shebbattora, uchenegdam amar veim et mishpatay tigal nafshechem, ki ellu lo yeanshu onesh gadol haamur bainyan ella al bittul hammishpatim shehem musbarim lesechel enosh, aval al hachukkim, veen tzarich lomar haddikdukim sheyyeanshu alehem gedole yisrael, niddonim bahem keshoggim ucheshotim haanusim sheansham kal ad meod.

Livleti asot. kan rasham Adonai tenay, shello yavi kol haonesh haamur ella im odam maskimim bedatam lalechet bedarche hara "livleti asot" vegomer, aval im datam lachazor, o hagam sheen datam lachazor ella shehaadon baruch hu yodea sheyyachzeru bitshuva, yaarich Adonai appo lahem ad shuvam elav, velo yavi alehem et haraa hakketuva.

Lehaferchem et beriti. nitkavven lehatenot od shello yavi kol haonesh ella laover lehacheis, keamro "lehaferchem et beriti", aval laover leteavon lo yavo lichlal hoonashim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (torat kohanim): "veim lo tishmeu" vegomer – yesh adam sheeno lomed aval ose, talmud lomar "velo taasu", yesh adam sheeno lomed velo ose aval eno moes baacherim, talmud lomar "bechukkotay timasu" vegomer, kol sheeno lomed eno ose, umoes baacherim haosim, vesone talmide chachamim dichtiv "tigal nafshechem", ulevassof eno manniach acherim laasot dichtiv "levilti asot", ulevassof kofer baikkar dichtiv "lehaferchem" vegomer, ad kan. hinne ledivrehem zichronam livracha lo yavo onesh haamur ella ad sheyyaggiu laggader haacharon shekkofer baikkar. vetaam shello amar hakkatuv gader haacharon levad, ba lehodia sibbat hassibbot shettesovev laadam lavo lemidda zo haacharona, umimmashmaut haddevarim taskil ki behikkashel barishona yitgalgel veyered matta matta ad midda haacharona. umeatta yuvan maamar hannavi (yirmeya 9:12) "al ma avda haaretz al azvam et torati" shehi sibba harishona shemmimmenna yatzu kol peratim haraim rachamana litztzelan.

rashi: Ki shemi Adonai. kemashmao: moshel veshallit lekayyem gezerati (Vayikra Rabba 24, 1):
targum: Bechen ha ana mechave lehon bezimna hada achavinun yat pureanuti veyat mechat gevureti veyedun are shemi Adonai:

rashi: Adonai uzzi umauzzi umenusi. antifoyymant belaaz, umenachem chibbero leshon pele, kemo "natatta lireecha nes lehitnoses" (tehillim 60:6), vechen "Adonai nissi" (Shemot 17:15). vedonash patar oto leshon manos mammash:
Elecha goyim yavou. sof haummot lashuv elecha uleavdecha shechem echad (Tzefanya 3:9); veammecha, ech asu lahem elohim vehemma lo elohim?!
Meafse. kemo "mikketze" (yirmeya 12:12):
Nachalu. leshon nachala:
Moil. leshon toelet:
targum: Adonai tukefi veruchetzani umeshezvi beidan aka leshema gevuretach ammin yetun misyafe ara veyemrun beram leshikra pelachu avahatana lilma velet behon hanaa:

rashi: Kol asher yitten mimmennu. amar raglah shel zo ola, devarav kayyamin, vetimmacher letzarche ola, vedameha chullin chutz middeme oto haever (sifra; arachin Adonai):

targum: Besugea derashie chova nisge vetzadikaya yechemun bemappaltehon:
Shalita detzaet mile deshikra kulhon meshumshanoy rashie:
Haefshar deyabed leh enash dachalan veinun taavan delet behon tzeroch:
Kidnan amar Adonai istamaru benafshatchon vela titlun matul beyoma deshabbeta vetealun betare yerushelem:
Redi vivrach veyanichach veyitten tafnuke lenafshach:
Vela tifkun mattul mibbattechon beyoma deshabbeta vechol avidta la tabedun utekadshun yat yoma deshabbeta kema defakdet yat avahatchon:
Vetemar lehon kabbilu pitgama dayya malchaya devet yehuda vechol devet yehuda vechol yatve yerushelem dealin betaraya hailen:
Malka dedaen bekusheta lemiskene kureseh laalam takin:
Ana Adonai chakar libba bechar kuleyata ulemittan leenash keorchateh kefere ovadohi:
Berich gavra deitrechetz bememra dayya vihe memra dayya rochtzaneh:
Keden amar Adonai li ezel utekom bitra bene ama deyaalun beh malchaya devet yehuda udeyifkun beh uvechol tare yerushelem:

bart: Lirshut habbaal. kegon shemmasar haav lishluche habbaal vaadayin hi vadderech, tu lo karena vah bet aviha:
Leotah mita. shehayu mechayyevin et hanniddon:
Uvoalah. kelomar, vechol habboalim niddonim kemitat hannivelet, chutz mibboel bat kohen, shehi visrefa vehu vechenek:

Reuya leaviv. shava vedoma leaviv bekol bemare vekoma. dichtiv enennu shomea bekolenu, middelo chetiv bekolotenu, shema minna kol echad lishnehem. umidkol bainan shavim, mare vekoma nammi bainan shavim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Giddem. yado ketua:
Benenu ze. mashma shemmarin oto:

Chershim. im amar lahem eni mekabbel mikkem enam shomim oto. veaf al pi sheroim achar kach sheeno mekayyem mitzvatan, mikkol makom hattora amra enennu shomea bekolenu, demashma devishat hakkol kaamri delo shama, sheshshemauhu sheamar eni mekabbel mikkem:

Umatrin bo bifne shelosha. hachi kaamar, umatrin bo bifne shenayim shello yargil. veim lo shama, malkin oto vevet din shel shelosha, keditnan beferek kamma, makkot bishlosha. divyisseru oto haamur beven sorer umore malkot hu, ketiv hacha (Devarim 21) ben sorer umore, uchetiv hatam (sham 25) vehaya im bin hakkot harasha:
Ze hu shellaka bifnechem. veaf al gav demibbae leh ze velo sumin, i ita dilhach milleta lechod ata, leze hu shellaka bifnechem, lichtuv benenu hu, may benenu ze, shamat minna tarte:
Veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton patur. kevan deillu avid hasheta lav bar ketala hu:
Veim mishshennigmar dino barach. have chegavra ketila vechayyav afillu leachar kamma shanim:
Ellu hen hannechenakin. mamre al pi vet din. shemmesarev al divre vet din haggadol shebbelishkat haggazit:

Vezomme vat kohen. af al pi shehem baim lechayyevah serefa, en niddonim ella vammita shehayu mechayyevim et boalah shehu vechenek, kishar habba al eshet ish, dichtiv (Vayikra 21) hi baesh tissaref, hi velo voalah. vezommeha yalfinan mikkaasher zamam laasot leachiv, velo laachoto:
Uvoalah. levat kohen keshehi nesua. aval arusa, hi uvoalah biskila:
Shehamekallel leachar mita chayyav. dichtiv (sham 20) aviv veimmo killel, ukera yetera hu lerabbot leachar mita:
Vehammakke leachar mita patur. deha lo michayyav ad sheyyaase vo chabbura, veen chabbura leachar mita:
Ad sheyyachnisennu lirshuto. dichtiv (Shemot 21) venimtza veyado, veen yado ella reshuto, vechen hu omer (Bamidbar 21) vayyikkach et kol artzo miyyado:
Veyishtammesh bo. tashmish sheyyesh bo shave feruta. vetanna kamma mechayyev afillu vetashmish shehu fachot mishshave feruta. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Haggonev et beno. taamayhu derabbanan defatre, dichtiv venimtza veyado, ukera yetera hu, deha chetiv (Devarim 24) ki yimmatze ish, ella lemidrash minna perat laze shehu matzuy. vahalacha kachachamim:

Rabbi yehuda mechayyev. dichtiv (sham) meechav mibbene yisrael, meechav limute avadim, mibbene yisrael, i chatav bene yisrael hava memaatinan mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, hasheta dichtiv mibbene yisrael, miuta acharina, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot. verabbanan savre, meechav lav limute avadim, deha achim hem bammitzvot, ella bene yisrael limute avadim, mibbene yisrael limute mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ven chorin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Haose maase. mammash, biskila:
Velo haochez et haenayim. mare labberiyyot keillu ose, veeno ose chelum:

Shenayim loktim kishshuim. bimchashshefut befanenu, echad mehen lakat vechayyav mita, vachavero lakat ufatur min hammita. ketzad, haose maase shellakat mammash bichshafim, chayyav. vehaochez et haenayim, hera lanu keillu nitkabbetzu chullan lemakom echad vehakkishshuim lo zazu mimmekoman, patur min hammita:

Velo vevet din shebbeyavne. shaalu levet din shebbelishkat haggazit veamru lo, vechazar leiro veshaha sham yamim rabbim ad sheggalta sanhedri gedola leyavne veachar kach hora chevattechilla, en memitin oto veyavne, af al pi shessanhedre gedola sham, veaf al pi sheadayin habbayit kayyam, kevan shessanhedre gedola enah yoshevet bimkomah belishkat haggazit:
Ketzad megallechin et hannatek. besof shavua rishon (lehesgero) shello fasa velo nolad bo sear tzahov (ketiv vehitgallach):
Haya megalleach chutza lo. megalleach saviv lannetek,

Umanniach shete searot. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) veet hannetek lo yegalleach, vechi ma yesh bo, vahalo chevar nittak hassear venafal, ella samuch lannetek lo yegalleach, shemmeshayyer saviv lannetek shete searot mikkol tzad, nimtza hannetek mukkaf searot kaatara:
Hechlito vesear tzahov. veachar shehuchlat bo halach sear tzahov veachare chen chazar:
Vechen befisyon. shello chazar sear tzahov ella sheppasa. ben kach uven kach hare hu muchlat kemo shehaya:

Battechilla besof shavua rishon. kelomar, din ze sheamarnu noheg ben shehechlito vesear tzahov battechilla keshehuva el hakkohen, ben shehechlito vesear tzahov besof shavua rishon, o besof shavua sheni, o leachar happetur, kegon sheamad beenav shene shavuot ufetaro uleachar happetur nolad sear tzahov vehechlito. uvechullehu halach sear tzahov vechazar, o shello chazar ella sheppasa hannetek, hare hu kemo shehaya:
Hechlito befisyon. kemo shemmefaresh behechlito besear tzahov kach yesh lefaresh hechlito befisyon. vehacha befisyon lo garsinan battechilla, sheen happisyon metamme ella achar hesger:

Ketzad meabberin. leshon ishsha meubberet shekkeresah bolet. vehachi kaamar, ketzad yesh lah ibbur lair, im bayit nichnas bayit yotze vechulei. keshebba letzayyen siman techum hair uva limdod alpayim chutza lah, im lo hayta chomatah chalaka ella battim semuchin umechubbarim, veyesh bayit nichnas letoch hair yoter mechavero veniret kenisato peguma, veyesh bayit bolet veyotze lachutz yoter mechavero:
O pagum nichnas pagum yotze. sheyyesh migdalim boltim bachoma, peamim boltim lifnim peamim lachutz:
O shehayu sham. leachat hakkeranot shel ir:
Gedudiyyot gevohot. shivre choma shel charvot battim, veyeshnan toch shivim amma veshirayim lair:
O nefashot. binyan sheosin al hakkever. vehu sheyyehe bahen bet dira:

Motziin et hammidda chenegdan. im habbelitot hallalu etzel keren mizrachit tzefonit, roim keillu yesh od belita acheret kenegdah bekeren mizrachit deromit, vechut matuach mizzo lazo, umoded min hachut velachutz, kede sheyyehe hattechum shave lishte hakkeranot velo yihye kan aroch vechan katzar:
Veosin otan. hattechumin. merubbaim, sheyyehe alpayim latztzedadim kevaemtza. velo agullim, sheyyehe lahen alpayim baemtza, uvatztzedadim hem mitmaatim kederech davar agol:
Veachar kach halcha lah hammichya. sheppasa hannega aleha. aval bishat happericha lo halcha lah michya ad achar kach. [aval lo nitkasset hammichya], en happericha metaharto:

En moddin ella min hammumche. adam habbaki bimdida. vegaon peresh mumche leshon umacha al [katef] yam kinneret (Bamidbar 34), kelomar shemmitkavvenim limdod hattechumin lechattechilla min hammakom hashshave vehayyashar kede shello yehe tzarich lekadder:
Ribba lemakom echad umiet lemakom acher. shennimtzeu simane techum zo arukkin uvoltin mikkeneged simane techum keren shekkenegdah:
Shomin limkom sheribba. umotziin middat hakketzara kenegdah, mippene shello matach mittechilla hachevel kol tzarko. vetanya battosefta shehu tzarich lematcho bechol kocho:
Ribba leechad umiet leacher. hachi kaamar, ribba echad umiet acher, shemmaddu shene bene adam mumchim, ze ribba veze miet:
Happoreach min hattame tahor. tame shennechlat beechad min hannegaim, veachar kach parcha vechullo, tahor:
Chazru vo rashe evarim. im leachar happericha chazru venitgallu afillu rashe evarim bilvad:
Tame. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) uveyom heraot bo basar chay yitma. vehu sheyyerau chaadasha:
Ad shettitmaet bahareto mikkaggeris. sheyyelech kol hannega velo yishtayyer bo chaggeris:

Mittahor tame. tahor shepparcha tzaraat bechullo, kegon shehechlito vesear lavan o vemichya venashar sear lavan o nitkasset hammichya, ufetaro, i nammi hisgiro bevaheret kaggeris veamad beenav shene shavuot ufetaro, bechol hane im achar peturo parcha vechullo, tame:

Ad shettachazor lichmot shehayta. deim nishtayyer min happericha kol shehu samuch laom, tame mishshum pisyon. veha ditnan besamuch sheim halcha michya veachar kach parcha vechullo, tahor, utenan nammi baheret uvah sear lavan parcha vechullo af al pi shehassear lavan bimkomo, tahor, umashma vechol shekken im eno vimkomo shehu tahor, hatam mayre shello fetaro hakkohen adayin keshepparcha vechullo, vehacha mayre kesheppetaro veachar kach parcha vechullo:
Zo lifnim mizzo. penimit petucha lachitzona vechitzona lirshut harabbim, uderisat ragleha shel penimit al chitzona latzet lirshut harabbim:
Erva penimit. beatzmah letaltel bachatzerah:
Shetehen asurot. dehavya penimit beatzmah regel haasura bimkomah, shehare lo erva leatzmah, veoseret bidrisat ragleha al hachitzona:
Zo mutteret leatzmah vechulei. deregel hammutteret bimkomah enah oseret:
Rabbi akiva oser. deka savar af regel hammutteret oseret keshello erva sham:
Vachachamim omrim kulei. dekasavre afillu regel haasura bimkomah, kegon keshello erva happenimit leatzmah, enah oseret al hachitzona. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Hakkarachat vehaggabbachat. shetehen barosh, ella shemmishshippua kadkod velaachorav karuy karachat, mishshippua kadkod kelappe fanav karuy gabbachat, keditnan besamuch. veenam kannetakim, shehannetek chozer umegaddel sear, vehakkarachat vehaggabbachat enan chozrin umegaddelin sear:
Mittammeot bishne shavuot. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) kemare tzaraat or basar, ma or basar bishne shavuot, af kan bishne shavuot:
Uvemichya uvefisyon. dichtiv (sham) tzaraat porachat hi bekarachto. tzaraat, melammed shemmittammea vemichya. porachat, melammed shemmittammea befisyon. hi, melammed sheenah mittammea besear lavan:
Neshem. sam shehaochlo eno megaddel sear, vehassach bo eno megaddel sear:
Makka sheenah reuya legaddel sear. kegon makka gedola shehabbasar naase tzalleket:
Pikka shel tzavvar. hi chulya harishona shel tzavvar:
Veen posot mizzo lazo. mikkarachat legabbachat umiggabbachat lekarachat:
Im yesh sear. mafsik benehen ben karachat legabbachat. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veniktzetza tehora. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) kol yeme asher hannega bo yitma, velo yamim shehayta vo vaheret veniktzetza:

Ketzatzah mitkavven. battosefta muchach dehecha dekatzatz kol habbaheret vekatzatz min habbasar asher sevivoteha immah, kulle alma lo felige deen lo tohora olamit, diknasuhu rabbanan meachar shennitkavven lesharesh achareha. vehecha diktzatzah veshiyyer mimmenna chol shehu, kulle alma lo felige deyesh lo tohora bifricha, kevan deshiyyer mimmenna lo kenasuhu chulle hay. ki felige, keshekketzatzah metzumtzemet habbaheret kemo shehi lo fachot velo yoter:

Rabbi eliezer omer lichsheyyivvaled lo nega acher veyithar mimmennu vachachamim omrim ad shettifrach bechullo. vahalacha kachachamim. hacha lo garsinan bemilletayhu dachachamim o ad shettitmaet baheret mikkaggeris, dedavka gabbe tolesh simane tuma deresha venishara habbaheret, hatam shayyach lemitne ad shettitmaet mikkaggeris, aval hacha hare niktzetza chol habbaheret:

Veim hayta verosh haarla yimmol. lav bemila vizmannah ayre, deha milleta difshita hi, hasheta shabbat deissur sekila dachya, tzaraat deissur lav gereda lo chol shekken, ella afillu mila shello vizmannah sheenah docha et hashshabbat, docha et hatztzaraat, deate ase demila vedache et lo taase detzaraat, dehachi kayma lan bechol hattora chullah, kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase, im atta yachol lekayyem et shenehem, mutav. veim lav, yavo ase veyidche et lo taase:
Shehu shuttaf im shechenav. shebbammavoy, leshem shuttafut bealma velo leshem eruv:

Enam tzerichim learev. vehu sheyyihyu kullan shuttafin bichli echad. vedavka shittufe mevoot havu beyayin keditnan bakkol mearvin umishtattefin, aval eruve chatzerot en mearvin ella befat, deeruv mishshum dira hu, vedira shel adam en libbo nimshach ella befat. veim shittef shittufe mevoot befat kol shekken dechashiv tefe vesomchin al oto shittuf shel pat bimkom eruv veenam tzerichim learev eruve chatzerot, aval im nishtattefu beyayin o bishar devarim tzerichim learev eruve chatzerot veen somchin al hashshittuf, kede shello tishtakkach torat eruv min hattinokot:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Habba vammachteret. sheamra tora yehareg:
Niddon al shem sofo. shessofo laharog et baal habbayit im yaamod kenegdo lehatztzil et shello:
Im yesh lo damim chayyav. kegon haav habba vammachteret al habben, beyadua sherachame haav al habben, lefichach en habben rashshay lehargo. veim shavar haav hechavit, chayyav leshallem:

En lo damim patur. ushear kol adam habba vammachteret sheim harago vaal habbayit en lo damim, im shavar et hechavit patur milleshallem. shekkevan shehu mitchayyev benafsho patur min hattashlumin, sheen adam met umeshallem:
Baheret. kaggeris:
Uvah sear lavan. ha ka mashma lan difricha metaheret achar kol simane tuma:

Parcha vemiktzato, tame. itzterich leashmeinan afillu farcha verubbo, delo amrinan rubbo kechullo. i nammi ashmeinan divsof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni tame bifrichat miktzato afillu vechol shehu mishshum pisyon:
Rabbi yehuda metamme. keditnan leel derabbi yehuda metamme hafuch velo hafuch:

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer lo metamme velo matztzil. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi shimon lefaroshe milleta detanna kamma deamar tahor kaatu, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar, tahor deamar tanna kamma lomar sheeno metamme, aval eno matztzil. verabbi shimon savar, tahor umatztzil kaamar. uleel paskinan dahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Mi sheyyatza. meiro, sheshshelachuhu anshe iro leholich lahem eruv kede sheyyuchelu lelech machar lair shemmearvin lah, shehi semucha lahem shene techume shabbat vicholin lelech mizzo lezo al yede eruv:
Vehecheziro chavero. deamar leh et chamma hi et tzinna hi:

Hu muttar lelech. lemachar leotah ir acheret, shekkevan shehechzik badderech kede liknot shevita lesof alpayim amma rachok min hair, have keani sheomer shevitati bemakom peloni, vekana lesham shevita:
Vechol bene iro asurin. shello hechziku badderech, veen lahem ella alpayim amma lechol ruach meiram:

Rabbi meir omer kulei. rabbi meir mesappeka leh i ani hu hoil veyatza mibbeto vehechzik badderech, o dilma kevan shehaya yachol learev befat velo erev lav ani hu, hilkach hare ze chammar gammal, sheen lo alpayim amma lechol ruach meiro, shemma shevitato bammakom shehaya holech leholich sham haeruv besof alpayim meiro, ulesof haalpayim meiro nammi lo kana alpayim letzad ir haacheret, shemma lo kana shevita ella beveto. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shachach achad min happenimit kulei. dehavya penimit regel haasura veoseret:

Natnu eruvan bemakom echad. sheervu shetehen zo im zo venatnu haeruv bachitzona. vekare la makom echad lefi sheshshete hachatzerot mishtammeshot bah keechad. veshachach afillu echad min hachitzona velo erev, shetehen asurot, difnimit nammi asura letaltel bachatzerah, shehare enah yechola lehistallek min hachitzona ulehishtammesh beanpe nafsha, deha leta leeruvah gabbah, deoto eruv hammattirah bechatzer holichuhu lachitzona. aval natnu haeruv bappenimit, chitzona mittasra beshichcha difnimit ufenimit lo mittasra beshichcha dechitzona, deha achada laddasha umishtamsha:

Veim hayu shel yechidim. sheen bappenimit ella echad uvachitzona echad, enam tzerichim learev ze im ze mishshum derisat haregel, dechevan deyachid hu bappenimit haveya regel hammutteret veenah oseret. usetam matnitin ketanna kamma dilel desavar regel hammutteret enah oseret:
Haddar. mi sheeno mode vaeruv. kuti:
Hare ze oser alav. letaltel mibbeto lechatzer, ad sheyyiskor mimmennu reshut sheyyesh lo bechatzer:

Leolam eno oser ad sheyyihyu shene yisreelim. ben letanna kamma ben lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov dirat oved kochavim lav shemah dira uvedin hu shello teesor, ella degazur rabbanan kede shello yadur yisrael im haoved kochavim shello yilmad mimmaasav. tanna kamma savar af al gav deoved kochavim chashid ashshefichat damim veasur leyisrael lehityached immo, zimnin demikre vedayyar yisrael im haoved kochavim, veamur rabbanan en eruv moil bimkom oved kochavim veen bittul reshut moil bimkom oved kochavim ad sheyyaskir, vehaoved kochavim lo yaskir, dechayesh lichshafim, umittoch kach lo yavo yisrael ladur im haoved kochavim velo yilmod mimmaasav. verabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar kevan deoved kochavim chashud ashshefichat damim, tere dishchiche dedayyere gazru behu rabbanan, chad delo shechiach dedayyar, sheasur lehityached im haoved kochavim, lo gazru beh rabbanan. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. vesochrim min haoved kochavim afillu befachot mishsheve peruta, vaafillu beshabbat. veaf al pi sheen haoved kochavim mevattel reshuto ad sheyyiskor mimmennu, yisrael yachol levattel reshut vaafillu beshabbat, vehu sheyyomar lachavero keshello ervu reshuti mevuttelet lecha, veyihye hu asur letaltel bechatzer vachavero muttar, veim yirtzu achar shehishlim chavero letaltel ma shetztzarich lo yachol chavero lachazor ulevattel lo reshuto veyihye hu muttar vachavero asur:

Shene netakim ze vetzad ze. sheyyesh bechol echad kaggeris hakkilki, devintakim nammi bainan kaggeris, dichtiv nega hannetek, hikkish nega lenetek, ma hannega bechaggeris, af netek bechaggeris. veim shene hannetakim munnachim ze etzel ze veyesh shitat sear mafseket ben shene hannetakim vecholeket otam lishnayim kimchitztza hammafseket:
Nifratz. sear shel otah hashshita:
Bemakom echad. besof shavua rishon shel hesger o besof shavua sheni o leachar happetur:
Tame. shehare fasa hannetek:
Bishne mekomot. sheotah shita nifretza lematta ulemala venisharu meotah shita shete searot baemtza:
Tahor. dimvutztzarot ninhu umatztzilot:
Kamma tehe happirtza. im bishne mekomot nifratz, have shiur happirtza mekom shete searot, divhachi chashive hassearot shebbaemtza mevutztzarot:
Veim bemakom echad nifratz tame. afillu nifratz kaggeris, tame, sheen sear shachor mevutztzar vechanus betoch hannega, kevan delo nifratz bishne mekomot:
Haggonev et hakkasva. echad mikkele sharet. milleshon kesot hannasech (Bamidbar 4):
Vehamekallel bakkosem. hamevarech et hashshem beshem avoda zara:
Vehabboel arammit. nachrit:

Kannaim pogim bo. hamekanneim kinato shel makom hayu horgim oto. vehu shettihye hannachrit bat nachrit, uvishat maase, uvifne asara miyyisrael. veim chaser echad min hattenaim hallalu asur lehargo. aval ansho meforash al pi navi, yachret Adonai‏ laish asher yaasenna. umalkin oto arba malkuyyot middivre sofrim, mishshum nidda, mishshum shifcha mishshum nachrit, mishshum zona:
Pirche chehunna. bachurim shemmatchil sear zekanam lifroach bahem:
Bigzirin. bekaiyyot shel etzim:
Rabbi akiva omer bechenek. neemar kan (Bamidbar 1) vehazzar hakkarev yumat, veneemar lehallan (Devarim 13) vehannavi hahu o cholem hachalom hahu yumat, ma lehallan bechenek af kan bechenek:

Vachachamim omrim bide shamayim. neemar kan yumat, veneemar lehallan (Bamidbar 17) kol hakkarev hakkarev el mishkan Adonai‏ yamut, ma lehallan bide shamayim af kan bide shamayim. vahalacha kachachamim. umita vide shamayim hu fachot min hakkaret, shehakkaret yesh alav onesh leachar mita im lo asa teshuva charauy, umita vide shamayim en leachar mita alav kelum. verashi chatav beferek bamme madlikin (shabbat daf ko) demita vide shamayim yamav niktzarim veeno holech ariri, karet it beh tarte, yamav nichratim veholech ariri. umechuyyave mita vide shamayim sheal iske mikdash vekadashim hem achad asar, veellu hen, haochel tevel, vechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora, vezar sheachal teruma, vezar vetame utevul yom sheshshimmeshu, umechussar kippurim, umechussar begadim, veshello kiddesh yadayim veraglayim, ushetuye yayin, uferue rosh. ketzat mehem neemar mita vahem beferush, uketzatam lemadum rabbotenu mippi hakkabbala bigzera shava uvehekkesh:

Hannetakim. negaim shebbarosh o vazzakan, keruyin netakim, al shem shehassear nittak venofel venosher mechamat hannega. vehannetakim en mittammein bearbaa marot kenega shebbimkom basar, ella mittammeim bechol marot:
Besear tzahov. dome letavnit zahav:
Dak lakuy katzar. ma sheamra tora uvo sear tzahov dak, mashmauto lakuy katzar:
Afillu aroch. sheen mashmaut dak ella rakik:

Ma hallashon omrim. milleshon bene adam atta lamed. kesheomrim kane ze dak, ma mashmao, ben lakuy katzar ben lakuy aroch. veit sefarim degarse, velo lakuy aroch, bitmiha, kelomar shemma lakuy katzar velo lakuy aroch:
Nilmad min hassear. derech bene adam kesheomrim al hassear shehu dak, al hallakuy katzar omrim, velo al hallakuy haaroch. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Mi shennitchayyev shete mitot. kegon sheavar avera kalla venigmar dino laavera kalla, vechazar veavar avera chamura, salka datach amena kevan denigmar dino laavera kalla, hay gavra ketila hu, kamashma lan:
Avar avera sheyyesh bah shete mitot. kegon chamoto, vehi eshet ish:
Niddon bachamura. bisrefa, mippene shehi chamoto, velo cheeshet ish shehi vechenek:

Niddon bazzikka harishona. beoto issur shehuzkak techilla lehizzaher velifrosh mimmennu hu niddon. aval lo vaissur habba alav acharon, veaf al pi shehu chamur, dekasavar rabbi yose en issur chal al issur, vaafillu chamur al hakkal. veim nasa vat almana shehayta techilla chamoto keshehayta fenuya veachar kach nisset, niddon bisrefa. veim hayta eshet ish veachar kach naaset chamoto, niddon bechenek kemita shel eshet ish shehayta techilla. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Ematay bizman sheen bah diurim. shennifretzu mechitztzoteha veenah reuya lediurin, sheim reuya lediurin af al pi sheen bah achshav diurin enah nechshevet kullah ella kearba ammot ledivre chachamim. vechen ir sheen yoshev bah veyesh lah choma saviv shennatan bah eruvo nechshevet kearba ammot, vaafillu hi gedola keantiyyochya:

Nimtza kal tochah meal gabbah. deillu gabbah shel meara im natan sham eruvo en lo ella alpayim amma mimmekom eruvo, degabbah eno rauy lediyyurin, vetochah mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma:

Velammoded sheamru. af al pi shecholkim chachamim al rabbi akiva benoten eruvo bair lomar shekkol hair lo kearba ammot, modim hen shehabba mimmekom shevitato vechalta middato shel alpayim amma afillu vimara sheyyesh bah diyyurin, sheeno nichnas lehallan mimmiddato kelum:
Veellu hen shemmatztzilin otan benafshan. shemmatztzilin otan min haavera benafshan, shennittan reshut lechol adam lehargam kede lehatztzilan min haavera:

Harodef achar chavero lehargo. dichtiv etzel naara hameorasa (Devarim 22) ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu uretzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze, makkish rotzeach lenaara meorasa, ma naara meorasa nittan lehatztzilah benafsho, af rotzeach nittan lehatztzilo venafsho. venaara meorasa nafka lan mikkera dichtiv (sham) tzaaka hannaara hameorasa veen moshia lah, ha yesh moshia lah chayyav lehoshiah bechol davar sheyyachol lehatztzilah:

Veachar hazzechur. nafka lan deamar kera (sham) velannaara lo taase davar, naar ketiv chaser hei, ze zechur. vehu haddin lechol chayyave cheretot umitot bet din shebbaarayot, shemmatztzilin otan benafshan, dichtiv (sham) chet mavet. chet, ellu chayyave cheretot. mavet, ellu chayyave mitot bet din:
Aval harodef achar habbehema. af al pi sheddome laarayot:
Vehamechallel et hashshabbat vehaoved avoda zara. af al pi sheshshenehem kofrim baikkar:

En matztzilin otam benafshan. vechol shekken shear chayyave cheretot umitot bet din sheenan shel arayot, sheen matztzilin otam benafsham, veen muttar lehargan kelal ad sheyyaavru avera veedim veyihyu chayyavim mita bevet din:
Hachammeret vehaggammelet. shayyara shel chammarim veshel gammalim shennishtahu vair sheloshim yom, have lehu vichlal yoshve iram:

Hare ellu matztzilin. im rov anshe hair huddechu umiut lo huddechu, vechammarim vegammalim shello huddechu mashlimin et hammuat laasotan rov, hare ellu matztzilin, sheen mamonan aved ella niddonin kichidim. vehu haddin degormin nammi laasot ir hanniddachat, im huddechu immam laasotam rov, ella detanna azzechuta ka mehaddar. veod deha pesika leh tefe, distam chammeret vegammelet en datan meorevet im bene hair sheyyihyu niddachin immahen:

Petuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lemavoy. baggemara muchach delo tanninan bematnitin petuchot zo lezo, mishshum dekayma lan sheen mavoy nittar belechi o kora ad sheyyihyu battim vachatzerot petuchim letocho, kelomar shene battim petuchim lechol chatzer ushete chatzerot petuchot lammavoy, vehanach kevan dechullan petuchot zo lezo umeoravot yachad derech pitchehen chada chashev lehu, velo tanninan ella chamesh chatzerot petuchot lemavoy:
Ervu hachatzerot. kol achat leatzmah:
Muttarim bachatzerot. muttarin kol bene chatzer leatzman:
Vaasurin bammavoy. deen somchin al eruv bimkom shittuf:
Veim nishtattefu. nammi bammavoy leachar sheervu bachatzerot, muttarin kan vechan:
Veshachach achad mibbene chatzer velo erev. bachatzero lehattir chatzero, aval bashshittuf haya lo chelek:

Muttarin kan vachan. detaama may en somchin al shittuf bimkom eruv, kede shello tishtakkach torat eruv min hattinokot, vehacha derov bene chatzer ervu ella sheshshachach echad mehem velo erev lo tishtakkach torat eruv:

Shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim. keshem sheasur lehotzi mibbattim lechatzer belo eruv, kach asur lehotzi min hechatzer lammavoy belo shittuf. velo tema lo damu, devayit vechatzer zo reshut hayyachid vezo reshut harabbim, aval chatzer umavoy shenehen reshuyyot shel rabbim hen:
Kol harauy littamme venega habbaheret. kegon or basar:
Meakkev et happericha. im nishtayyer mimmennu chol shehu shello farcha vo, meakkev et tohorato:
Vechol sheeno rauy littamme venega habbaheret. kegon rosh vezakan vechol hane dachashiv bahadayhu:

En meakkevin et happericha. deaf al pi shello farach hannega alehem, kevan defarach bishar hagguf, tahor. verashe evarim lo ka chashiv, dehanhu meakkevin et happericha, diruyin littamme venega habbaheret ninhu, shehare hannega pose bahen:

Venaasu tzarevet tehorim. af al gav deachshav shennikrechu harosh vehazzakan reuyim littamme benega habbaheret, vechen shechin umichva vekedach hammordim shennaasu tzarevet, hare hen keor basar, kevan devishat happericha lo hayu reuyin, lo meakkevim vetahor:

Af al pi shennaasa mekom hammichya baheret tame. difricha kammayta lav pericha hi, kevan deishtayyer meor habbasar chatzi adasha samuch larosh, ufericha dehashta shennitkasset hammichya shel chatzi adasha nammi la chashiva fericha, kevan dichvar nikrechu venaasu tzarevet vahare hen keor basar, velo mahane ad defarach nammi alayhu:
Haomer en tefillin vechulei‏ patur. sheen zo horaa. dezil kere ve rav hu:
Chamesh totafot. yesh horaa. veaf al pi sheen davar ze ella lehosif al divre sofrim, chayyav, shebbemidrash sofrim [letotafot letotefet] letotafot ketiv, hare chan arba parashiyyot:

Vechen shelosha chefarim hammeshullashim. lo meshullashim mammash, ella shelishi omed merachok keneged ben hachitzonim, vechol sheillu machnis emtzai levenehen veen ben ze laze ella 141 amma ushelish, shehen shivim amma ushene shelishim lazo veshivim amma ushene shelishim lazo, vechen letzad hair hachitzona haacheret en ben haemtzait levenah ella mea vearbaim veechad amma ushelish, hare shelashtan nechshavot keachat, vehayyotze meachat mehen lelech derech chavroteha mone mechomat chavertah hachitzona. vechamma yehe ben haemtzait lachitzonit, alpayim amma, dehoil vichola lavo emtzait lachitzona vechitzona laemtzait belo eruv amrinan roin keillu emtzait netuna benehen. aval im rechoka yoter mealpayim lo amrinan roin:

Rotzeach shennitarev baacherim. kegon shenayim shehayu omdim veyatza chetz mibbenehem veharag, shenehem peturim. vaafillu echad mishshenehem muchzak bachasidut uveyadua shehu lo zarak hachetz, afillu hachi lo mechayyevin leh leidach bachazaka zo:

Rabbi yehuda omer konsin otan lechippa. matnitin chasure michassera vehachi katane, veshor shennigmar dino shennitarev bishvarim acherim, soklim otam, deha al karchacha kullehu asurim bahanaa vaafillu hen elef, mippene ze hameorav bahen, hilkach soklin et kullam kede shettitkayyem mitzvat sekila bamchuyyav bah. [rabbi yehuda omer] konsin otan lechippa, veen tzarich lesaklan, ella chonsin otan lecheder vehen metim baraav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Rabbi shimon omer besayif. shehachenek chamur:
Vachachamim omrim bechenek. shehassayif chamur:

Maase vitzdoki. matnitin chassore mechasra vehachi katane, tzedoki hare hu keoved kochavim, rabban gamliel omer eno keoved kochavim, umaase bitzdoki echad kulei‏ veamar lanu abba maharu vaasu tzarchechem ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem. shema minnah dichyisrael hu veyachol levattel reshut. umippene shehamevattel reshuto vechazar vehotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid oser kedilkamman, mishshum hachi kaamar rabban gamliel maharu veasu tzarchechem ad shello yotzi hu kelav lechatzer veyachzor veyizke birshuto shebbittel veyeesor alechem, aval i keoved kochavim hu veen haoved kochavim yachol levattel ad sheyyiskor, hechi have matze lemesar alayhu meachar daagir lehu veshakel deme:

Verabbi yehuda omer. lo kach amar rabban gamliel, dilolam tzedoki hare hu keoved kochavim sevira leh lerabban gamliel, veotah maase enah reaya, dehachi kaamar lehu rabban gamliel, maharu vaasu tzarchechem beerev shabbat kodem shettechshach, velo ad shello yotzi kelav kidamart, ella ad shello yetze hayyom veyeesor alechem. ufesak hahalacha, shekkol yisrael shemmechallel shabbat befarhesya hare hu keoved kochavim veen mearvin immo veeno mevattel reshut, ella sochrim mimmennu kederech shessochrim min haoved kochavim. vehameshammer shabbat befarhesya af al pi sheppeamim mechallel oto betzina veeno mode betorat eruv, kegon hatztzedokim bazzeman hazze shemmeshammerim shabbat veenam modim betorat eruv, hare ze en mearvin immo, aval yachol levattel reshut veen tzarich liskor mimmennu, vehu shello yihye oved avodat kochavim:
Challon betoch asara. sheyyehe ketzat mimmennu vaafillu mashshehu betoch asara samuch lakkarka:
Mearvin shenayim. shene eruvin, ellu leatzman veellu leatzman vaasurim zo im zo:
Veim ratzu mearvin echad. eruv echad, sheyyittenu ellu eruvan baacheret viyarvu immahen veyihyu echad:

Pachot mearbaa. lav petach hu veen rauy laavor mizzo lezo, ulemala measara nammi lo nicha tashmishteh, hilkach en mearvin echad. vedavka bechatzer sheeno mekore aval babbayit hammekore afillu lemala measara mearvin echad, shedderech lasum safsalim vetevot sevivot habbayit venicha tashmishteh:

Hashshechin vehammichva mittammein beshavua echad. im nolad bimkoman baheret, masgiran shavua echad, ulesof shavua im yesh bo sear lavan o fisyon, machlito. veim lav, potro. aval bemichya en mittammein, demichyat basar chay bainan, veen ze basar chay, kevan dimkomo shechin umichva:
Begefet. pesolet shel zetim, vehu cham mechamat atzmo. vechen chamme teverya mechamat mekoran hen chammim velo mechamat haur:
Kol sheeno mechamat haesh zehu shechin. laatoye avar meikkaro:
Remetz. efer kira, vecham mechamat haur:
Kol shehu mechamat haesh. laatoye chamme haur:
Shelosha melachim vearbaa hedyotot. af al pi sheggedolim vachachamim hayu, en lahem chelek laolam habba.

Shello hayta emunatam shelema. veaf al gav devilam meummot haolam hava, vaanan kol yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba tenan, mishshum dekayma lan chaside ummot haolam yesh lahem chelek laolam habba, ashmeinan devilam lav mechaside ummot haolam hu:

Ma shello shama. ma shello neemar binvua leshum navi vaolam. uma shenneemar lachavero velo lo, ushemaah mippi chavero uva veamar shenneemra lo, shene ellu nevie hashsheker hem umitatan bechenek. dichtiv (Devarim 18) ach hannavi asher yazid ledabber davar bishmi, ze hammitnabbe ma shello shama meolam. asher lo tzivvitiv, ha lachavero tzivviti, ze hammitnabbe ma shello neemar lo veneemar lachavero. uchetiv umet hannavi hahu, vechol mita haamura vattora setam enah ella chenek:

Mitatan bide shamayim. dichtiv (sham) vehaya haish asher lo yishma el devaray, kare veh lo yishma, ukeri veh lo yashmia, ukeri veh lo yishshama hu atzmo el devaray, hare shelashtan bakkelal. uchetiv (sham) anochi edrosh meimmo, bide shamayim:
Uvo sear tzahov tame. sear tzahov metamme ben battechilla, ben besof shavua rishon, ben besof shavua sheni, ben leachar happetur:
Nolad bo sear shachor tahor. i vetzamach leachar hannetek, af al pi sheenan mevutztzarot. vei vimshoar, davka vimvutztzar, derachok mikkamat harosh mekom shete searot kedaamaran:

Af al pi shehalach lo sear shachor tahor. dechevan denithar hatztzahov, tu lo metamme af al pi shennashar hashshachor. aval im hechlito befisyon, uva hashshachor vetahar happisyon veachare chen halach hashshachor, chozer happisyon umetamme. o sheppasa vechanas vechazar ufasa, lo amrinan kevan denithar hannetek lo metamme:

Kol netek shettahar shaa achat. ben shehechlito befisyon vechanas, o shebba sear shachor vetiharo, ben hechlito vesear tzahov uva sear shachor vetiharo veachare chen halach hashshachor, o ma shekkanas chazar venittak, shuv en lenetek ze tuma leolam, af al gav dekaymu simane tuma shello kegon sear tzahov ufisyon. velo mibbaya vehane dichvar taharu besear shachor, ella afillu fasa achar shehalach hashshachor o nolad bo sear tzahov acher, kevan detahar hannetek kevar shuv en lo tuma:

Rabbi shimon omer kol sear tzahov shettahar shaa achat. kegon hay dahava kae beshaa shebba hashshachor, en lo tuma leolam. aval im achar shehalach hashshachor nolad bannetek sear tzahov acher o fasa achare chen, tame, dechol netek shettahar lo amrinan. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Mittoch hattohora tame. kegon habba chullo lavan battechilla, uleachar hesger o hechlet nithar, deim chazru vo rashe evarim venitgallu, tahor, kidfareshna leel. veim mittoch tohora zo chazru venitkassu bevat achat, tame mishshum pisyon, vehayenu dekaamar im parcha chullo keachat mittoch tohora, tame, kidfareshna vematnitin dilel deim parcha chullo bevat achat nammi tame kemo parcha vemiktzato:
Patur min happeria umin happerima. kol zeman shehu musgar. veillu tahor mittoch hechlet, chayyav bifria uferima, kol zeman shehu muchlat. peria uferima, begadav yihyu ferumim verosho yihye farua:
Metammein bevia. im bau el haohel nitma kol asher baohel:
Baheret. mehasheta ayre beveharot temeot:
Veen bah kelum. lo michya velo sear lavan:
Battechilla. keshehuva el hakkohen. vechen besof shavua rishon im lo nolad bah kelum, yasgir:
Besof shavua sheni. im lo nolad bah kelum, patur. vechen leachar happetur, im lo nolad bah kelum, omed biftur ze kol yamav veshuv eno masgiro:

Odehu masgiro. shehaya rotze lehasegiro, ben battechilla keshehuva el hakkohen, ben besof shavua rishon, velo hispik lehasegiro ad shennoldu simane tuma, kegon battechilla besear lavan umichya, uvesof shavua rishon besear lavan umichya ufisyon, yachlit. aval mishshehisgiro, ha tenan leel beresh perek 3, en machlitin et hammusgar:
Ufoter. kelomar o fotro, kegon besof shavua sheni. vaafillu leachar happetur im noldu simane tuma, yachlit:
Odehu machlito. shehaya [va] lehachelit velo hispik ad shehalchu simane tuma:

Battechilla. keshehuva el hakkohen, o besof shavua rishon: yasgir. aval im mishshehechlito halchu lahen, kegon shehechlito vesear lavan vehalach lo sear lavan uvaheret kayyemet, en masgiro aleha, ella fotro vetahor:
En moddin. alpayim amma shel techum shabbat ella bechevel shel pishtan aroch chamishshim amma:
Lo fachot. shekkeshehachevel katzar nimtach harebe umaarich (haamma) [hammidda]:
Velo yoter. shekkeshehu aroch harebe kavdo machpilo beemtzaito umitkatztzer:
Ella cheneged libbo. kavu lo chachamim makom lasum rosh hachevel kol echad neged libbo, sheim yitten ze keneged tzavvaro veze keneged raglav hachevel mitkatztzer vehattechumin mitmaatin:
Legader. chomat avanim shennafla venaaset gal gavoah umeshuppa:

Mavlio. im eno rachav chamishshim amma missefato el sefato millemala, af al pi sheyyesh bemidrono hilluch yoter meelef, en omrim taale middat midrono lemiddat hattechum, ella ze yaamod al sefato mikkan veze yaamod al sefato mikkan veyavliu midrono bechevel echad:

Vechozer lemiddato. middekatane chozer lemiddato, mashma sheim haya rachbo keneged hair yoter mechamishshim veeno yachol lehavelio sham bachevel, uveechad merashav shello keneged hair yachol lehavelio, holech umavlio sham, umoded veholech sham missefato vahala ad keneged hammakom shekkale bo rochav haggay keneged hair, vechozer lemiddato keneged hair, umashlim et middat techumav:

Higgia lehar mavlio. vehu shello yihye har zakuf harebe ella meshuppa, shebbehilluch chamesh ammot mimmennu lo yigba ella asara tefachim, aval im hu zakuf ad shebbefachot mehilluch chamesh ammot zakuf asara tefachim, eno mavlio, ella omdo bilvad veholech:

Vehu shello yetze chutz lattechum. kesheholech hammoded lehavelia hahar o haggay, lo yetze chutz lattechum lemakom sherashe haggay ketzarim sheyyachol lehaveliam sham kede sheyyachzor achar kach lemiddato keneged hair, gezera mippene sheharoe oto moded veholech sham yomar shemmiddat techumim shel tzidde hair baa ad kan:
Bazo amar rabbi dostay. bezo lemiute ir miklat veegla arufa hakkerova el hechalal, sheen mekadderin bahen:

Mekadderin. nokvin, roin keillu nokvin otan umoddim derech hannekev lemaet middat midrono, kidamrinan baggemara shemmoddin oto bechevel shel arba ammot, vehattachton meniach et hachevel keneged libbo vehaelyon keneged raglav, vechen moddin oto kullo arba ammot arba ammot, umitmaet midron shel kol arba ammot chatzi komat adam. vahalacha kerabbi dostay:

Notnin karpef lair. kol habba limdod techumin meniach lair avir shel shivim amma veshirayim shehen shivim amma ushene shelishe amma umishsham matchil limdod alpayim amma, shenneemar (Bamidbar la) mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv, amra tora ten chutza veachar kach medod, kelomar ten lah karpef shel shivim amma veshirayim veachar kach medod mishsham vahala:

Lo amru karpef ella ven shete ayarot. shete ayarot hassemuchot zo lazo notnin shivim amma veshirayim lechol achat kede lechabberan al yede karpifot hallalu lihyot keir achat, vehabba lalechet meachat mehen [derech] chavertah moddim lo alpayim amma michutz lachavertah, mippene sheshshetehen keir achat al yede karpifot hallalu shemmechabberin benehen. vahalacha kachachamim, sheen notnin karpef leir achat ella ben shete ayarot bilvad:

Afillu amma achat lo yikkanes. veen lo ella arba ammot mikkan vearba ammot mikkan. veaf al pi shemmuvlaot ellu arba ammot betoch techum hair, lo amrinan kevan deal al, disvira leh havelaat techumim lav milleta hi:

Shetayim yikkanes. rabbi eliezer letaameh, deamar vehu beemtzaan, shebbesof haalpayim yesh lo arba ammot, shetayim mitztzad ze betoch hattechum ushetayim mitztzad ze lesof hattechum, hilkach im hu omed baamma hashsheniyya yikkanes, dehavlaat techumin milleta hi. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Mi shehechshich. shehaya ba min hadderech vechashcha lo chutz lattechum:

Lo yikkanes. devimkomo lo kana shevita, shehare gilla dato sheeno rotze liknot shevita bimkomo, uvair lo kana shevita, sheyyesh beno uven hair yoter mealpayim amma, hilkach en lo ella arba ammot kedin mi sheyyatza michutz lattechum:
Ad chamesh esre amma. lav davka, dehu haddin pachot o yoter meat. veit dimfarshe chamesh esre davka, velo yadati leyashshevo yafe:
Hammashochot. modde hattechumim laayarot veosin siman lesof hattechum, en mematztzin et hammiddot laasot hassiman besof alpayim mammash, ella konsin otan letoch alpayim:

Mippene hattoin. sheen makkirin hassiman ufeamim sheyyotzim lehallan mimmennu vechozrin velav addatayhu, umishshum hachi regilin tamid lichnos betoch alpayim, venimtza sheellu chamesh esre ammot betoch hattechum hen, vechevan shehaya ze anus sharinan leh likkanes, velo machmirinan leh ki hechi demachmirinan lemi sheyyatza chutz lattechum, dehatam hava leh lizzaher velatet bedato shello yetze. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Mi shehaya vammizrach. bassade, vekadash alav sham hayyom, vehu rachok meeruvo yoter mealpayim, vahare en eruvo eruv kevan sheeno yachol lelech velittelo, haveya leh shevitato beveto, shehare bitchum beto hu omed, umistama beveto nicha leh shettehe shevitato kesheen eruvo eruv:
Asur leveto. limnot mibbeto alpayim lechol ruach:
Beibburah shel ir. beechad min habbattim haomdim betoch shivim amma veshirayim:
Lo asa velo chelum. shehare belo eruv nammi yesh lo min hair alpayim lechol ruach, vechol hair im ibburah nechshavim lo kearba ammot:
Netano chutz lattechum. chutz leibburah shel ir, vehachi mefaresh la baggemara:

Ma shenniskar. leruach ze mafsid laruach shekkenegdah, shehare mone min haeruv alpayim lechol ruach, veim netano besof elef lammizrach nimtza shekkalot alpayim shel mizrach besof shelosha alafim lair venistakker elef, vealpayim shel maarav kalot besof elef shel maarav hair vehifsid elef. veka mashma lan deen hair ola becheshbon haalpayim shel maarav ella kullah kearba ammot. vehane mille kesheen kalot haalpayim shemmin haeruv letzad hair ella besof hair o chutza lah, aval im kalot beemtza hair o beeze makom betochah eno yachol lelech betoch hair ella ad makom shekkalot haalpayim amma shel eruv vetu lo, keditnan besamuch:
Hatztzomeach matztzil. sear shachor shetztzamach bannetek:
Miyyad sear tzahov umiyyad pisyon. sheim huchlat besear tzahov o befisyon, vetzamchu vo shete searot shechorot, tahor:
Ben mechunnas. dishtehen bemakom echad:
Ben mefuzzar. achat lemizrach hannega veachat lemaaravo:
Vehameshoar. shekkadmu shete searot shechorot hallalu lannetek, kegon shekkeshennittak sear rosho o zekano chaggeris nisharu vetoch hannetek shete searot shechorot:
Umevutztzar. im hen mevutztzarot beemtza hannetek, matztzilot. aval omdot min hatztzad, en matztzilot:

Ad sheyyehe rachok min hakkama. ad sheyyehu shete searot hallalu rechokot min hassearot hammakkifot et hannetek keshiur shete searot. vehassearot shesseviv hannetek hen keruyin kama. ucheshessearot hallalu rechokot min hakkama mekom shete searot, nechshavot kimvutztzarot betoch hannega:

Achat tzehubba veachat shechora. bitzhubba shekkadma lannetek delo haveya siman tuma, itzterich leh lememar deen mitztarefet im hashshechora lehatztzil miyyad sear tzahov umiyyad happisyon. usetam matnitin kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar besamuch lekamman desear tzahov shekkadam lannetek lo metamme velo matztzil:
Mechunnas. shete searot bemakom echad:
Mefuzzar. achat bemizrach hannega veachat bemaaravo:
Mevutztzar. shehassear beemtza hannetek, kemivtzar shehu veemtza hair:
Hafuch. shennehpach hassear letzahov mechamat hannetek, kegon shehannetek kadam lassear [tzahov]:
Sheeno hafuch. shekkadam sear tzahov lannetek:

Sheen sear acher matztzil miyyado. sheim yesh bannega shete searot levanot, afillu male searot shechorot enan matztzilot (al hashsheti) searot levanot shello yetammeu. aval sear tzahov, im yesh immo [shete] searot shechorot eno metamme. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Niddon al shem sofo. sof shemmechalle mamon aviv umevakkesh ma shehurgal bo veeno motze, veyoshev befarashat derachim umelastem et habberiyyot, amra tora yamut zakkay veal yamut chayyav:
Hanaa lahen. sheenan mosifin lachato:
Vahanaa laolam. shakta chol haaretz:
Ra lahen. shehayu mosifim zechuyyot:
Vera laolam. shehayu meginnim al doran umochichin et haddor:
Yayin veshena larshaim. kol zeman sheshshotim vishenim en chotin veen merein labberiyyot:
Latztzaddikim ra lahen. sheenam oskin battora:
Vera laolam. shekkeshehen mitbattelim, puranut baa laolam:
Pizzur. shehen nifradim ze mizze veen yecholim lehivvaetz ulesayyea ze et ze:
Mi shehaya muchlat. besear lavan o vemichya o befisyon:
Lo hispik lehareot lakkohen. shessimane tuma halchu:
Sheillu hera lakkohen. keshehalchu simane tuma haya metaher, veim achar ken haya foreach, haya tame, dahava leh poreach min hattahor, aval hasheta have leh poreach min hattame, vetahor:
Baheret veen bah kelum. en bo siman missimane tuma:

Ad shepparcha vechullo tame. kelomar, taun hesger keva chullo lavan battechilla. veim mittechilla kodem shepparcha hara el hakkohen haya masgir, uvesof shavua keshepparcha, have leh poreach mittoch hesger vetahor:
Ben sorer umore. mishsheyyavi shete searot. vehu ven shelosh esre shana veyom echad. demikamme hachi en hassearot siman ella shuma:
Ad sheyyakkif zakan hattachton. hay zakan deamur rabbanan, hattachton amru, sheyyakkif hassear sevivot haggid:
Velo haelyon. zakan mammash:

Shenneemar ben velo ish. mishshehikkif zakan hattachton ish hu. veaf al gav demikkatnuto hu karuy ben, lo matzinu lechayyevo mikamme sheyyavi shete searot, dekatan patur, shello va lichlal hammitzvot, hilkach chiyyuveh batar hachi hu. vehachi kaamar kera, ki yihye leish ben, ben hassamuch ligvurato shel ish, bitchillat ishuto chayyeveh kera. umishshehikkif zakan hattachton, ish gamur hu:
Yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal. banim sheenam olim bitchiyyat hammetim, veniddachin kammaddichin:
Ad sheyyihyu maddicheha meotah hair. dichtiv vayyaddichu et yoshve iram, velo yoshve ir acheret:
Umeoto hashshevet. dichtiv mikkirbecha, mikkerev hashshevet atzmo:
Vead sheyyuddach rubbah. shel ir. dichtiv yoshve iram, demashma yishshuvah shel ir dehaynu rubbah:
Hare ellu chichidim. sheavdu avoda zara. veyiddonu viskila umamonan palet:
Utzerichim. anshe ir hanniddachat:

Shene edim vehateraa lechol echad veechad. shehayu marbim lahem batte dinin, vechol mi shennimtza sheavad avoda zara beedim vehateraa mafrishim otan ad sheyyiru im hem rubbah shel ir, meviin otan levet din haggadol vegomrin dinan sham, vehorgim otam besayif umamonan aved. veim lo nimtzeu rubbah shel ir, danin otan biskila umamonan palet:
Ganav mishshel aviv veachal birshut aviv. af al gav dishchiach leh lignov mishshel aviv, hoil veachal birshut aviv mitpached umitbaet meaviv shemma yirennu, velo mimmeshich:
Ganav mishshel acherim. lo shechiach leh sheyyuchal bechol et lignov mishshel acherim, velo mimmeshich:
Ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv. dishchiach leh lignov bechol et:
Veyochal birshut acherim. sheeno mitbaet sham meaviv, devichhay gavna vadday mimmeshich:
Umishshel immo. minnechasim sheyyesh lah sheen leaviv reshut bahen. kegon shennatan lah acher nechasim bemattana al menat sheen levalah reshut bahen. veen halacha kerabbi yose verabbi yehuda:
Shenneemar lo yadon ruchi vaadam, lo din velo ruach. sheen omdim baddin veen lahem ruach lichyot im hatztzaddikim sheyyesh lahem chelek:
Korte veriti ale zavach. shekkartu verit im hammakom ale zevachim ushelamim, dichtiv (Shemot 24) vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim, uchetiv (sham) vayyizrok al haam vayyomer hinne dam habberit:
En atidim lachazor. mimmakom sheggalu. veha deamrinan sheyyirmeya hecheziran veyoshiyyahu ven amon malach alehem, lo chullan chazru ella miktzatan:
