Parcha vechullo veachar kach nitgallu vo rashe evarim. hacha mayre shello hispik lehachelito ad shepparcha vechullo venitgallu rashe evarim, derabbi yishmael medamme leh leva chullo lavan battechilla chutz merashe evarim, detaun hesger. verabbi elazar ben azarya savar, dechevan deillu lo farcha haya machlito, dino chevaheret ketanna uvah michya, dei farcha vechullo veachar kach nitgallu rashe evarim, tame. veod yesh lefaresh, daafillu hechlito bemichya ufarcha vechullo vetiharo, kasavar rabbi yishmael deen metamme vachazarat rashe evarim, dechi metamme vachazarat rashe evarim sheachar pericha, hecha detahar betorat pericha, aval hacha lav betorat pericha tahar, deha illu nitmaata michya mikkaadasha [nammi] tahor:
Charitz. aroch hu umafsik al pene kol hechatzer kullah:
Verachav arba. defachot mikkan noach lefaso missefato lisfato:
Vaafillu male teven vekash. lav setima hi, delo mevattel leh lehatam, desofo littelo:
Ir shel yachid. kegon sheadam echad kana kullah vehu maskir kol batteha livne adam haddarim bah. veachar kach naaset shel rabbim:
Mearvin et kullah. kederech shehayu mearvin keshehayta shel yachid, shello hayta tzericha shiyyur:

En mearvin et kullah. sheasur learev ir shel rabbim im en meshayyer bah battim yeduim belo eruv, dehahu shiyyur have hekker detama mishshum eruv hu velo tishtakkach torat reshut harabbim. vezo hoil vehayta shel rabbim vehayta tzericha shiyyur, af al gav dehashta haveya shel yachid, niddonet kevattechilla:
Ella im ken asa chutza lah. shiyyur shello ervo im shear hair. urevuta ka mashma lan, sheafillu shiyyur shel chutza lah moil lishar hair:

Kair chadasha shebbihuda. ir hayta bihuda ushemah chadasha, velo hayu bah ella chamishshim diyyurim, vehi hair hayyoter ketanna shebbechol eretz yehuda, vehi hayta shiyyur leir gedola hassemucha lah, vehu shiur hashshiyyur shetztzarich leshayyer bair shello yearvo im haacherim mishshum hekkera:
Rabbi shimon omer shalosh chatzerot kulei. ufesak hahalacha afillu bayit echad bechatzer echad have shiyyur. veir sheen lah ella petach echad bilvad, afillu hayta shel rabbim, en tzarich shiyyur:
Veellu hen hannisrafim. habba al ishsha uvittah. al ishsha shekkevar nasa vittah, dehaynu chamoto:
Uvat kohen. vechen bat kohen shezzinneta hi visrefa:

Yesh bichlal ishsha uvittah. kelomar beishsha uvittah ketiva serefa behedya (Vayikra 20) veish asher yikkach et ishsha veet immah vegomer‏ baesh yisrefu, uminna yalfinan kullehu hanach nammi deitnehu visrefa:
Bitto. meanusato, delav bat ishto hi dilchayyav aleha mishshum bat ishto, deha lav bat ishto hi:
Bat bitto uvat beno. shehayu lo meanusato:
Bat ishto. ben shehi vitto ben shehi choragto:

Vachamoto. af al gav detana la resha vehedya habba al ishsha shennasa vittah, velo midderasha atya, ayde detane vehach kelala em chamoto veem chamiv deatya midderasha, tana nammi aggav rihata chamoto bahadayhu:
Kavash alav. achaz rosho shel chavero utekafo vetoch hammayim shello yuchal leharim rosho:
Shissa. gera:
Hishshich. sheachaz hannachash beyado veholicho vehiggia shinne hannachash lagguf shel chavero:
Rabbi yehuda mechayyev. desavar eres nachash beshinnav omed, umikkevan shehiggia shinne hannachash bivsaro shel chavero have cheillu harago vechayyav:
Vachachamim potrin. deka savre eres nachash meatzmo hu meki, hilkach lav ihu katleh ella gerama vealma hu ufatur. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vaamaduhu lemita. aval amaduhu techilla lechayyim, afillu lerabbanan patur:
Vehekel mimma shehaya. vechazru vaamaduhu lechayyim:
Sheraglayim laddavar. shello met mechamat makka zo:

Kol yisrael yesh lahem chelek laolam habba. afillu ellu shennitchayyevu mita bevet din mippene rishatan, yesh lahem chelek laolam habba. veolam habba haamur kan hu haolam habba achar techiyyat hammetim, sheatidim lichyot velaamod begufam uvenafsham chayyim nitzchiyyim, kachamma vechallevana vechakkochavim, kidmayte vaggemara behay pirka, metim sheatidim lichyot en chozrin laafaran. vehaolam habba en bo lo achila velo shetiyya, veaf al pi sheyyesh bo guf ugeviyya, ella tzaddikim yoshvin veatrotehen berashehen venehenin mizziv hashshechina. umippene sheen kol yisrael shavin bo, ella haggadol lefi gadlo vehakkatan lifne katno, mishshum hachi katane yesh lahem chelek:

Haomer en techiyyat hammetim min hattora. baggemara kaamar, vechol kach lamma, tana, hu chafar bitchiyyat hammetim, lefichach lo yihye lo chelek bitchiyyat hammetim. umikkan ani mochiach sheolam habba haamur bemishna zo eno haolam shehanneshamot munnachot bo bazzeman hazze, ella haolam shel techiyyat hammetim kedifreshit:
Eppikores. shemmevazze talmide chachamim. vechol shekken hamevazze hattora atzmah:

Bassefarim hachitzonim. sifre minim, kegon sifre aristo hayevani vachaverav. uvichlal ze hakkore vesefer divre hayyamim shel malche nachrim uveshirim shel agavim vedivre cheshek sheen bahem chachma velo toelet ella ibbud zeman bilvad:
Vehallochesh al hammakka. uverokek bilvad hu deen lo chelek laolam habba, lefi sheen mazkirin shem shamayim al harkika:
Vehahoge et hashshem. shel arba otiyyot kemo shehu nichtav:
Amru lo lamma. yasgir ha i efshar lehivvaled lo siman tuma:
Legaddel sear en reuya. dechaf hayyad eno megaddel sear leolam:
Lefisyon enah posa. dishchin umichva en posin leor habbasar:
Lemichya enah mittamma. deha tenan bishne simanim besear lavan uvefisyon, velo vemichya:
Shemma tichnos. kaggeris, uchesheyyirenna hakkohen besof shavua yiftor oto, uleachar happetur tachazor vetifse vetoch hashshechin shemmekomo kassela, veyachlit:
Amru lo hare mekomah kaggeris. kelomar, veim haya mekom hatztzarevet kaggeris bilvad vehabbaheret betochah, lamma yasgir, vahalo en shayyach lomar kan shemma tichnos vetifse:
Amar lahen lo shamati. kelomar gam ze yasgir, aval lo shamati vo taam:
Alammed bo. tarsheni shealammed bedin ze davar:

Im lekayyem divre chachamim hen. im timtza taam lekayyem divre chachamim sheamru shettaun hesger, emor, aval lelammed sheeno taun hesger lo tomar, sheeni manniach ma shekkibbalti merabbotay veshomea mimmecha:
Shemma yivvaled lo shechin acher chutza lo veyifse letocho. sheshshechin pose lishchin. vechen halacha:
Bitraklin. bayit gadol verachav, moshav melachim, vechillekuhu lachamishsha, vechullan yesh lahen petach min hatteraklin lechatzer, utzerichim learev im shear bene hechatzer:
Bet shammay omrim. reshutehen chalukim vetzarich shekkol chavura vachavura titten pat leeruv hechatzer:

Uvet hillel omrim. en mechitztza zo chilluk reshut. uvizman shechilleku hatteraklin limchitztzot gedolot hammaggiot lattikra kulle alma lo felige dahave chilluk reshut, mishshum dahave kishruyim bachadarim uvaaliyyot. ki felige dechilleku bimchitztzot nemuchot sheenan maggiot lattikra, bet shammay savre mechitztza kazo haveya chilluk reshut, uvet hillel savre lo haveya chilluk reshut:
Hattolesh simane tuma. kegon sear lavan beor basar, vesear tzahov bintakim:
Vehakkove et hammichya. demishshennichvet enah siman tuma:
Over belo taase. dehishshamer benega hatztzaraat. vechol makom shenneemar hishshamer, pen, veal, eno ella lo taase:
Uletohora. kelomar uleinyan tohora ma dino:
Ad shello va etzel kohen. im telashan, tahor. veim telashan leachar chilluto, tame:
Holchim legadvad garsinan, vehu shem makom:
Betoch hesgero mahu. im talash simane tuma betoch shavua shel hesger rishon o shel hesger sheni, mahu:

Hitchalti mevi lahem reayot. battosefta mayte dechach hayta reayato, mippene ma ad shello va etzel kohen, tahor, lo mippene shello raa hakkohen simane hattuma shebbo, hattolesh simane hattuma toch hesger nammi din hu sheyyehe tahor, shello raa hakkohen simane tuma shebbo. hilkach, echad omed bifne hakkohen, kelomar echad oto haomed bifne hakkohen umiher litlosh simane tuma kodem sheyyomar lo hakkohen tame atta, veechad oto shettelashan toch yeme hesgero, ben ze uven ze tehorin. vechen halacha:
Meematay hi tohorato. shel oto shettalash simane tuma leachar chilluto:
Kesheyyivvaled lo nega acher veyithar mimmennu. dechevan denitrappa min hashsheniyya, iggallay milleta dechas rachamana aleh, vei nammi havat kayma kammayta hava mittasse minna kemo mizzo:
Ad shettifrach bechullo. nega haacharon, delekka lemechash lemidi. deha i hava veh nammi kamma, hasheta miha have tahor:

O ad shettitmaet bahareto mikkaggeris. daafillu lo nitlash hassear velo nichvet hammichya, haya nithar, mikkevan denitmaata habbaheret mikkaggeris. umihu ad shettifrach bechullo lo kae ella attolesh simane tuma, aval kove et hammichya eno nithar bifricha, sheillu hayta hammichya kayyemet lo haya tahor bifricha. vahalacha kachachamim:

Ze lifnim mizze. kegon netek kaggeris hakkilki merubba, veshita shel sear makkifo saviv, vechutz leotah shita makkif netek kaggeris kol sevivoteha, dehaynu retzua shel netek berochav kaadasha makkefet et hashshita shel sear, shezehu shiur hannetek hammakkif hassearot hamevutztzarot:
Nifratz mimmakom echad tame. happenimi. shehare sear shachor betziddo veeno mevutztzar letocho. aval hachitzon tahor, deha shete searot shechorot mevutztzarot letocho:
Mishshene mekomot tahor. happenimi, vechol shekken hachitzon. shennaasu shenehem netek echad uvetochan shete searot shechorot mevutztzarot:
Kamma tehe happirtza. mishshene mekomot vihe tahor, mekom shete searot:

Nifratz mimmakom echad kaggeris tahor. veha daamaran nifratz bemakom echad tame, hayenu befachot mikkaggeris. aval meachar denifretza kaggeris, afillu mimmakom echad naasu shene hannetakim echad, usearot hannisharot hare hen mevutztzarot:

Beto asur lehachenis ulehotzi. mibbeto lechatzer, ben hu ben anshe hechatzer. uchegon shebbittel lahem reshut chatzero, kelomar hachelek sheyyesh lo immahem bechatzer, velo bittel lahem beto, desavar hay tanna ma shebbittel bittel uma shello bittel lo bittel, hilkach hava leh bayit reshuta dideh vechatzer reshuta didhu:

Veshellahem. battim shellahen, muttarin lehotzi mehen lechatzer ben hu ben hem, deha battim shellahem vechatzer reshut achat hi. vehu af al gav delo erev have keoreach gabbayhu, sheoreach metaltel birshut achsanya shello:

Natnu lo. hem reshut chatzeran, hu muttar lehotzi mibbeto lechatzer, shehakkol kirshuto, vehen asurim afillu letaltel mibbeto lechatzer. velo havu orchim gabbeh, dechad legabbe rabbim have oreach, rabbim legabbe yachid lo havu orchim:

Hayu shenayim. shello ervu, ushear bene chatzer bittelu lahem reshutam, shenehem osrim ze al ze, mippene shehechatzer hi shel shenehem vehabbattim meyuchadim kol bayit livalav, veen motzi mershut hameyuchedet lo lirshut shello veshel chavero. veaf al gav dahadar chad minnayhu uvattil leh lechavreh, eno moil, hoil uveshaa shebbittelu bene hechatzer reshutam leellu hashshenayim shello ervu hayu osrim ze al ze, ishtakkach devittul kammay lo mehanne, vechi hadar mevattel lo matze leaknoye reshuta didhu, deha lo kanye. hilkach bene chatzer shekketzatan ervu uketzatan lo ervu, otan shello ervu mevattelin reshutan leotan sheervu, veen otan sheervu mevattelin reshutan leotan shello ervu, deasre ahadade kidamran. vehamevattel reshuto livne chatzer tzarich sheyyefaresh shemmevattel lechol echad veechad:
Habba chullo lavan. mittechilla ba chullo mechusse vannega:
Yasgir. kedin baheret kaggeris. shemma yivvaled lo sear lavan o michya. deen pericha metaheret battechilla:
Nolad lo sear lavan. besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni, yachlit. veim lo vau simane tuma, yiftor:
Hishchiru shetehen. kol hane dachashiv, simane tohora ninhu, umeforashim hem leel besof perek kamma:
Nolad lo michya o sear lavan. im leachar shebbau simane tohora hallalu nolad lo michya o sear lavan, tame. veim lav, tahor:

Vechullan shechazru vahem rashe evarim. habba chullo lavan battechilla, ben shehuzkak lehasegir ben lehachelit ben liftor, im chazru venitgallu rashe evarim shellahen, hare hen kemo shehayu utehorim, dela chashive michya. ketzad, habba chullo lavan battechilla vehusgar shene shavuot velo noldu vo simane tuma, ufetaro, veachar kach nitgallu vo rashe evarim, hayenu chazru vo rashe evarim mittoch happetur, vetahor. veim hechlito vesear lavan vehishchiru hassearot veachar kach nitgallu rashe evarim, hayenu chazru vo rashe evarim mittoch hechlet, vetahor. veim besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni nitgallu rashe evarim, hayenu chazru bo rashe evarim mittoch hesger, vetahor. kach niret perush mishna zo mittoch torat kohanim. aval rambam lo fershah ken:
Parcha vemiktzato. bemiktzat rashe evarim shennitgallu:
Tame. shehare fasa hannega:
Parcha vechullo. achar shepparcha vemiktzato:

Tahor. dahave leh poreach min hattame. aval im mittechilla leachar shennitgallu rashe evarim parcha vechullo bevat achat, tame mishshum pisyon. veha detana resha parcha vemiktzato tame, hu haddin parcha vechullo nammi tame, velo nakat parcha vemiktzato ella mishshum devae lemitne vatra parcha vechullo tahor, dehaynu leachar shepparcha vemiktzato:
Natan alav neser. missefato lisfato keen gesher, have kemo petach:
Shete gezuzteraot. kemin tikra boletet mershut hayyachid al reshut harabbim, venatan neser rachav arbaa mizzo lezo, have nammi petach:
Pachot mikkan. sheen hanneser rachav arbaa, adam yare laavor alav velo nicha tashmishteh:

Haachin hashshuttafin. hachi kaamar, haachin sheochlin al shulchan avihem vehashshuttafim haochlim al shulchan echad. veochlin al shulchan avihem lav davka, ella notlin mezonotehen mibbet avihen veochlin otam kol echad beveto. vechen hashshuttafin osim melacha etzel baal habbayit echad beshuttafut venotlin mezonotehem mibbaal habbayit umolichin leechol bevattehem:
Vishenim bevattehem. vehem vaavihem [vaacherim] darim bechatzer echad:
Tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad. im rotzim learev im anshe chatzeran:
Mevattel et reshuto. tzarich levattel et reshuto:

Ematay bizman shemmolichin et eruvan. letitto leechad mibbatte shear bene hechatzer, dehoil vehuzkeku laeruv ushear diyyurin asre, inhu nammi asre, utzerichin kullan litten pat baeruv hoil vachalukin diyyurehen ballina, vegam en ochlin al shulchan avihen mammash ella kol echad notel parnasato veochel beveto:
Aval im haya eruv. kol hechatzer ba levet avihen, shello huzkeku laeruv, shebbayit shemmannichin bo haeruv en tzarich litten pat:
O sheen immahen diurin. acherim, sheen diyyurin mazkikim otam laeruv enan tzerichim learev dechichidim damu:
Vehaya vah kede lehamit al libbo vamet patur. detarte vainan, sheyyehe mitkavven lemakkat mita vegam sheyyakkennu makkat mita:

Rabbi shimon omer afillu nitkavven laharog et ze. lav assefa demilleta detanna kamma kae, aha dekaamar tanna kamma nitkavven lehakkot et haggadol vehaya vah kede lehamit et haggadol vehalcha al hakkatan vamet chayyav, dei aha kae, rabbi shimon poter mibbae leh, velamma leh lemihdar ulefaroshe afillu nitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze, ha beferush amaro tanna kamma, umay afillu. ella rabbi shimon aresha kae, nitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam patur, ha nitkavven laharog et haadam veharag adam acher chayyav, vaala kaamar rabbi shimon afillu nitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze patur. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Mi shellaka veshana. shellaka shete feamim al avera shechayyavim aleha charet, shekkol chayyave cheretot lokim. kesheyyachazor veyaase otah avera atzmah paam shelishit:

Machnisin oto lechippa. makom keshiur komat adam velo yoter. umaachilin oto techilla lechem tzar umayim lachatz ad sheyyuktenu vene meav, vahadar maachilin oto seorim shennofchot bemeav ad shekkereso nivkaat:

Shello veedim. shello veedut sheyyihye mechuyyav aleha mita. umikkol makom yadua levet din shehaddavar emet shebbevadday harag, ella shehuchchashu haedim bivdikot o shello hayta sham hateraa maspeket:
Umaachilin oto lechem tzar umayim lachatz. techilla, veachar kach maachilin oto seorim ad shekkereso nivkaat. vehayenu resha. uma shechisser ze gilla ze:
En mitztarfin. chatzi geris shechin vachatzi geris michva, en mitztarfin lechaggeris:

Veen posin mizze laze. deim shechin umichva ze etzel ze, uveechad mehen baheret kaggeris, vehisgirah, uvesof shavua pasta lachavero o leor habbasar, en machlito. vechen im habbaheret beor habbasar ufasta lashshechin o lammichva, lo chashuv pisyon:
Hayu mordin. shello nitrappeu yafe velo nikram haor vaadayin motziin lecha, en metammein bannegaim, dichtiv [vayyikra 13] shechin venirpa, uvemichva chetiv [sham] vehayta michyat hammichva:
Af al pi shennaasa mekomo tzalleket. shennikkar shehaya sham shechin o michva veen shave lishar or basar, af al pi chen niddon keor habbasar, meachar shennaasa kerum chazak:

Anshe ir gedola. shehayta lahen ir ketanna betoch alpayim, veyotzim meiran umonin veholchim derech hakketanna hassemucha, mehallechin et kol hair hakketanna hassemucha lahen kearba ammot umashlimim middatan chutza lah:

Veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et haggedola. kullah kearba ammot, lefi shemmiddat techumin kala beemtza ir gedola, lefichach en ir gedola nechshevet lahem kearba ammot veen holchim bah ella ad sof techuman:

Ketzad mi shehaya veir gedola. matnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola, bamme devarim amurim, bemoded alpayim amma, aval hannoten eruvo betoch hair, ben natnu anshe ir gedola eruvan bakketanna ben natnu anshe ir ketanna eruvan baggedola, mehallechin kol hair shehaeruv munnach bah kearba ammot, ketzad, mi shehaya meir gedola venatan et eruvo beir ketanna kulei:
Verabbi akiva. cholek al tanna kamma vesavar sheen haeruv ose hair shehu munnach bah kearba ammot, veen monim alpayim ella mimmekom haeruv. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Bet shammay omrim mibbeod yom. desavre bittul reshut makne reshuta hu, umakne reshut beshabbat asur:

Uvet hillel omrim af mishshettechshach. savre bittul lav akkenuye reshuta hu ella istaloke mershuta, veistaloke mershuta beshabbat shappir dami. uvabberayta pershu divchol ducheta amrinan kevan shenneesar lemiktzat shabbat neesar lechullah chutz mimmevattel reshut:
Mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi. shechazar venishtammesh barshut shebbittel:
Echad shogeg veechad mezid. dekanes shogeg attu mezid. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Venittak kol rosho. shepparach hannetek bechol harosh. ben shehuchlat besear tzahov ben shehuchlat befisyon:

Tahor. divchullehu pericha metaheret. uminnayin shehappericha metaheret barosh, dichtiv (Vayikra 13) veish ki yimmaret rosho kereach hu tahor hu. bazzakan minnayin, talmud lomar veish, lerabbot et hazzakan. vehabba chullo netek battechilla eno tahor, keshem shehabba chullo lavan battechilla eno tahor bevaheret:

En meakkevin ze et ze. im haya varosh netek kaggeris veachar kach nittak kol harosh, af al pi shello nittak hazzakan, tahor. vechen keshepparach bazzakan velo farach barosh, tahor, deen meakkevin ze al ze:
Vedin hu. sheyyehu meakkevin:

Sheyyesh davar acher mafsik benehen. shessear harosh vehazzakan deen mittammein bevaheret, mafsikin ben or happanim lishar hagguf. veor happanim ushear hagguf meakkevin ze al ze, dechol sherauy littamme venega habbaheret meakkev perichat habbaheret:
En mitztarfin ze im ze. bammakom sheharosh vehazzakan mitchabberim ze im ze, im nolad chatzi geris baze vachatzi geris baze, en mitztarfin:
Veen posin mizze laze. deim yesh netek kaggeris barosh samuch lazzakan, ulesof shavua rishon o lesof shavua sheni o leachar happetur pasa vazzakan, la chashiv pisyon:
Min happerek shel lechi. haelyon. moteach chut meozen leozen, kol shemmin hachut ulemala zehu harosh, vechol shemmin hachut ulematta ze hazzakan:
Pikka shel gargaret. rosh hashshippuy kova, vehabbasar hammakkif beshippuy kova michutz, karuy pikka:
Shelosha vatte dinin hayu sham. birushalayim, demishtae vah kera vekamta vealita:
Echad yoshev al petach har habbayit. hu shaar mizrachi shellifnim min hachel, lifne ezrat nashim:
Veechad yoshev. lemala hemennu, kesheavru ezrat nashim uvaim lefetach ezrat yisrael:
Veechad yoshev belishkat haggazit. shehi venuya vetoch haazara chetzyah bakkodesh vechetzyah bachol:

Baim laze sheal petach har habbayit. zaken ze shehora veiro venechleku vet din shebbeiro alav vehizkikan hakkatuv laalot lirushalayim, baim hu uvet din shebbeiro laze vet din sheal petach har habbayit, shehare vo fogim techilla:

Talmid shehora laasot. talmid shello higgia lehoraa venechelak al bet din shebbeiro uvau levet din haggadol veshaalu vechazar leiro vehora chevattechilla, patur, sheen lahem lismoch al horaato, vehattora lo chiyyeva ella mufla umumche levet din, kidyalfinan mikki yippale mimmecha, bammufla shebbevet din hakkatuv medabber:

Nimtza chumro kullo. chomer haavera sheavar vehora af al pi shello higgia lehoraa musaf al hahamraa shehimra al pi vet din, hi naaset lo kulla lefatro min hammita, sheim haya zaken shehiggia lehoraa vehimra al pi vet din haya chayyav mita:
Tartemar. chatzi mane. vehu sheyyihye habbasar bashil velo vashil, kederech shehallistim ochlim:
Min hayyayin haitalki. shehu meshubbach umimmeshich batreh. vehu deshate leh mezig velo mezig:
Rabbi yose omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Achal bachavurat mitzva. bisudda shel mitzva:
Achal beibbur hachodesh. af al gav deen olin leotah seudda ella befat vekitnit bilvad veihu assik basar veyayin, hoil uvemitzva kaasek lo mimmeshich:
Achal maaser sheni birushalayim. kevan dichderech mitzvato hu, dichtiv bemaaser sheni (Devarim 14) babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar, lo mimmeshich:
Nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim. dichtiv enennu shomea bekolenu, velo ze sheafillu vekolo shel hammakom baruch hu eno shomea:
Davar shehu mitzva. derabbanan, laatoye tanchume avelim. dei meresha, hava amena chavurat mitzva hayenu chohanim sheochlim kadashim o achilat pesachim:
Vedavar shehu avera. laatoye taanit tzibbur sheissuro middivre sofrim:
Shebbifrichatan tiharu tame. sheal yede ferichatan tiharu et hattame. keshechazru venitgallu achare chen, chozer letumato:

Shebbachaziratam timmeu tahor. sheal yede chazaratan shechazru venitgallu timmeu et hattahor, im chazru venitkassu, sheppasa alehem hannega, tahor. veim chazru venitgallu achar kach, tame. veitzterich leashmeinan daafillu zimne tuva, kidkatane vaafillu mea feamim:

Kotel shebben shete chatzerot. hay denakat rochav arbaa lav mishshum detzarich rochav arbaa lemehave setima, dimchitztza berochav kol dehu haveya setima. ella mishshum devae lemitne sefa hayu [berosho] perot ellu olin mikkan veochlin uvilvad shello yoridu lematta, dechashiv reshut beanpe nafsha, ulehay dina tzarich sheyyihye rochav arbaa, defachot mearbaa have makom petor umuttarin ellu vaellu lehorid lematta:
Uvilvad shello yoridu lematta. laddiyyurin babbattim, aval bechatzer share:
Yoter mikkan. have pirtza, vehaveya kullah kechatzer achat, veim erva kol achat leatzmah have keillu cholkin et eruvan veosrin ellu al ellu:
Haya rechovah chutza lah. im mekom kibbutz bene hair haya chutza lah, konsim otah letoch hair, shetztzarich laasot lah rechov betochah:
Rechov. pelatya gedola:
Hekdeshot shebbetochah yippadu. kelomar en nisrafim ella tzerichim pediyya kishar kol hahekdeshot:

Uterumot yerakvu. baggemara mokminan la bitruma veyad kohen, demamon kohen hu vechal aleh issur deir hanniddachat. umihu lo hayu hatterumot nisrafim kishar shelalah, delo mezalzelinan bah kulle hay, lefichach yerakvu. veim teruma veyad yisrael hi, shelal gavoah hu vetinnaten lechohen shebbeir acheret:
Umaaser sheni. af al gav demamon yisrael hu shehare hu neechol leyisrael, hoil vekodesh ikkere, lo yissaref ella yigganez:
Kalil laAdonai‏ elohecha. amar rabbi shimon vechulei‏ garsinan. velo garsinan shenneemar kalil laAdonai‏ elohecha:
Lo tease gannot ufardesim. deod, legamre mashma:
Lichmo shehayta. beyishshuv battim:
Aval naaset hi gannot ufardesim. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Achat temea. muchletet:
Veachat tehora. leachar happetur. sheamad beenav besof shavua sheni:
Ufarcha mizzo lazo. ben mittehora lattemea ben mittemea lattehora:

Veachar kach parcha vechullo tahor. mishshum dithora naaset temea keshepparach mimmenna lattemea, dahare fasta, vechi farach achar kach bechullo, have foreach min (hattuma lattahor) [hattame, vetahor]:

Bisfato haelyona. chatzi geris baheret. uvisfato hattachtona chatzi geris, ucheshessoger piv niret kaggeris bemakom echad. vechen bishte etzbaot uvishne rise enav, keshemmedabbekan niret kaggeris shalem:
Aval lo vabbohak. mare lavnunit lematta mearbaa marot, umeakkev et happericha:
Chazru vo rashe evarim. shennitgallu min hannega venaasa vohak:

Tahor. vehu haddin bishar hagguf. deaf al gav devohak meakkev et happericha vattechilla, eno meakkev bassof. veaggav sefa devae lemitne rashe evarim, tana hacha rashe evarim. uvassefa nakat rashe evarim, lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir daafillu verashe evarim shennitgallu fachot mikkaadasha venaasu vohak metamme rabbi meir, vechol shekken bishar hagguf. vehach resha dechazru vo rashe evarim kemin bohak tahor, kerabbanan atya velo kerabbi meir. verabbanan dimtahare, lav davka fachot mikkaadasha, daafillu tuva nammi tahor, devohak bassof eno meakkev. vahalacha kachachamim:
